# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module BienChucDanhChanGo30X15
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('BienChucDanhChanGo30X15', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Kích thước chính
    width = 300.mm
    height = 150.mm
    thickness = 5.mm

    # Đế gỗ (3 bậc tam cấp)
    base1_w = 320.mm
    base1_d = 80.mm
    base1_h = 15.mm

    base2_w = 300.mm
    base2_d = 60.mm
    base2_h = 12.mm

    base3_w = 280.mm
    base3_d = 45.mm
    base3_h = 10.mm

    # Mặt biển chức danh
    plate_z = base1_h + base2_h + base3_h

    # Màu sắc
    color_gold = Sketchup::Color.new("#E7C873")
    color_wood = Sketchup::Color.new("#7B2D1D")
    color_border = Sketchup::Color.new("#C7A43A")
    color_text = Sketchup::Color.new("#3B2B1B")
    color_logo_red = Sketchup::Color.new("#D32F2F")
    color_logo_yellow = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFD700")

    # 1. Đế gỗ bậc 1
    base1 = entities.add_group
    pts1 = [
      [-(base1_w/2), -(base1_d/2), 0],
      [ (base1_w/2), -(base1_d/2), 0],
      [ (base1_w/2),  (base1_d/2), 0],
      [-(base1_w/2),  (base1_d/2), 0]
    ]
    face1 = base1.entities.add_face(pts1)
    face1.pushpull(base1_h)
    base1.material = color_wood

    # 2. Đế gỗ bậc 2
    base2 = entities.add_group
    pts2 = [
      [-(base2_w/2), -(base2_d/2), base1_h],
      [ (base2_w/2), -(base2_d/2), base1_h],
      [ (base2_w/2),  (base2_d/2), base1_h],
      [-(base2_w/2),  (base2_d/2), base1_h]
    ]
    face2 = base2.entities.add_face(pts2)
    face2.pushpull(base2_h)
    base2.material = color_wood

    # 3. Đế gỗ bậc 3
    base3 = entities.add_group
    pts3 = [
      [-(base3_w/2), -(base3_d/2), base1_h+base2_h],
      [ (base3_w/2), -(base3_d/2), base1_h+base2_h],
      [ (base3_w/2),  (base3_d/2), base1_h+base2_h],
      [-(base3_w/2),  (base3_d/2), base1_h+base2_h]
    ]
    face3 = base3.entities.add_face(pts3)
    face3.pushpull(base3_h)
    base3.material = color_wood

    # 4. Nẹp vàng trang trí trên bậc 2 và 3
    # Nẹp bậc 2
    border2 = entities.add_group
    border2_w = base2_w - 10.mm
    border2_d = base2_d - 10.mm
    border2_h = 2.mm
    ptsb2 = [
      [-(border2_w/2), -(border2_d/2), base1_h+base2_h-2.mm],
      [ (border2_w/2), -(border2_d/2), base1_h+base2_h-2.mm],
      [ (border2_w/2),  (border2_d/2), base1_h+base2_h-2.mm],
      [-(border2_w/2),  (border2_d/2), base1_h+base2_h-2.mm]
    ]
    faceb2 = border2.entities.add_face(ptsb2)
    faceb2.pushpull(border2_h)
    border2.material = color_border

    # Nẹp bậc 3
    border3 = entities.add_group
    border3_w = base3_w - 8.mm
    border3_d = base3_d - 8.mm
    border3_h = 2.mm
    ptsb3 = [
      [-(border3_w/2), -(border3_d/2), base1_h+base2_h+base3_h-2.mm],
      [ (border3_w/2), -(border3_d/2), base1_h+base2_h+base3_h-2.mm],
      [ (border3_w/2),  (border3_d/2), base1_h+base2_h+base3_h-2.mm],
      [-(border3_w/2),  (border3_d/2), base1_h+base2_h+base3_h-2.mm]
    ]
    faceb3 = border3.entities.add_face(ptsb3)
    faceb3.pushpull(border3_h)
    border3.material = color_border

    # 5. Mặt biển chức danh (inox vàng)
    plate = entities.add_group
    pts_plate = [
      [-(width/2), -(thickness/2), plate_z],
      [ (width/2), -(thickness/2), plate_z],
      [ (width/2),  (thickness/2), plate_z],
      [-(width/2),  (thickness/2), plate_z]
    ]
    face_plate = plate.entities.add_face(pts_plate)
    face_plate.pushpull(height)
    plate.material = color_gold
    plate.transformation = Geom::Transformation.translation([0, 0, plate_z])

    # 6. Viền hoa văn nổi (giả lập bằng khung vàng mỏng)
    border_w = width - 8.mm
    border_h = height - 8.mm
    border_t = 2.mm
    border = entities.add_group
    pts_border = [
      [-(border_w/2), -(thickness/2)-0.1.mm, plate_z+4.mm],
      [ (border_w/2), -(thickness/2)-0.1.mm, plate_z+4.mm],
      [ (border_w/2),  (thickness/2)+0.1.mm, plate_z+4.mm],
      [-(border_w/2),  (thickness/2)+0.1.mm, plate_z+4.mm]
    ]
    face_border = border.entities.add_face(pts_border)
    face_border.pushpull(border_h)
    border.material = color_border

    # 7. Logo quốc huy (giả lập hình tròn đỏ vàng)
    logo = entities.add_group
    logo_radius = 22.mm
    logo_center = [-(width/2)+logo_radius+12.mm, 0, plate_z+height/2]
    logo_face = logo.entities.add_circle([logo_center[0], logo_center[1], logo_center[2]-logo_radius], [0,0,1], logo_radius)
    logo.entities.add_face(logo_face).pushpull(2.mm)
    logo.material = color_logo_red
    # Vòng tròn vàng nhỏ bên trong
    logo_inner = logo.entities.add_circle([logo_center[0], logo_center[1], logo_center[2]-logo_radius+3.mm], [0,0,1], logo_radius-7.mm)
    logo.entities.add_face(logo_inner).pushpull(2.5.mm)
    logo.material = color_logo_yellow

    # 8. Chữ nội dung (dùng add_3d_text)
    # Dòng 1: "ỦY BAN NHÂN DÂN PHƯỜNG DĨ AN"
    text1 = entities.add_group
    text1.entities.add_3d_text(
      "ỦY BAN NHÂN DÂN PHƯỜNG DĨ AN",
      TextAlignCenter = true,
      "Arial",
      12.mm,
      false,
      false,
      2.mm
    )
    text1.material = color_text
    text1.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([0, 0, plate_z+height-20.mm]))

    # Dòng 2: "TĂNG NGỌC ĐĂNG TÂM"
    text2 = entities.add_group
    text2.entities.add_3d_text(
      "TĂNG NGỌC ĐĂNG TÂM",
      TextAlignCenter = true,
      "Arial Black",
      18.mm,
      true,
      false,
      3.mm
    )
    text2.material = color_text
    text2.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([0, 0, plate_z+height-55.mm]))

    # Dòng 3: "PHÓ CHÁNH VĂN PHÒNG"
    text3 = entities.add_group
    text3.entities.add_3d_text(
      "PHÓ CHÁNH VĂN PHÒNG",
      TextAlignCenter = true,
      "Arial",
      10.mm,
      false,
      false,
      1.5.mm
    )
    text3.material = color_text
    text3.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([0, 0, plate_z+height-85.mm]))

    # Dòng 4: "VĂN PHÒNG HĐND VÀ UBND PHƯỜNG"
    text4 = entities.add_group
    text4.entities.add_3d_text(
      "VĂN PHÒNG HĐND VÀ UBND PHƯỜNG",
      TextAlignCenter = true,
      "Arial",
      10.mm,
      false,
      false,
      1.5.mm
    )
    text4.material = color_text
    text4.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([0, 0, plate_z+height-100.mm]))

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

module BienChucDanhChanGoInUv
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('BienChucDanhChanGoInUv', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số kích thước
    width = 300.mm
    height = 150.mm
    depth = 40.mm
    base_height1 = 20.mm
    base_height2 = 20.mm
    base_depth1 = 90.mm
    base_depth2 = 70.mm
    base_offset = 10.mm

    # Màu sắc
    color_gold = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFD700")
    color_gold_dark = Sketchup::Color.new("#E6B800")
    color_red = Sketchup::Color.new("#D32F2F")
    color_blue = Sketchup::Color.new("#0D47A1")
    color_green = Sketchup::Color.new("#388E3C")
    color_wood = Sketchup::Color.new("#7B3F00")
    color_white = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFFFFF")

    # 1. Đế gỗ bậc 1 (dưới cùng)
    base1 = entities.add_group
    pts1 = [
      [0, 0, 0],
      [width, 0, 0],
      [width, base_depth1, 0],
      [0, base_depth1, 0]
    ]
    face1 = base1.entities.add_face(pts1)
    face1.pushpull(base_height1)
    base1.material = color_wood

    # 2. Đế gỗ bậc 2 (trên)
    base2 = entities.add_group
    pts2 = [
      [base_offset, base_offset, base_height1],
      [width - base_offset, base_offset, base_height1],
      [width - base_offset, base_depth2 + base_offset, base_height1],
      [base_offset, base_depth2 + base_offset, base_height1]
    ]
    face2 = base2.entities.add_face(pts2)
    face2.pushpull(base_height2)
    base2.material = color_wood

    # 3. Mặt bảng mica vàng in UV
    board = entities.add_group
    board_z = base_height1 + base_height2
    board_y = (base_depth2 + base_offset - depth) / 2 + base_offset
    pts3 = [
      [0, board_y, board_z],
      [width, board_y, board_z],
      [width, board_y + depth, board_z],
      [0, board_y + depth, board_z]
    ]
    face3 = board.entities.add_face(pts3)
    face3.pushpull(height)
    board.material = color_gold

    # 4. Viền nẹp vàng (hoa văn)
    border = entities.add_group
    border_width = 5.mm
    # Viền ngoài
    border_pts = [
      [-border_width, board_y - border_width, board_z - border_width],
      [width + border_width, board_y - border_width, board_z - border_width],
      [width + border_width, board_y + depth + border_width, board_z - border_width],
      [-border_width, board_y + depth + border_width, board_z - border_width]
    ]
    border_face = border.entities.add_face(border_pts)
    border_face.pushpull(height + 2*border_width)
    border.material = color_gold_dark

    # 5. Logo (khối tròn + hoa văn cách điệu)
    logo = entities.add_group
    logo_radius = 18.mm
    logo_center = [25.mm, board_y + depth/2, board_z + height/2]
    logo_face = logo.entities.add_circle(logo_center, [0,0,1], logo_radius)
    logo.entities.add_face(logo_face).pushpull(2.mm)
    logo.material = color_green

    # 6. Chữ "NHẬT KHOA HƯNG"
    text1 = entities.add_group
    text1.entities.add_3d_text(
      "NHẬT KHOA HƯNG",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false,
      false,
      18.mm,
      2.mm,
      0,
      true,
      0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width/2, board_y + depth/2, board_z + height - 38.mm]))
    text1.material = color_blue

    # 7. Chữ "CHI NHÁNH VĨNH LONG"
    text2 = entities.add_group
    text2.entities.add_3d_text(
      "CHI NHÁNH VĨNH LONG",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial",
      false,
      false,
      10.mm,
      1.5.mm,
      0,
      true,
      0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width/2, board_y + depth/2, board_z + height - 55.mm]))
    text2.material = color_blue

    # 8. Chữ "GIÁM ĐỐC"
    text3 = entities.add_group
    text3.entities.add_3d_text(
      "GIÁM ĐỐC",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial",
      false,
      false,
      10.mm,
      1.5.mm,
      0,
      true,
      0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width/2, board_y + depth/2, board_z + height - 75.mm]))
    text3.material = color_blue

    # 9. Chữ lớn "KIM NHỚ"
    text4 = entities.add_group
    text4.entities.add_3d_text(
      "KIM NHỚ",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false,
      false,
      24.mm,
      4.mm,
      0,
      true,
      0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width/2, board_y + depth/2, board_z + height - 105.mm]))
    text4.material = color_red

    # 10. Chữ nhỏ dưới logo: "NHAT KHOA HUNG"
    text5 = entities.add_group

      true,
      0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([25.mm, board_y + depth/2, board_z + height - 20.mm]))
    text5.material = color_blue

    model.commit_operation
  end

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module BienSoNhaInoxSoNoiNenVanGo30X20
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('BienSoNhaInoxSoNoiNenVanGo30X20', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số chính
    width = 300.mm
    height = 200.mm
    depth = 20.mm
    border_thickness = 5.mm
    border_depth = 20.mm
    steel_frame = 25.mm
    steel_offset = 5.mm

    # Màu sắc
    color_wood = Sketchup::Color.new("#A97C50")
    color_gold = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFD700")
    color_black = Sketchup::Color.new("#111111")

    # 1. Khung xương sắt hộp phía sau (ẩn, mô phỏng)
    frame_group = entities.add_group
    frame = frame_group.entities
    # Khung ngoài
    frame.add_face([steel_offset, steel_offset, -steel_frame],
                   [width-steel_offset, steel_offset, -steel_frame],
                   [width-steel_offset, height-steel_offset, -steel_frame],
                   [steel_offset, height-steel_offset, -steel_frame]).pushpull(steel_frame)
    # Xương ngang tăng cứng
    frame.add_face([width/2-steel_frame/2, steel_offset, -steel_frame],
                   [width/2+steel_frame/2, steel_offset, -steel_frame],
                   [width/2+steel_frame/2, height-steel_offset, -steel_frame],
                   [width/2-steel_frame/2, height-steel_offset, -steel_frame]).pushpull(steel_frame)
    # Xương dọc tăng cứng
    frame.add_face([steel_offset, height/2-steel_frame/2, -steel_frame],
                   [width-steel_offset, height/2-steel_frame/2, -steel_frame],
                   [width-steel_offset, height/2+steel_frame/2, -steel_frame],
                   [steel_offset, height/2+steel_frame/2, -steel_frame]).pushpull(steel_frame)

    # 2. Tấm nền vân gỗ (alu/mica/gỗ)
    base_group = entities.add_group
    base_face = base_group.entities.add_face([0,0,0],[width,0,0],[width,height,0],[0,height,0])
    base_face.pushpull(-depth)
    base_group.material = color_wood

    # 3. Viền nẹp nhôm/inox vàng gương
    border_group = entities.add_group
    # Trên
    border_group.entities.add_face([0,0,0],[width,0,0],[width,border_thickness,0],[0,border_thickness,0]).pushpull(-border_depth)
    # Dưới
    border_group.entities.add_face([0,height-border_thickness,0],[width,height-border_thickness,0],[width,height,0],[0,height,0]).pushpull(-border_depth)
    # Trái
    border_group.entities.add_face([0,border_thickness,0],[border_thickness,border_thickness,0],[border_thickness,height-border_thickness,0],[0,height-border_thickness,0]).pushpull(-border_depth)
    # Phải
    border_group.entities.add_face([width-border_thickness,border_thickness,0],[width,border_thickness,0],[width,height-border_thickness,0],[width-border_thickness,height-border_thickness,0]).pushpull(-border_depth)
    border_group.material = color_gold

    # 4. Nền vàng gương phía dưới chữ (cao 60mm, sát đáy)
    gold_base_height = 60.mm
    gold_base_group = entities.add_group
    gold_base_face = gold_base_group.entities.add_face(
      [border_thickness, border_thickness, 0],
      [width-border_thickness, border_thickness, 0],
      [width-border_thickness, gold_base_height+border_thickness, 0],
      [border_thickness, gold_base_height+border_thickness, 0]
    )
    gold_base_face.pushpull(-depth+1.mm)
    gold_base_group.material = color_gold
    gold_base_group.move!([0, height-gold_base_height-border_thickness, 0])

    # 5. Số nổi inox vàng gương "28"
    text_group = entities.add_group
    text_height = 60.mm
    text_depth = 20.mm
    text = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "28",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false,
      false,
      text_height,
      text_depth,
      0,
      true,
      0.0
    )
    # Căn giữa trên nền
    bounds = text_group.bounds
    x_offset = (width - (bounds.max.x-bounds.min.x))/2 - bounds.min.x
    y_offset = height - border_thickness - text_height - 10.mm
    text_group.move!([x_offset, y_offset, depth])
    text_group.material = color_gold

    # 6. Chữ nổi đen "PI NĂNG TẮC"
    text2_group = entities.add_group
    text2_height = 25.mm
    text2_depth = 3.mm
    text2 = text2_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "PI NĂNG TẮC",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false,
      false,
      text2_height,
      text2_depth,
      0,
      true,
      0.0
    )
    # Căn giữa trên nền vàng gương
    bounds2 = text2_group.bounds
    x2_offset = (width - (bounds2.max.x-bounds2.min.x))/2 - bounds2.min.x
    y2_offset = height - gold_base_height - border_thickness + (gold_base_height-text2_height)/2
    text2_group.move!([x2_offset, y2_offset, depth])
    text2_group.material = color_black

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100% dựng biển số nhà mica "223" (xanh dương)
module BienSoNhaMica
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('BienSoNhaMica', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Kích thước biển
    width = 300.mm
    height = 200.mm
    thickness = 5.mm
    corner_radius = 10.mm

    # Tạo mặt nền mica bo góc
    pts = [
      [0, 0, 0],
      [width, 0, 0],
      [width, height, 0],
      [0, height, 0]
    ]
    face = entities.add_face(pts)
    face.pushpull(thickness)
    group_bg = entities.add_group(face.all_connected)
    group_bg.material = "#0A2D8F" # Xanh dương đậm

    # Bo góc (cắt bo 4 góc)
    require 'sketchup.rb'
    def self.round_corners(group, width, height, radius, thickness)
      ents = group.entities
      # 4 góc: (0,0), (width,0), (width,height), (0,height)
      [[0,0], [width,0], [width,height], [0,height]].each do |x, y|
        center = Geom::Point3d.new(x == 0 ? radius : width - radius, y == 0 ? radius : height - radius, thickness/2)
        arc = ents.add_arc(center, [0,0,1], [x==0 ? 1 : -1,0,0], radius, 0, 90.degrees)
        face = ents.add_face(arc)
        face.pushpull(-thickness)
      end
    end
    round_corners(group_bg, width, height, corner_radius, thickness)

    # Viền chỉ trắng (vẽ đường line offset vào trong 10mm)
    offset = 10.mm
    viền_pts = [
      [offset, offset, thickness+0.1],
      [width-offset, offset, thickness+0.1],
      [width-offset, height-offset, thickness+0.1],
      [offset, height-offset, thickness+0.1],
      [offset, offset, thickness+0.1]
    ]
    viền = entities.add_group
    viền.entities.add_edges(viền_pts)
    viền.material = "#FFFFFF"

    # Vẽ 4 họa tiết góc (dạng bo cong)
    def self.add_corner_decor(entities, x, y, thickness, color)
      r = 10.mm
      arc = entities.add_arc([x, y, thickness+0.1], [0,0,1], [1,0,0], r, 0, 90.degrees)
      arc.each { |e| e.material = color }
    end
    add_corner_decor(entities, offset, offset, thickness, "#FFFFFF")
    add_corner_decor(entities, width-offset, offset, thickness, "#FFFFFF")
    add_corner_decor(entities, width-offset, height-offset, thickness, "#FFFFFF")
    add_corner_decor(entities, offset, height-offset, thickness, "#FFFFFF")

    # Vẽ lỗ bắt vít 4 góc
    hole_radius = 4.mm
    hole_offset = 8.mm
    [[hole_offset, hole_offset],
     [width-hole_offset, hole_offset],
     [width-hole_offset, height-hole_offset],
     [hole_offset, height-hole_offset]].each do |x, y|
      circle = entities.add_circle([x, y, thickness/2], [0,0,1], hole_radius)
      hole_face = entities.add_face(circle)
      hole_face.pushpull(-thickness*2)
    end

    # Thêm số nhà lớn "223"
    text_group = entities.add_group
    text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "223",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false,
      false,
      60.mm, # Chiều cao chữ lớn
      2.mm,  # Độ dày nổi nhẹ
      0,     # Độ nghiêng
      true,  # Filled
      0
    )
    # Đặt vị trí số lớn
    t = Geom::Transformation.new([width/2, height*0.60, thickness+0.5])
    text_group.transform!(t)
    text_group.material = "#FFFFFF"

    # Thêm dòng chữ phụ "TRƯƠNG PHƯỚC PHAN,P.BTD,Q.BTÂN"
    text_sub = entities.add_group
    text_sub.entities.add_3d_text(
      "TRƯƠNG PHƯỚC PHAN,P.BTD,Q.BTÂN",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial",
      false,
      false,
      15.mm, # Chiều cao chữ phụ
      1.2.mm, # Độ dày nổi nhẹ
      0,
      true,
      0
    )
    t2 = Geom::Transformation.new([width/2, height*0.18, thickness+0.5])
    text_sub.transform!(t2)
    text_sub.material = "#FFFFFF"

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

module BienSoNhaNenAluChuNoiDong

    color_vien = "#222222"
    color_chu_noi = "#FFD700"
    color_chu_phang = "#222222"

    # 1. Khung xương sắt hộp phía sau (25x25mm)
    khung_group = entities.add_group
    khung = khung_group.entities
    # Khung viền ngoài
    khung.add_face([0,0,-25.mm],[width,0,-25.mm],[width,height,-25.mm],[0,height,-25.mm]).pushpull(25.mm)
    # Xương ngang tăng cứng (ở giữa)

    khung.add_face([x1,0,-25.mm],[x1+25.mm,0,-25.mm],[x1+25.mm,height,-25.mm],[x1,height,-25.mm]).pushpull(25.mm)
    # Xương dọc tăng cứng (ở giữa)
    y1 = height/2 - 12.5.mm
    khung.add_face([0,y1,-25.mm],[width,y1,-25.mm],[width,y1+25.mm,-25.mm],[0,y1+25.mm,-25.mm]).pushpull(25.mm)
    # Tai treo (giả định 2 tai tròn Ø10mm, dày 5mm)
    tai1 = khung_group.entities.add_circle([15.mm, height-10.mm, -12.5.mm], [0,0,1], 5.mm, 24)

    khung_group.entities.add_face(tai2).pushpull(5.mm)

    # 2. Tấm nền alu xước bạc
    matbien_group = entities.add_group
    matbien = matbien_group.entities

    # 3. Viền nẹp alu/nhôm đen (bản 10mm)

    ]
    vien_face = vien.add_face(outer)
    vien_face.followme(vien.add_face(inner).all_connected.select{|e|e.is_a?(Sketchup::Edge)})
    vien_group.material = color_vien

    # 4. Chữ phẳng (CÔNG TY TNHH, MST, ĐỊA CHỈ)

      2.mm, 
      false, 
      false, 
      text_font
    )
    text1.material = color_chu_phang
    text1.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width/2, height-35.mm, 1.mm]))

    # Dòng 3: MST: 3401291249 (có 2 gạch ngang)

      "MST: 3401291249", 
      TextAlignCenter, 
      14.mm, 
      1.5.mm, 
      false, 
      false, 
      text_font
    )
    text3.material = color_chu_phang
    text3.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width/2, height-85.mm, 1.mm]))
    # Gạch ngang 2 bên

    # Bên trái

      [width/2-55.mm+g_length, height-80.mm+g_height, 1.2.mm],
      [width/2-55.mm, height-80.mm+g_height, 1.2.mm]

    # Bên phải
    text_group.entities.add_face(

      [width/2+55.mm+g_length, height-80.mm+g_height, 1.2.mm],
      [width/2+55.mm, height-80.mm+g_height, 1.2.mm]
    ).pushpull(1.5.mm)

    # Dòng 4: ĐỊA CHỈ (dòng 1)
    text4 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "ĐỊA CHỈ: D12 LƯƠNG THẾ VINH,",

      10.mm, 
      1.mm, 
      false, 
      false, 
      text_font
    )
    text4.material = color_chu_phang
    text4.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width/2, height-110.mm, 1.mm]))
    # Dòng 5: PHƯỜNG PHÚ THỦY, TỈNH LÂM ĐỒNG, VIỆT NAM
    text5 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "PHƯỜNG PHÚ THỦY, TỈNH LÂM ĐỒNG, VIỆT NAM", 
      TextAlignCenter, 
      10.mm, 
      1.mm, 
      false, 
      false, 
      text_font
    )
    text5.material = color_chu_phang
    text5.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width/2, height-122.mm, 1.mm]))

    # 5. Chữ nổi 3D vàng đồng: "CÀ BIỂN MŨI"
    chu_noi_group = entities.add_group
    chu_noi_height = 28.mm
    chu_noi_depth = 6.mm
    chu_noi_font = "Arial Black"
    chu_noi = chu_noi_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "CÀ BIỂN MŨI", 
      TextAlignCenter, 
      chu_noi_height, 
      chu_noi_depth, 
      false, 
      false, 
      chu_noi_font
    )
    chu_noi.material = color_chu_noi
    chu_noi_group.material = color_chu_noi
    chu_noi.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width/2, height-60.mm, 3.mm]))

    # 6. Đường viền chỉ trang trí trong mặt biển (line đen)
    vien_trang_tri = entities.add_group
    offset = 7.mm

      [offset, offset, 0],
      [width-offset, offset, 0],
      [width-offset, height-offset, 0],
      [offset, height-offset, 0],
      [offset, offset, 0]
    ]
    for i in 0..3
      vien_trang_tri.entities.add_line(pts[i], pts[i+1])
    end

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module BienTenCongTyInoxAnMon40X30
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('BienTenCongTyInoxAnMon40X30', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Kích thước tổng thể
    width = 400.mm
    height = 300.mm
    depth = 20.mm
    face_thickness = 1.mm
    border_thickness = 10.mm

    # Màu sắc
    inox_vang = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFD700")
    chu_do = Sketchup::Color.new("#C62828")
    chu_den = Sketchup::Color.new("#222222")

    # Tạo nhóm tổng thể
    group = entities.add_group
    ents = group.entities

    # 1. Tạo tấm nền inox vàng gương
    base = ents.add_face([0,0,0], [width,0,0], [width,height,0], [0,height,0])
    base.pushpull(-face_thickness)
    base.material = inox_vang
    base.back_material = inox_vang

    # 2. Tạo viền nẹp inox vàng gương (4 cạnh)
    # Trên
    ents.add_face(
      [0,0,0], 
      [width,0,0], 
      [width,-border_thickness,0], 
      [0,-border_thickness,0]
    ).pushpull(-depth)
    # Dưới
    ents.add_face(
      [0,height,0], 
      [width,height,0], 
      [width,height+border_thickness,0], 
      [0,height+border_thickness,0]
    ).pushpull(-depth)
    # Trái
    ents.add_face(
      [0,0,0], 
      [0,height,0], 
      [-border_thickness,height,0], 
      [-border_thickness,0,0]
    ).pushpull(-depth)
    # Phải
    ents.add_face(
      [width,0,0], 
      [width,height,0], 
      [width+border_thickness,height,0], 
      [width+border_thickness,0,0]
    ).pushpull(-depth)
    # Gán màu viền
    group.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each do |f|
      if f.normal.parallel?(Z_AXIS)
        f.material = inox_vang
        f.back_material = inox_vang
      end
    end

    # 3. Thêm chữ ăn mòn (dùng add_3d_text, độ dày nhỏ)
    # Dòng 1: CÔNG TY TNHH MỘT THÀNH VIÊN
    text1 = ents.add_3d_text(
      "CÔNG TY TNHH MỘT THÀNH VIÊN",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial",
      false, false,
      25.mm, 2.mm, 0, true, 0
    )
    text1.material = chu_den
    text1.transformation = Geom::Transformation.new([width/2, height-35.mm, face_thickness+0.1.mm])
    text1.move!([-(text1.bounds.width/2), 0, 0])

    # Dòng 2: TM - DV CHUNG LÝ (chữ lớn, đỏ)
    text2 = ents.add_3d_text(
      "TM - DV CHUNG LÝ",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false, false,
      40.mm, 3.mm, 0, true, 0
    )
    text2.material = chu_do
    text2.transformation = Geom::Transformation.new([width/2, height-90.mm, face_thickness+0.1.mm])
    text2.move!([-(text2.bounds.width/2), 0, 0])

    # Dòng 3: MST: 6001802511
    text3 = ents.add_3d_text(
      "MST: 6001802511",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial",
      false, false,
      22.mm, 2.mm, 0, true, 0
    )
    text3.material = chu_den
    text3.transformation = Geom::Transformation.new([width/2, height-135.mm, face_thickness+0.1.mm])
    text3.move!([-(text3.bounds.width/2), 0, 0])

    # Dòng 4: ĐC: THÔN 2, XÃ EA KIẾT, T. ĐẮK LẮK
    text4 = ents.add_3d_text(
      "ĐC: THÔN 2, XÃ EA KIẾT, T. ĐẮK LẮK",
      TextAlignLeft,
      "Arial",
      false, false,
      16.mm, 1.5.mm, 0, true, 0
    )
    text4.material = chu_den
    text4.transformation = Geom::Transformation.new([15.mm, 30.mm, face_thickness+0.1.mm])

    # Dòng 5: ĐT: 0985 177 457
    text5 = ents.add_3d_text(
      "ĐT: 0985 177 457",
      TextAlignRight,
      "Arial",
      false, false,
      16.mm, 1.5.mm, 0, true, 0
    )
    text5.material = chu_den
    text5.transformation = Geom::Transformation.new([width-15.mm, 30.mm, face_thickness+0.1.mm])
    text5.move!([-text5.bounds.width, 0, 0])

    # 4. Tai treo (giả lập 2 lỗ khoan treo phía trên, mỗi bên 30mm)
    hole_radius = 4.mm
    hole_offset_x = 30.mm
    hole_y = -border_thickness/2
    [hole_offset_x, width-hole_offset_x].each do |x|
      circle = ents.add_circle([x, hole_y, face_thickness/2], Z_AXIS, hole_radius, 24)
      ents.add_face(circle)
    end

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

module BanHieuLedVienSangMat60X80
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('BanHieuLedVienSangMat60X80', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số kích thước
    width = 600.mm
    height = 800.mm
    depth = 20.mm
    khung_size = 25.mm
    viền_nẹp = 20.mm
    radius = 40.mm

    # ======= Khung xương sắt hộp =======
    khung_group = entities.add_group
    khung = khung_group.entities

    # Khung ngoài
    pts = [
      [0,0,0], [width,0,0], [width,height,0], [0,height,0]
    ]
    khung_face = khung.add_face(pts)
    khung_face.pushpull(-khung_size)
    # Xương đứng giữa
    khung.add_face(
      [width/2-khung_size/2,0,0],
      [width/2+khung_size/2,0,0],
      [width/2+khung_size/2,height,0],
      [width/2-khung_size/2,height,0]
    ).pushpull(-khung_size)
    # Xương ngang tăng cứng (trên/dưới)
    khung.add_face(
      [0,khung_size,0],
      [width,khung_size,0],
      [width,khung_size+khung_size,0],
      [0,khung_size+khung_size,0]
    ).pushpull(-khung_size)
    khung.add_face(
      [0,height-khung_size*2,0],
      [width,height-khung_size*2,0],
      [width,height-khung_size,0],
      [0,height-khung_size,0]
    ).pushpull(-khung_size)
    # Chân đế đứng
    chan_de = khung.add_group
    chan_de.entities.add_face(
      [width/2-20.mm, -50.mm, -khung_size],
      [width/2+20.mm, -50.mm, -khung_size],
      [width/2+20.mm, 0, -khung_size],
      [width/2-20.mm, 0, -khung_size]

module BangHieuAluChuNoi450X160
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('BangHieuAluChuNoi450X160', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số chính
    width = 4500.mm
    height = 1600.mm
    depth = 30.mm
    frame_thick = 30.mm
    frame_size = 30.mm

    # Màu sắc
    color_alu = Sketchup::Color.new("#F7F7F7")
    color_frame = Sketchup::Color.new("#E6E6E6")
    color_text = Sketchup::Color.new("#222222")
    color_led = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFFFFF")

    # 1. Khung xương sắt hộp 30x30mm
    frame_group = entities.add_group
    frame = frame_group.entities

    # Khung viền ngoài
    [
      [0,0,0], [width,0,0], [width,height,0], [0,height,0]
    ].each_with_index do |pt, i|
      next_pt = [
        [width,0,0], [width,height,0], [0,height,0], [0,0,0]
      ][i]
      frame.add_face(pt, [pt[0], pt[1], pt[2]+frame_size], [next_pt[0], next_pt[1], next_pt[2]+frame_size], next_pt).pushpull(frame_thick)
    end

    # Xương đứng cách nhau ~500mm
    (1..8).each do |i|
      x = i * (width/9)
      frame.add_face([x,0,0], [x,0,frame_size], [x,height,frame_size], [x,height,0]).pushpull(frame_thick)
    end

    # Xương ngang tăng cứng
    [height/3, 2*height/3].each do |y|
      frame.add_face([0,y,0], [0,y,frame_size], [width,y,frame_size], [width,y,0]).pushpull(frame_thick)
    end

    frame_group.material = color_frame

    # 2. Tấm nền alu composite
    alu_face = entities.add_face [0,0,frame_thick], [width,0,frame_thick], [width,height,frame_thick], [0,height,frame_thick]
    alu_face.pushpull(depth)
    alu_face.all_connected.each { |e| e.material = color_alu }

    # 3. Viền nẹp alu (bo quanh)
    border_group = entities.add_group
    border = border_group.entities
    border_width = 10.mm
    # Trên
    border.add_face([0,0,frame_thick+depth], [width,0,frame_thick+depth], [width,-border_width,frame_thick+depth], [0,-border_width,frame_thick+depth]).pushpull(border_width)
    # Dưới
    border.add_face([0,height,frame_thick+depth], [width,height,frame_thick+depth], [width,height+border_width,frame_thick+depth], [0,height+border_width,frame_thick+depth]).pushpull(border_width)
    # Trái
    border.add_face([-border_width,0,frame_thick+depth], [0,0,frame_thick+depth], [0,height,frame_thick+depth], [-border_width,height,frame_thick+depth]).pushpull(border_width)
    # Phải
    border.add_face([width,0,frame_thick+depth], [width+border_width,0,frame_thick+depth], [width+border_width,height,frame_thick+depth], [width,height,frame_thick+depth]).pushpull(border_width)
    border_group.material = color_frame

    # 4. Chữ nổi 3D: "THỦY NaBi"
    text_group = entities.add_group
    # "THỦY"
    text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "THỦY",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Times New Roman",
      false, false,
      400.mm, # chiều cao chữ
      30.mm,  # độ dày chữ
      0,      # độ nghiêng
      true,   # filled
      0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.new([width*0.27, height*0.65, frame_thick+depth+2.mm]))
    # "NaBi"
    text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "NaBi",
      TextAlignLeft,
      "Brush Script MT",
      false, false,
      250.mm,
      30.mm,
      0,
      true,
      0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.new([width*0.53, height*0.65, frame_thick+depth+2.mm]))
    # Đặt màu chữ nổi
    text_group.material = color_text

    # 5. Dòng chữ phụ: "Tiệm thuê đồ bmt"
    text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "Tiệm thuê đồ bmt",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial",
      false, false,
      110.mm,
      15.mm,
      0,
      true,
      0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.new([width*0.5, height*0.45, frame_thick+depth+2.mm]))
    
    # 6. Nội dung phụ, icon, số điện thoại, địa chỉ
    # Địa chỉ
    text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "Đc: 09 Bà Triệu",
      TextAlignLeft,
      "Arial",
      false, false,
      60.mm,
      10.mm,
      0,
      true,
      0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.new([width*0.08, height*0.18, frame_thick+depth+2.mm]))
    text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "P. Buôn Ma Thuột",
      TextAlignLeft,
      "Arial",
      false, false,
      60.mm,
      10.mm,
      0,
      true,
      0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.new([width*0.08, height*0.11, frame_thick+depth+2.mm]))
    # Số điện thoại
    text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "Sđt: 0962085179",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial",
      false, false,
      60.mm,
      10.mm,
      0,
      true,
      0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.new([width*0.5, height*0.145, frame_thick+depth+2.mm]))
    # Facebook
    text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "Thủy NaBi",
      TextAlignRight,
      "Arial",
      false, false,
      60.mm,
      10.mm,
      0,
      true,
      0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.new([width*0.92, height*0.145, frame_thick+depth+2.mm]))

    # Icon location
    icon_group = entities.add_group
    center_icon = [width*0.045, height*0.16, frame_thick+depth+2.mm]
    icon_radius = 30.mm
    icon_face = icon_group.entities.add_circle(center_icon, [0,0,1], icon_radius)
    icon_group.entities.add_face(icon_face).pushpull(5.mm)
    icon_group.material = color_text

    # Icon phone
    center_icon2 = [width*0.37, height*0.16, frame_thick+depth+2.mm]
    icon2_face = icon_group.entities.add_circle(center_icon2, [0,0,1], icon_radius)
    icon_group.entities.add_face(icon2_face).pushpull(5.mm)
    icon_group.material = color_text

    # Icon facebook
    center_icon3 = [width*0.82, height*0.16, frame_thick+depth+2.mm]
    icon3_face = icon_group.entities.add_circle(center_icon3, [0,0,1], icon_radius)
    icon_group.entities.add_face(icon3_face).pushpull(5.mm)
    icon_group.material = color_text

    # 7. LED hắt chân chữ (mô phỏng viền sáng)
    led_group = entities.add_group
    led_rect = led_group.entities.add_face(
      [width*0.18, height*0.6, frame_thick+depth+1.mm],
      [width*0.82, height*0.6, frame_thick+depth+1.mm],
      [width*0.82, height*0.75, frame_thick+depth+1.mm],
      [width*0.18, height*0.75, frame_thick+depth+1.mm]
    )
    led_rect.pushpull(2.mm)
    led_group.material = color_led
    led_group.material.alpha = 0.2

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('BangHieuAluChuNoiMica', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Kích thước tổng thể
    width = 1200.mm
    height = 400.mm
    depth = 60.mm

    # Khung sắt hộp 30x30mm
    khung_group = entities.add_group
    khung = khung_group.entities
    khung_size = 30.mm

    # Khung viền ngoài
    pts = [
      [0, 0, 0],
      [width, 0, 0],
      [width, height, 0],
      [0, height, 0]
    ]
    khung.add_face(pts).pushpull(-khung_size)
    # Xương đứng
    (1..(width/500.mm-1)).each do |i|
      x = i*500.mm
      khung.add_face(
        [x, 0, 0],
        [x+khung_size, 0, 0],
        [x+khung_size, height, 0],
        [x, height, 0]
      ).pushpull(-khung_size)
    end
    # Xương ngang tăng cứng
    khung.add_face(
      [0, height/2-khung_size/2, 0],
      [width, height/2-khung_size/2, 0],
      [width, height/2+khung_size/2, 0],
      [0, height/2+khung_size/2, 0]
    ).pushpull(-khung_size)

    # Tấm nền alu (phía trước khung)
    alu_group = entities.add_group
    alu = alu_group.entities
    alu_thickness = 3.mm

    # Nền đỏ trên (2/3 trên)
    red_height = (height*0.6).to_i
    face_red = alu.add_face(
      [0, height-red_height, alu_thickness],
      [width, height-red_height, alu_thickness],
      [width, height, alu_thickness],
      [0, height, alu_thickness]
    )
    face_red.pushpull(-alu_thickness)
    mat_red = model.materials.add('AluRed')
    mat_red.color = '#E53935'
    face_red.material = mat_red
    face_red.back_material = mat_red

    # Nền trắng dưới (1/3 dưới)
    face_white = alu.add_face(
      [0, 0, alu_thickness],
      [width, 0, alu_thickness],
      [width, height-red_height, alu_thickness],
      [0, height-red_height, alu_thickness]
    )
    face_white.pushpull(-alu_thickness)
    mat_white = model.materials.add('AluWhite')
    mat_white.color = '#FFFFFF'
    face_white.material = mat_white
    face_white.back_material = mat_white

    # Viền alu cạnh (nẹp alu đỏ)
    vien_group = entities.add_group
    vien = vien_group.entities
    vien_width = 30.mm
    # Viền trái
    vien.add_face(
      [0, 0, alu_thickness],
      [vien_width, 0, alu_thickness],
      [vien_width, height, alu_thickness],
      [0, height, alu_thickness]
    ).pushpull(-vien_width)
    # Viền phải
    vien.add_face(
      [width-vien_width, 0, alu_thickness],
      [width, 0, alu_thickness],
      [width, height, alu_thickness],
      [width-vien_width, height, alu_thickness]
    ).pushpull(-vien_width)
    # Viền trên
    vien.add_face(
      [0, height-vien_width, alu_thickness],
      [width, height-vien_width, alu_thickness],
      [width, height, alu_thickness],
      [0, height, alu_thickness]
    ).pushpull(-vien_width)
    # Viền dưới
    vien.add_face(
      [0, 0, alu_thickness],
      [width, 0, alu_thickness],
      [width, vien_width, alu_thickness],
      [0, vien_width, alu_thickness]
    ).pushpull(-vien_width)
    mat_vien = model.materials.add('VienAluRed')
    mat_vien.color = '#E53935'
    vien_group.material = mat_vien

    # Chữ nổi HAFELE (mica trắng, viền đỏ)
    text_group = entities.add_group
    text_z = alu_thickness + 5.mm # cách nền 5mm
    text_height = 120.mm
    text_depth = 40.mm
    text_x = (width - 480.mm)/2 # căn giữa, ước lượng chiều dài chữ
    text_y = height - red_height + 60.mm
    h_text = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "HAFELE",
      TextAlignCenter,
      text_height,
      false,
      true,
      text_depth
    )
    h_text.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([text_x, text_y, text_z]))
    mat_hafele = model.materials.add('HafeleWhite')
    mat_hafele.color = '#FFFFFF'
    h_text.material = mat_hafele

    # Chữ nổi ĐĂNG TUẤN (mica đỏ)
    text2_height = 80.mm
    text2_depth = 30.mm
    text2_x = (width - 400.mm)/2
    text2_y = height - red_height + 10.mm
    d_text = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "ĐĂNG TUẤN",
      TextAlignCenter,
      text2_height,
      false,
      true,
      text2_depth
    )
    d_text.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([text2_x, text2_y, text_z]))
    mat_dang_tuan = model.materials.add('DangTuanRed')
    mat_dang_tuan.color = '#E53935'
    d_text.material = mat_dang_tuan

    # Chữ phụ nhỏ (đen)
    phu_group = entities.add_group
    phu_z = alu_thickness + 2.mm
    phu_size = 22.mm
    phu_depth = 5.mm
    phu_x = 60.mm
    phu_y = height - red_height - 30.mm
    phu1 = phu_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "Thiết kế Gia Dụng Nội Thất",
      TextAlignLeft,
      phu_size,
      false,
      true,
      phu_depth
    )
    phu1.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([phu_x, phu_y, phu_z]))
    phu2 = phu_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "Phụ Kiện Cửa & Ngũ Kim",
      TextAlignLeft,
      phu_size,
      false,
      true,
      phu_depth
    )
    phu2.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([phu_x, phu_y-28.mm, phu_z]))
    phu3 = phu_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "Phụ Kiện Đồ Gỗ Nội Thất",
      TextAlignLeft,
      phu_size,
      false,
      true,
      phu_depth
    )
    phu3.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([phu_x, phu_y-56.mm, phu_z]))
    phu4 = phu_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "www.hafele-dangtuan.com",
      TextAlignLeft,
      phu_size,
      false,
      true,
      phu_depth
    )
    phu4.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([phu_x, phu_y-84.mm, phu_z]))
    phu5 = phu_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "ĐT: 0914 09 09 92 - 0941 78 38 48",
      TextAlignLeft,
      phu_size,
      false,
      true,
      phu_depth
    )
    phu5.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([phu_x, phu_y-112.mm, phu_z]))
    mat_phu = model.materials.add('PhuDen')
    mat_phu.color = '#222222'
    phu_group.material = mat_phu

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module BangHieuAluDanDecalChuNoi500X90
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('BangHieuAluDanDecalChuNoi500X90', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số chính
    width = 5000.mm
    height = 900.mm
    depth = 150.mm
    khung_size = 30.mm
    viendo = 20.mm

    # Màu sắc
    mau_nen = Sketchup::Color.new("#222222")
    mau_vang = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFD600")
    mau_cam = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFA000")
    mau_trang = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFFFFF")
    mau_den = Sketchup::Color.new("#222222")

    # 1. Khung xương sắt hộp 30x30
    khung_group = entities.add_group
    khung = khung_group.entities

    # Khung viền ngoài
    [
      [ORIGIN, [width,0,0]],
      [[width,0,0], [width,height,0]],
      [[width,height,0], [0,height,0]],
      [[0,height,0], ORIGIN],
      # Khung sâu
      [ORIGIN, [0,0,depth]],
      [[width,0,0], [width,0,depth]],
      [[width,height,0], [width,height,depth]],
      [[0,height,0], [0,height,depth]],
      # Khung sau
      [[0,0,depth], [width,0,depth]],
      [[width,0,depth], [width,height,depth]],
      [[width,height,depth], [0,height,depth]],
      [[0,height,depth], [0,0,depth]],
      # Nối các góc
      [ORIGIN, [0,0,depth]],
      [[width,0,0], [width,0,depth]],
      [[width,height,0], [width,height,depth]],
      [[0,height,0], [0,height,depth]]
    ].each do |p1, p2|
      khung.add_face(p1, [p1[0]+khung_size,p1[1],p1[2]], [p2[0]+khung_size,p2[1],p2[2]], p2).pushpull(khung_size)
    end

    # Xương đứng cách nhau 500mm
    (1..9).each do |i|
      x = i*500.mm
      next if x >= width
      khung.add_face([x,0,0], [x+khung_size,0,0], [x+khung_size,height,0], [x,height,0]).pushpull(khung_size)
    end

    # Xương ngang tăng cứng (chia 3)
    [height/3, 2*height/3].each do |y|
      khung.add_face([0,y,0], [width,y,0], [width,y+khung_size,0], [0,y+khung_size,0]).pushpull(khung_size)
    end

    # 2. Tấm nền alu mặt biển
    nen_group = entities.add_group
    nen = nen_group.entities
    face = nen.add_face([0,0,khung_size],[width,0,khung_size],[width,height,khung_size],[0,height,khung_size])
    face.pushpull(3.mm)
    nen_group.material = mau_nen

    # 3. Viền nẹp alu vàng
    vien_group = entities.add_group
    vien = vien_group.entities
    # Viền trên
    vien.add_face([0,0,khung_size+3.mm],[width,0,khung_size+3.mm],[width,viendo,khung_size+3.mm],[0,viendo,khung_size+3.mm]).pushpull(viendo)
    # Viền dưới
    vien.add_face([0,height-viendo,khung_size+3.mm],[width,height-viendo,khung_size+3.mm],[width,height,khung_size+3.mm],[0,height,khung_size+3.mm]).pushpull(viendo)
    # Viền trái
    vien.add_face([0,viendo,khung_size+3.mm],[viendo,viendo,khung_size+3.mm],[viendo,height-viendo,khung_size+3.mm],[0,height-viendo,khung_size+3.mm]).pushpull(viendo)
    # Viền phải
    vien.add_face([width-viendo,viendo,khung_size+3.mm],[width,viendo,khung_size+3.mm],[width,height-viendo,khung_size+3.mm],[width-viendo,height-viendo,khung_size+3.mm]).pushpull(viendo)
    vien_group.material = mau_vang

    # 4. Chữ nổi "LỐP 66"
    text_group = entities.add_group
    # Tạo chữ nổi 3D
    text_opts = {
      :font => "Arial Black",
      :bold => true,
      :italic => false,
      :align => TextAlignCenter,
      :extrude => 40.mm
    }
    # Vị trí chữ chính
    x_text = width*0.45
    y_text = height*0.45
    text1 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text("LỐP 66", text_opts)
    text1.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([x_text, y_text, khung_size+3.mm+viendo]))
    text_group.material = mau_vang

    # 5. Dòng phụ địa chỉ
    text_opts2 = text_opts.dup
    text_opts2[:extrude] = 10.mm
    text_opts2[:height] = 60.mm
    diachi = text_group.entities.add_3d_text("66 ĐINH TIÊN HOÀNG, BMT, ĐẮK LẮK", text_opts2)
    diachi.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width*0.15, height*0.13, khung_size+3.mm+viendo]))
    diachi.material = mau_trang

    # 6. Số điện thoại
    sdt1 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text("0981 217 430", text_opts2)
    sdt1.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width*0.65, height*0.13, khung_size+3.mm+viendo]))
    sdt1.material = mau_trang
    sdt2 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text("0914 582 952", text_opts2)
    sdt2.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width*0.80, height*0.13, khung_size+3.mm+viendo]))
    sdt2.material = mau_trang

    # 7. Icon lốp xe (mô phỏng khối trụ)
    icon_group = entities.add_group
    icon1 = icon_group.entities.add_circle([width*0.13, height*0.65, khung_size+3.mm+viendo], [0,0,1], 60.mm)
    icon1f = icon_group.entities.add_face(icon1)
    icon1f.pushpull(20.mm)
    icon_group.material = mau_trang

    # 8. Logo lốp xe lớn bên trái (mô phỏng khối trụ lớn)
    logo_group = entities.add_group
    logo1 = logo_group.entities.add_circle([width*0.08, height*0.55, khung_size+3.mm+viendo], [0,0,1], 120.mm)
    logo1f = logo_group.entities.add_face(logo1)
    logo1f.pushpull(40.mm)
    logo_group.material = mau_den

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module BangHieuBatLotTon2MatCoTru250X150
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('BangHieuBatLotTon2MatCoTru250X150', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số chính
    width = 2500.mm
    height = 1500.mm
    depth = 30.mm
    khung_sat = 25.mm
    tru_sau = 40.mm
    cao_tru = 2200.mm
    day_ton = 1.2.mm

    # Tạo nhóm bảng hiệu
    group_bang = entities.add_group
    ents_bang = group_bang.entities

    # Khung sắt viền ngoài
    pts = [
      [0,0,0],
      [width,0,0],
      [width,height,0],
      [0,height,0]
    ]
    face = ents_bang.add_face(pts)
    face.pushpull(-depth)

    # Khung sắt hộp viền (25x25)
    # 4 cạnh ngoài
    def add_khung_sat(ents, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz)
      pts = [
        [x, y, z],
        [x+dx, y, z],
        [x+dx, y+dy, z],
        [x, y+dy, z]
      ]
      face = ents.add_face(pts)
      face.pushpull(dz)
    end
    # Trên
    add_khung_sat(ents_bang, 0, 0, depth, width, khung_sat, -khung_sat)
    # Dưới
    add_khung_sat(ents_bang, 0, height-khung_sat, depth, width, khung_sat, -khung_sat)
    # Trái
    add_khung_sat(ents_bang, 0, 0, depth, khung_sat, height, -khung_sat)
    # Phải
    add_khung_sat(ents_bang, width-khung_sat, 0, depth, khung_sat, height, -khung_sat)

    # Xương tăng cứng ngang (2 thanh)
    add_khung_sat(ents_bang, 0, height/3, depth, width, khung_sat, -khung_sat)
    add_khung_sat(ents_bang, 0, 2*height/3, depth, width, khung_sat, -khung_sat)
    # Xương đứng (chia 3 khoang)
    add_khung_sat(ents_bang, width/3, 0, depth, khung_sat, height, -khung_sat)
    add_khung_sat(ents_bang, 2*width/3, 0, depth, khung_sat, height, -khung_sat)

    # Tấm tôn lót 2 mặt (giả lập 1 mặt)
    face_ton = ents_bang.add_face(
      [khung_sat, khung_sat, depth-1.mm],
      [width-khung_sat, khung_sat, depth-1.mm],
      [width-khung_sat, height-khung_sat, depth-1.mm],
      [khung_sat, height-khung_sat, depth-1.mm]
    )
    mat_ton = model.materials.add('TonTrang')
    mat_ton.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#e0e0e0')
    face_ton.material = mat_ton

    # Bạt in căng mặt trước
    face_bat = ents_bang.add_face(
      [khung_sat+1.mm, khung_sat+1.mm, depth-2.mm],
      [width-khung_sat-1.mm, khung_sat+1.mm, depth-2.mm],
      [width-khung_sat-1.mm, height-khung_sat-1.mm, depth-2.mm],
      [khung_sat+1.mm, height-khung_sat-1.mm, depth-2.mm]
    )
    mat_bat = model.materials.add('BatXanh')
    mat_bat.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#2266bb')
    face_bat.material = mat_bat

    # Phần nền trắng phía dưới (1/3 chiều cao)
    h_trang = height/3 - khung_sat
    face_trang = ents_bang.add_face(
      [khung_sat+1.mm, khung_sat+1.mm, depth-1.9.mm],
      [width-khung_sat-1.mm, khung_sat+1.mm, depth-1.9.mm],
      [width-khung_sat-1.mm, khung_sat+1.mm+h_trang, depth-1.9.mm],
      [khung_sat+1.mm, khung_sat+1.mm+h_trang, depth-1.9.mm]
    )
    mat_trang = model.materials.add('NenTrang')
    mat_trang.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#ffffff')
    face_trang.material = mat_trang

    # Viền nẹp nhôm (alu) ngoài cùng
    def add_nep_nhom(ents, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz)
      pts = [
        [x, y, z],
        [x+dx, y, z],
        [x+dx, y+dy, z],
        [x, y+dy, z]
      ]
      face = ents.add_face(pts)
      face.pushpull(dz)
    end
    nep = 8.mm
    # Trên
    add_nep_nhom(ents_bang, -nep, -nep, depth, width+2*nep, nep, -nep)
    # Dưới
    add_nep_nhom(ents_bang, -nep, height, depth, width+2*nep, nep, -nep)
    # Trái
    add_nep_nhom(ents_bang, -nep, 0, depth, nep, height, -nep)
    # Phải
    add_nep_nhom(ents_bang, width, 0, depth, nep, height, -nep)
    mat_nep = model.materials.add('NepNhom')
    mat_nep.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#b0b0b0')
    group_bang.material = mat_nep

    # Trụ sắt đứng 2 bên
    group_tru = entities.add_group
    ents_tru = group_tru.entities
    # Trụ trái
    ents_tru.add_cylinder([0, -tru_sau/2, 0], [0, -tru_sau/2, cao_tru], tru_sau/2, 24)
    # Trụ phải
    ents_tru.add_cylinder([width, -tru_sau/2, 0], [width, -tru_sau/2, cao_tru], tru_sau/2, 24)
    mat_tru = model.materials.add('TruSat')
    mat_tru.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#b0b0b0')
    group_tru.material = mat_tru

    # Chữ nổi 3D (mô phỏng chữ in trên bạt)
    # ĐỘI SẢN XUẤT
    text1 = ents_bang.add_3d_text(
      "ĐỘI SẢN XUẤT",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false, false,
      180.mm, 20.mm, 0, true, 0
    )

      kg.add_face([x,0,0],[x+khung_size,0,0],[x+khung_size,height,0],[x,height,0])

module BangMicaTenPhong20X10
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('BangMicaTenPhong20X10', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Kích thước bảng
    width = 200.mm
    height = 100.mm
    thickness = 3.mm

    # Màu sắc
    color_blue = Sketchup::Color.new("#2B4CB2")
    color_white = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFFFFF")

    # 1. Tạo tấm mica nền
    pts = [
      [0, 0, 0],
      [width, 0, 0],
      [width, height, 0],
      [0, height, 0]
    ]
    face = entities.add_face(pts)
    face.pushpull(thickness)
    face.material = color_blue
    face.back_material = color_blue

    # 2. Tạo viền trắng mảnh bên trong (dạng decal/in UV)
    margin = 7.mm
    pts_inner = [
      [margin, margin, thickness + 0.01.mm],
      [width - margin, margin, thickness + 0.01.mm],
      [width - margin, height - margin, thickness + 0.01.mm],
      [margin, height - margin, thickness + 0.01.mm]
    ]
    face_inner = entities.add_face(pts_inner)
    face_inner.erase! if face_inner.normal.z < 0 # Xóa mặt trong nếu bị ngược
    # Vẽ 4 đoạn viền trắng
    for i in 0..3
      line = entities.add_line(pts_inner[i], pts_inner[(i+1)%4])
      line.material = color_white
      line.width = 2 # Chỉ hiển thị trong LayOut, không ảnh hưởng 3D
    end

    # 3. Tạo chữ "PHÒNG THUỐC" (dạng decal/in UV nổi trên mặt mica)
    text_group = entities.add_group
    text_entities = text_group.entities

    # Font chữ: Arial Black hoặc tương tự, in hoa, căn giữa
    text = "PHÒNG THUỐC"
    font = "Arial Black"
    text_height = 32.mm # Ước tính chiều cao chữ
    text_depth = 0.5.mm # Decal/in UV nổi nhẹ trên mặt mica

    # Tính toán vị trí căn giữa
    x_center = width / 2
    y_center = height / 2

    # Tạo chữ 3D (dạng decal nổi nhẹ)
    text3d = text_entities.add_3d_text(
      text,
      TextAlignCenter,
      text_height,
      false, # không nghiêng
      false, # không in đậm thêm
      font,
      true,  # filled
      text_depth
    )
    # Đặt chữ vào giữa bảng
    bounds = text3d.bounds
    text_width = bounds.width
    text_height_real = bounds.height
    # Di chuyển chữ vào giữa bảng
    tr = Geom::Transformation.new([
      x_center - text_width / 2,
      y_center - text_height_real / 2,
      thickness + 0.01.mm
    ])
    text_group.transform!(tr)
    text_group.material = color_white

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module ChuChanNhomKhongGo
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('ChuChanNhomKhongGo', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số chữ
    letter = "B"
    width = 1200.mm
    height = 400.mm
    depth = 60.mm
    face_color = "#FFFFFF" # Mica trắng
    side_color = "#B0BEC5" # Nhôm xước bạc

    # Tạo nhóm chữ nổi
    group = entities.add_group
    gents = group.entities

    # Vẽ mặt chữ bằng 3D Text
    text = gents.add_3d_text(
      letter,
      TextAlignLeft,
      "Arial Black",
      height,
      false, # không in nghiêng
      false, # không in đậm (Arial Black đã đậm)
      depth # Độ dày khối chữ
    )

    # Đặt vị trí chữ tại gốc toạ độ
    bounds = group.bounds
    min = bounds.min
    tr = Geom::Transformation.new([-min.x, -min.y, 0])
    group.transform!(tr)

    # Đặt màu mặt chữ (mặt trước)
    faces = []
    group.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face) { |f| faces << f if f.normal.z > 0.9 }
    faces.each { |f| f.material = face_color }

    # Đặt màu chân chữ (cạnh bên)
    group.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face) do |f|
      if (f.normal.z.abs < 0.1)
        f.material = side_color
      end
    end

    # Đặt tên nhóm
    group.name = "Chu chan nhom khong go"

    model.commit_operation
  end

module ChuChanNhomXuocCoGo

    depth = 60.mm
    margin = 40.mm

      [0, 0, 0],
      [width, 0, 0],
      [width, height, 0],
      [0, height, 0]
    )
    base_face.pushpull(-5.mm)
    base = base_face.all_connected
    base.each { |e| e.material = "#FFFFFF" }

    # Tạo các chữ nổi (ví dụ: "F", "O", "C")
    # Kích thước mỗi chữ: rộng ~200mm, cao ~250mm, sâu 60mm

    char_depth = 60.mm
    char_margin = 50.mm
    font = "Arial Black"
    bold = true
    italic = false

    # Vị trí các chữ (giả định 3 chữ: "F", "O", "C")
    chars = ["F", "O", "C"]
    x = margin
    y = (height - char_height) / 2

    chars.each do |ch|
      group = entities.add_group
      char_entities = group.entities
      text = char_entities.add_3d_text(
        ch,
        TextAlignLeft,
        char_height,
        char_depth,
        false,
        font,
        bold,
        italic
      )
      # Đặt vị trí chữ
      bounds = group.bounds
      group.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([x, y, 5.mm]))
      # Gán vật liệu vàng xước
      group.material = "#D4AF37"
      group.entities.each { |e| e.material = "#D4AF37" }
      # Tạo gờ nổi (viền quanh mặt chữ)
      # Gờ cao 2mm, rộng 5mm quanh mặt chữ
      face = nil
      group.entities.each { |e| face = e if e.is_a?(Sketchup::Face) }
      if face
        edges = face.outer_loop.edges
        offset_faces = face.offset(5.mm)
        if offset_faces
          offset_faces.each do |f|
            f.pushpull(2.mm)
            f.material = "#D4AF37"
          end
        end
      end
      # Cập nhật vị trí x cho chữ tiếp theo
      x += char_height + char_margin
    end

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

    # Xương ngang tăng cứng
    frame.add_face([0,height/2-frame_thickness/2,0], [width,height/2-frame_thickness/2,0], [width,height/2+frame_thickness/2,0], [0,height/2+frame_thickness/2,0]).pushpull(-frame_thickness)

    # --- Tấm nền alu xước bạc ---

      [0-border_thick,height+border_thick,frame_thickness+alu_thickness]

      [0,0,frame_thickness+alu_thickness],
      [width,0,frame_thickness+alu_thickness],
      [width,height,frame_thickness+alu_thickness],
      [0,height,frame_thickness+alu_thickness]

    # Viền chỉ đen

    mat_black.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#222222')
    always_group.entities.each do |e|
      e.material = mat_black if e.is_a?(Sketchup::Face) && e.normal.z.abs < 0.5
    end

    # Thành chữ inox vàng gương

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module ChuInox304ChanChaoLed
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('ChuInox304ChanChaoLed', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số cơ bản
    width = 1200.mm
    height = 400.mm
    depth_inox = 30.mm
    depth_mica = 10.mm
    depth_total = depth_inox + depth_mica

    # Màu sắc vật liệu
    inox_gold = Sketchup::Color.new("#D4AF37")
    mica_white = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFF8E1")
    led_glow = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFF8E1")
    bg_color = Sketchup::Color.new("#232323")

    # Tạo mặt phẳng nền giả lập (nếu muốn đặt chữ lên nền)
    bg_group = entities.add_group
    bg_face = bg_group.entities.add_face([0,0,0], [width,0,0], [width,height,0], [0,height,0])
    bg_face.pushpull(-5.mm)
    bg_group.material = bg_color
    bg_group.layer = "Nền"

    # Tạo chữ nổi 3D (ví dụ chữ "Ruby" dạng script)
    # Vị trí đặt chữ: căn giữa bảng
    text_main = "Ruby"
    font = "Pacifico" # hoặc font script gần giống
    text_height = 300.mm # chữ lớn, chiếm phần lớn chiều cao bảng
    text_depth = depth_inox

    # Tạo chữ inox nổi
    text_group = entities.add_group
    text_entities = text_group.entities
    # Chữ nổi inox (mặt + thành)
    text3d = text_entities.add_3d_text(
      text_main,
      TextAlignCenter,
      text_height,
      false, # không in đậm
      false, # không nghiêng
      font,
      true,  # extruded
      text_depth
    )
    # Căn giữa chữ trên bảng
    bounds = text_group.bounds
    dx = (width - bounds.width) / 2 - bounds.min.x
    dy = (height - bounds.height) / 2 - bounds.min.y
    dz = 10.mm # nổi lên khỏi nền
    text_group.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([dx, dy, dz + depth_mica]))
    text_group.material = inox_gold
    text_group.layer = "Chữ inox"

    # Tạo đế mica trắng sữa (hắt LED)
    # Đế mica là biên dạng chữ, dày 10mm, đặt dưới chữ inox
    # Dùng offset và pushpull để tạo đế mica
    # Lấy biên dạng đáy chữ
    text_faces = []
    text_group.entities.each do |e|
      if e.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)
        text_faces << e if (e.normal == [0,0,-1])
      end
    end
    # Tạo group đế mica
    mica_group = entities.add_group
    mica_entities = mica_group.entities
    text_faces.each do |face|
      # Copy biên dạng đáy chữ sang group mica
      new_face = mica_entities.add_face(face.vertices.map(&:position))
      new_face.pushpull(-depth_mica)
      new_face.material = mica_white
    end
    mica_group.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([dx, dy, dz]))
    mica_group.layer = "Đế mica"

    # Mô phỏng ánh sáng LED hắt chân (tạo viền phát sáng quanh đế mica)
    # Tạo outline lớn hơn biên dạng chữ 2mm, vật liệu màu vàng nhạt
    led_group = entities.add_group
    led_entities = led_group.entities
    text_faces.each do |face|
      # Offset biên dạng đáy chữ ra ngoài 2mm
      pts = face.vertices.map(&:position)
      # Đơn giản hóa: tạo hình chữ nhật phát sáng quanh chữ
      min = Geom::Point3d.new(pts.map(&:x).min-2.mm, pts.map(&:y).min-2.mm, dz-1.mm)
      max = Geom::Point3d.new(pts.map(&:x).max+2.mm, pts.map(&:y).max+2.mm, dz-1.mm)
      led_face = led_entities.add_face([min.x, min.y, min.z], [max.x, min.y, min.z], [max.x, max.y, min.z], [min.x, max.y, min.z])
      led_face.pushpull(-2.mm)
      led_face.material = led_glow
    end
    led_group.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([dx, dy, 0]))
    led_group.layer = "LED hắt chân"

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module ChuInoxHongLoGanDaLed
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('ChuInoxHongLoGanDaLed', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số chữ
    letter_height = 400.mm
    letter_depth = 60.mm
    letter_spacing = 40.mm
    face_thickness = 2.mm
    side_thickness = 1.mm

    # Vị trí bắt đầu
    x0 = 0
    y0 = 0
    z0 = 0

    # Dữ liệu từng chữ (tên, chiều rộng ước tính)
    letters = [
      {char: "D", width: 320.mm},
      {char: "I", width: 120.mm},
      {char: "C", width: 320.mm}
    ]

    # Màu sắc
    color_inox = "#FFD700" # Inox vàng gương
    color_led = "#FFB300"  # Ánh sáng LED vàng cam
    color_mica = "#FFD700" # Mặt mica vàng

    # Hàm tạo chữ nổi đơn giản hóa (hình hộp + bo góc cho D, C)
    def self.add_letter(entities, char, x, y, z, w, h, d, color_inox, color_led, color_mica)
      group = entities.add_group
      ents = group.entities

      # Tạo mặt chữ (mica vàng, gắn đá LED)
      face = nil
      case char
      when "D"
        # D là hình chữ nhật bo tròn 1 bên
        pts = [
          [x, y, z],
          [x + w - h/2, y, z],
          [x + w - h/2, y + h, z],
          [x, y + h, z]
        ]
        face = ents.add_face(pts)
        # Bo tròn bên phải
        center = [x + w - h/2, y + h/2, z]
        arc = ents.add_arc(center, [0,1,0], [1,0,0], h/2, 270.degrees, 90.degrees, 24)
        arc_pts = arc.map{|e| e.position}
        face.pushpull(face_thickness)
        # Tạo khối nổi
        face2 = ents.add_face(pts)
        face2.pushpull(-d)
        # Bo tròn bên phải cho khối nổi
        circle = ents.add_circle(center, [0,1,0], h/2, 24)
        face3 = ents.add_face(circle)
        face3.pushpull(-d)
      when "I"
        # I là hình chữ nhật đứng
        pts = [
          [x, y, z],
          [x + w, y, z],
          [x + w, y + h, z],
          [x, y + h, z]
        ]
        face = ents.add_face(pts)
        face.pushpull(face_thickness)
        face2 = ents.add_face(pts)
        face2.pushpull(-d)
      when "C"
        # C là hình tròn khuyết (hình vành khăn)
        center = [x + w/2, y + h/2, z]
        outer = ents.add_arc(center, [0,0,1], [1,0,0], h/2, 45.degrees, 315.degrees, 36)
        inner = ents.add_arc(center, [0,0,1], [1,0,0], h/2 - w/4, 45.degrees, 315.degrees, 36)
        pts = outer.map(&:position) + inner.map(&:position).reverse
        face = ents.add_face(pts)
        face.pushpull(face_thickness)
        face2 = ents.add_face(pts)
        face2.pushpull(-d)
      end

      # Tô màu mặt chữ (mica vàng)
      group.material = color_mica

      # Tạo hông chữ (inox vàng, đục lỗ LED)
      # Đơn giản hóa: tạo khối hộp quanh chữ, vẽ lỗ tròn đều trên mặt bên
      side_group = group.entities.add_group
      side_ents = side_group.entities
      # Hông chữ là khối hộp quanh mặt chữ
      side = side_ents.add_face([x, y, z - d], [x + w, y, z - d], [x + w, y + h, z - d], [x, y + h, z - d])
      side.pushpull(d)
      side_group.material = color_inox

      # Đục lỗ LED trên hông (vòng quanh cạnh, mỗi lỗ cách nhau 30mm, đường kính 8mm)
      hole_dia = 8.mm
      hole_spacing = 30.mm
      holes = []
      # Đục lỗ trên cạnh dài (trên/dưới)
      n_holes = (w / hole_spacing).to_i
      n_holes.times do |i|
        hx = x + i * hole_spacing + hole_spacing/2
        hy = y - 2.mm
        hz = z - d/2
        circle = side_ents.add_circle([hx, hy, hz], [0,1,0], hole_dia/2, 16)
        hole_face = side_ents.add_face(circle)
        hole_face.pushpull(-side_thickness*2)
      end
      n_holes = (h / hole_spacing).to_i
      n_holes.times do |i|
        hx = x - 2.mm
        hy = y + i * hole_spacing + hole_spacing/2
        hz = z - d/2
        circle = side_ents.add_circle([hx, hy, hz], [1,0,0], hole_dia/2, 16)
        hole_face = side_ents.add_face(circle)
        hole_face.pushpull(-side_thickness*2)
      end

      # Tô màu ánh sáng LED vàng cam cho mặt trong
      # (Đơn giản: tô mặt phía trong khối chữ)
      # Không mô phỏng đá LED chi tiết, chỉ tạo hiệu ứng màu
      # (Có thể dùng thêm vật liệu phát sáng nếu plugin hỗ trợ)

      # Tạo tai bắt (inox vàng, hình chữ nhật nhỏ ở cạnh dưới)
      tai_w = 20.mm
      tai_h = 8.mm
      tai_d = 2.mm
      tai_x = x + w/2 - tai_w/2
      tai_y = y - tai_h - 2.mm
      tai_z = z - d
      tai = ents.add_face([tai_x, tai_y, tai_z], [tai_x + tai_w, tai_y, tai_z], [tai_x + tai_w, tai_y + tai_h, tai_z], [tai_x, tai_y + tai_h, tai_z])
      tai.pushpull(tai_d)
      tai.material = color_inox

      group
    end

    # Dựng từng chữ
    x = x0
    letters.each do |l|
      add_letter(entities, l[:char], x, y0, z0, l[:width], letter_height, letter_depth, color_inox, color_led, color_mica)
      x += l[:width] + letter_spacing
    end

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module ChuInoxHongLoGanDaArylicLed
  extend self

  def hex_to_color(hex)
    hex = hex.delete('#')
    r = hex[0..1].to_i(16) / 255.0
    g = hex[2..3].to_i(16) / 255.0
    b = hex[4..5].to_i(16) / 255.0
    Sketchup::Color.new(r, g, b)
  end

  def build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('ChuInoxHongLoGanDaArylicLed', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số
    width = 1200.mm
    height = 400.mm
    depth = 60.mm
    khung_size = 25.mm

    # Màu sắc
    mau_nen = hex_to_color('#222222')
    mau_inox = hex_to_color('#FFD700')
    mau_led = hex_to_color('#FFB300')
    mau_logo = hex_to_color('#FFD700')

    # 1. Khung xương sắt hộp 25x25mm
    khung_group = entities.add_group
    khung = khung_group.entities

    # Khung viền ngoài
    pts = [
      [0, 0, 0],
      [width, 0, 0],
      [width, height, 0],
      [0, height, 0]
    ]
    # 4 cạnh ngoài
    khung.add_face(pts[0], pts[1], [pts[1][0], pts[1][1], khung_size], [pts[0][0], pts[0][1], khung_size]).pushpull(khung_size)
    khung.add_face(pts[1], pts[2], [pts[2][0], pts[2][1], khung_size], [pts[1][0], pts[1][1], khung_size]).pushpull(khung_size)
    khung.add_face(pts[2], pts[3], [pts[3][0], pts[3][1], khung_size], [pts[2][0], pts[2][1], khung_size]).pushpull(khung_size)
    khung.add_face(pts[3], pts[0], [pts[0][0], pts[0][1], khung_size], [pts[3][0], pts[3][1], khung_size]).pushpull(khung_size)

    # Xương đứng
    x1 = width / 3
    x2 = 2 * width / 3
    [x1, x2].each do |x|
      khung.add_face([x, 0, 0], [x + khung_size, 0, 0], [x + khung_size, height, 0], [x, height, 0]).pushpull(khung_size)
    end

    # Xương ngang tăng cứng
    y1 = height / 2
    khung.add_face([0, y1, 0], [width, y1, 0], [width, y1 + khung_size, 0], [0, y1 + khung_size, 0]).pushpull(khung_size)

    # Tai treo tường (2 bên trên)
    2.times do |i|
      x = i == 0 ? 0 : width - khung_size
      khung.add_face([x, height, 0], [x + khung_size, height, 0], [x + khung_size, height + 30.mm, 0], [x, height + 30.mm, 0]).pushpull(khung_size)
    end

    # 2. Tấm nền alu (giả định)
    nen_group = entities.add_group
    nen = nen_group.entities
    nen_face = nen.add_face([0, 0, khung_size], [width, 0, khung_size], [width, height, khung_size], [0, height, khung_size])
    nen_face.pushpull(3.mm)
    nen_face.material = mau_nen

    # 3. Viền nẹp alu/inox vàng
    nep_group = entities.add_group
    nep = nep_group.entities
    nep_width = 10.mm
    nep_face = nep.add_face([-nep_width, -nep_width, khung_size], [width+nep_width, -nep_width, khung_size], [width+nep_width, height+nep_width, khung_size], [-nep_width, height+nep_width, khung_size])
    hole = nep.add_face([0, 0, khung_size], [width, 0, khung_size], [width, height, khung_size], [0, height, khung_size])
    nep_face.followme(nep.add_circle([0,0,khung_size], [0,0,1], nep_width, 24))
    nep_face.material = mau_inox

    # 4. Chữ nổi "ĐÈN NHẬN"
    text_group = entities.add_group
    text = text_group.entities

    # Vị trí căn giữa bảng
    font_height = 200.mm
    font_depth = depth
    font = "Arial Black"
    text_main = "ĐÈN NHẬN"
    text_width = 0
    temp = text.add_3d_text(text_main, TextAlignCenter, font_height, font_depth, false, true, font)
    bounds = temp.bounds
    text_width = bounds.width
    x0 = (width - text_width) / 2
    y0 = (height - font_height) / 2

    # Xóa temp, tạo lại chữ từng ký tự để mô phỏng hông lỗ và mặt đá
    temp.erase!

    offset_x = x0
    text_main.each_char do |ch|
      next if ch == " "
      char_group = text.add_group
      char = char_group.entities
      char_3d = char.add_3d_text(ch, TextAlignLeft, font_height, font_depth, false, true, font)
      # Di chuyển ký tự về đúng vị trí
      char_group.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([offset_x, y0, khung_size+3.mm]))
      # Mặt đá acrylic vàng
      char_3d.material = mau_led
      # Hông inox vàng lỗ (mô phỏng bằng vật liệu vàng, không tạo lỗ thực)
      char_3d.back_material = mau_inox
      # Tăng offset_x cho ký tự tiếp theo
      offset_x += char_3d.bounds.width * 1.05
    end

    # 5. Logo đầu sư tử (mô phỏng khối tròn vàng nổi)
    logo_group = entities.add_group
    logo = logo_group.entities
    logo_center = [x0 - 60.mm, y0 + font_height/2, khung_size+3.mm+font_depth/2]
    logo.add_circle(logo_center, [0,0,1], 50.mm, 32)
    logo_face = logo.add_face(logo_center, [logo_center[0]+50.mm, logo_center[1], logo_center[2]], [logo_center[0], logo_center[1]+50.mm, logo_center[2]])
    logo_face.pushpull(20.mm)
    logo_face.material = mau_logo

    # 6. LED mô phỏng (các khối tròn nhỏ vàng trên mặt chữ)
    led_group = entities.add_group
    led = led_group.entities
    led_radius = 5.mm
    led_z = khung_size+3.mm+font_depth+5.mm
    (0..7).each do |i|
      led.add_circle([x0 + i*120.mm, y0 + font_height/2, led_z], [0,0,1], led_radius, 16)
      led_face = led.add_face([x0 + i*120.mm, y0 + font_height/2, led_z], [x0 + i*120.mm + led_radius, y0 + font_height/2, led_z], [x0 + i*120.mm, y0 + font_height/2 + led_radius, led_z])
      led_face.pushpull(5.mm)
      led_face.material = mau_led
    end

    model.commit_operation
  end

module ChuInoxVangGuong304
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('ChuInoxVangGuong304', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Kích thước tổng thể
    width = 1200.mm
    height = 400.mm
    thickness = 8.mm # Tấm nền alu/kính

    # Tạo khung xương sắt hộp 25x25mm
    frame_thick = 25.mm
    frame_group = entities.add_group
    frame = frame_group.entities

    # Khung viền ngoài
    frame.add_face([0,0,0], [width,0,0], [width,height,0], [0,height,0]).pushpull(-frame_thick)
    # Xương đứng (cách nhau ~500mm)
    frame.add_face([width/2-frame_thick/2,0,0], [width/2+frame_thick/2,0,0], [width/2+frame_thick/2,height,0], [width/2-frame_thick/2,height,0]).pushpull(-frame_thick)
    # Xương ngang tăng cứng
    frame.add_face([0,height/2-frame_thick/2,0], [width,height/2-frame_thick/2,0], [width,height/2+frame_thick/2,0], [0,height/2+frame_thick/2,0]).pushpull(-frame_thick)

    # Tạo tấm nền alu/kính
    base_group = entities.add_group
    base = base_group.entities
    base_face = base.add_face([0,0,frame_thick], [width,0,frame_thick], [width,height,frame_thick], [0,height,frame_thick])
    base_face.pushpull(thickness)
    # Gán màu nền trắng ngà
    mat_base = model.materials.add('AluWhite')
    mat_base.color = '#F8F8F8'
    base_group.material = mat_base

    # Viền nẹp alu (vát cạnh 5mm)
    border_group = entities.add_group
    border = border_group.entities
    border_width = 5.mm
    # Viền trên
    border.add_face([0,0,frame_thick+thickness], [width,0,frame_thick+thickness], [width,border_width,frame_thick+thickness], [0,border_width,frame_thick+thickness]).pushpull(border_width)
    # Viền dưới
    border.add_face([0,height-border_width,frame_thick+thickness], [width,height-border_width,frame_thick+thickness], [width,height,frame_thick+thickness], [0,height,frame_thick+thickness]).pushpull(border_width)
    # Viền trái
    border.add_face([0,border_width,frame_thick+thickness], [border_width,border_width,frame_thick+thickness], [border_width,height-border_width,frame_thick+thickness], [0,height-border_width,frame_thick+thickness]).pushpull(border_width)
    # Viền phải
    border.add_face([width-border_width,border_width,frame_thick+thickness], [width,border_width,frame_thick+thickness], [width,height-border_width,frame_thick+thickness], [width-border_width,height-border_width,frame_thick+thickness]).pushpull(border_width)
    # Gán màu viền alu trắng
    mat_border = model.materials.add('AluBorder')
    mat_border.color = '#F8F8F8'
    border_group.material = mat_border

    # Tạo chữ nổi inox vàng gương 304
    # Thông số chữ lớn: "DOANH TRÍ" (cao 120mm, dày 60mm)
    text_main = "DOANH TRÍ"
    text_main_group = entities.add_group
    text_main_entities = text_main_group.entities
    text_main_height = 120.mm
    text_main_depth = 60.mm
    text_main_font = "Arial Black"
    text_main_pos = [100.mm, 200.mm, frame_thick+thickness+1.mm]
    text_main_entities.add_3d_text(
      text_main,
      TextAlignLeft,
      text_main_height,
      false,
      false,
      text_main_font,
      true,
      text_main_depth
    ).move!(text_main_pos)
    # Gán màu inox vàng gương
    mat_inox = model.materials.add('InoxGold')
    mat_inox.color = '#FFD700'
    text_main_group.material = mat_inox

    # Chữ phụ trên: "TOÀN" (cao 60mm, dày 30mm)
    text_top = "TOÀN"
    text_top_group = entities.add_group
    text_top_entities = text_top_group.entities
    text_top_height = 60.mm
    text_top_depth = 30.mm
    text_top_font = "Arial Black"
    text_top_pos = [100.mm, 320.mm, frame_thick+thickness+1.mm]
    text_top_entities.add_3d_text(
      text_top,
      TextAlignLeft,
      text_top_height,
      false,
      false,
      text_top_font,
      true,
      text_top_depth
    ).move!(text_top_pos)
    text_top_group.material = mat_inox

    # Chữ phụ dưới: "TRANG SỨC THUỐC" (cao 40mm, dày 20mm)
    text_bot = "TRANG SỨC THUỐC"
    text_bot_group = entities.add_group
    text_bot_entities = text_bot_group.entities
    text_bot_height = 40.mm
    text_bot_depth = 20.mm
    text_bot_font = "Arial"
    text_bot_pos = [100.mm, 80.mm, frame_thick+thickness+1.mm]
    text_bot_entities.add_3d_text(
      text_bot,
      TextAlignLeft,
      text_bot_height,
      false,
      false,
      text_bot_font,
      true,
      text_bot_depth
    ).move!(text_bot_pos)
    text_bot_group.material = mat_inox

    # Kết thúc thao tác
    model.commit_operation
  end
end

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module ChuMicaSangHatChan
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('ChuMicaSangHatChan', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số kích thước
    width = 1200.mm
    height = 400.mm
    depth = 60.mm
    frame_thickness = 25.mm
    alu_thickness = 3.mm
    border_width = 10.mm
    border_height = depth
    text_thickness = 30.mm
    led_glow_offset = 5.mm

    # Màu sắc
    color_alu = Sketchup::Color.new("#F5F5F5")
    color_frame = Sketchup::Color.new("#222222")
    color_border = Sketchup::Color.new("#E0E0E0")
    color_text = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFFFFF")
    color_text_edge = Sketchup::Color.new("#222222")
    color_led = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFD700")

    # 1. Khung xương sắt hộp 25x25mm
    frame_group = entities.add_group
    frame = frame_group.entities
    # Viền ngoài
    [
      [0,0,0], [width,0,0], [width,height,0], [0,height,0]
    ].each_with_index do |pt, i|
      next_pt = [
        [width,0,0], [width,height,0], [0,height,0], [0,0,0]
      ][i]
      frame.add_face(pt, [pt[0]+frame_thickness, pt[1], pt[2]], [next_pt[0]+frame_thickness, next_pt[1], next_pt[2]], next_pt)
      edge = frame.add_line(pt, next_pt)
      edge.find_faces
    end
    # Xương đứng tăng cứng
    frame.add_face([width/2-frame_thickness/2,0,0], [width/2+frame_thickness/2,0,0], [width/2+frame_thickness/2,height,0], [width/2-frame_thickness/2,height,0])
    # Xương ngang tăng cứng
    frame.add_face([0,height/2-frame_thickness/2,0], [width,height/2-frame_thickness/2,0], [width,height/2+frame_thickness/2,0], [0,height/2+frame_thickness/2,0])
    frame_group.material = color_frame

    # 2. Tấm nền alu composite
    alu_group = entities.add_group
    alu_face = alu_group.entities.add_face(
      [frame_thickness, frame_thickness, alu_thickness],
      [width-frame_thickness, frame_thickness, alu_thickness],
      [width-frame_thickness, height-frame_thickness, alu_thickness],
      [frame_thickness, height-frame_thickness, alu_thickness]
    )
    alu_face.pushpull(-alu_thickness)
    alu_group.material = color_alu

    # 3. Viền nẹp alu/nhôm
    border_group = entities.add_group
    # 4 cạnh viền
    [
      [[0,0,0],[width,0,0]],
      [[width,0,0],[width,height,0]],
      [[width,height,0],[0,height,0]],
      [[0,height,0],[0,0,0]]
    ].each do |start_pt, end_pt|
      edge = border_group.entities.add_line(start_pt, end_pt)
      face = border_group.entities.add_face(
        start_pt,
        [start_pt[0], start_pt[1], border_height],
        [end_pt[0], end_pt[1], border_height],
        end_pt
      )
      face.pushpull(border_width)
    end
    border_group.material = color_border

    # 4. Chữ nổi 3D "Highcut Vintage"
    text_group = entities.add_group
    text_string = "Highcut Vintage"
    text_height = 120.mm
    text_pos_x = width/2 - 300.mm
    text_pos_y = height/2 - 60.mm
    text_pos_z = alu_thickness + 2.mm

    text = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      text_string,
      TextAlignCenter,
      text_height,
      false,
      true,
      text_thickness
    )
    # Di chuyển chữ vào vị trí giữa biển
    tr = Geom::Transformation.new([text_pos_x, text_pos_y, text_pos_z])
    text_group.transform!(tr)
    text_group.material = color_text
    text_group.entities.each do |e|
      if e.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)
        e.material = color_text
        e.back_material = color_text
      end
    end

    # 5. Viền chữ (edge) màu đen
    text_group.entities.each do |e|
      if e.is_a?(Sketchup::Edge)
        e.material = color_text_edge
      end
    end

    # 6. LED hắt chân (mô phỏng ánh sáng vàng dưới chân chữ)
    led_group = entities.add_group
    led_face = led_group.entities.add_face(
      [text_pos_x, text_pos_y, alu_thickness],
      [text_pos_x+600.mm, text_pos_y, alu_thickness],
      [text_pos_x+600.mm, text_pos_y+120.mm, alu_thickness],
      [text_pos_x, text_pos_y+120.mm, alu_thickness]
    )
    led_face.pushpull(-led_glow_offset)
    led_group.material = color_led
    led_group.material.alpha = 0.3

    model.commit_operation
  end
end
