module ChuMicaSangMatChanDungDon
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('ChuMicaSangMatChanDungDon', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số
    width = 1200.mm
    height = 400.mm
    depth = 60.mm
    base_thickness = 5.mm
    frame_size = 30.mm
    frame_offset = 10.mm

    # Màu sắc
    color_nen = "#222222"
    color_vien = "#444444"
    color_chu_vang = "#ffe600"
    color_chu_trang = "#ffffff"
    color_hong_chu = "#222222"

    # 1. Khung xương sắt hộp
    frame_group = entities.add_group
    frame = frame_group.entities

    # Khung viền ngoài
    pts = [
      [0, 0, 0],
      [width, 0, 0],
      [width, height, 0],
      [0, height, 0]
    ]
    frame.add_face(pts).pushpull(-frame_size)
    # Xương đứng (2 xương giữa)
    x1 = width / 3
    x2 = 2 * width / 3
    [x1, x2].each do |x|
      frame.add_face(
        [x, 0, -frame_size],
        [x + frame_size, 0, -frame_size],
        [x + frame_size, height, -frame_size],
        [x, height, -frame_size]
      ).pushpull(-frame_size)
    end
    # Xương ngang tăng cứng (1 thanh giữa)
    y = height / 2 - frame_size / 2
    frame.add_face(
      [0, y, -frame_size],
      [width, y, -frame_size],
      [width, y + frame_size, -frame_size],
      [0, y + frame_size, -frame_size]
    ).pushpull(-frame_size)

    # 2. Tấm nền alu/gỗ phủ đen
    nen_group = entities.add_group
    nen = nen_group.entities
    nen_face = nen.add_face(
      [frame_offset, frame_offset, 0],
      [width - frame_offset, frame_offset, 0],
      [width - frame_offset, height - frame_offset, 0],
      [frame_offset, height - frame_offset, 0]
    )
    nen_face.pushpull(base_thickness)
    nen_group.material = color_nen

    # 3. Viền nẹp alu/nhôm xước
    vien_group = entities.add_group
    vien = vien_group.entities
    vien_width = 20.mm
    # Viền trên
    vien.add_face(
      [0, 0, base_thickness],
      [width, 0, base_thickness],
      [width, vien_width, base_thickness],
      [0, vien_width, base_thickness]
    ).pushpull(vien_width)
    # Viền dưới
    vien.add_face(
      [0, height - vien_width, base_thickness],
      [width, height - vien_width, base_thickness],
      [width, height, base_thickness],
      [0, height, base_thickness]
    ).pushpull(vien_width)
    # Viền trái
    vien.add_face(
      [0, 0, base_thickness],
      [vien_width, 0, base_thickness],
      [vien_width, height, base_thickness],
      [0, height, base_thickness]
    ).pushpull(vien_width)
    # Viền phải
    vien.add_face(
      [width - vien_width, 0, base_thickness],
      [width, 0, base_thickness],
      [width, height, base_thickness],
      [width - vien_width, height, base_thickness]
    ).pushpull(vien_width)
    vien_group.material = color_vien

    # 4. Chữ nổi 3D dòng trên: "NHÀ KHẾ"
    chu1_group = entities.add_group
    chu1_text = "NHÀ KHẾ"
    chu1_height = 170.mm
    chu1_depth = 60.mm
    chu1_x = 80.mm
    chu1_y = height - chu1_height - 40.mm
    chu1_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      chu1_text,
      TextAlignLeft = true,
      Font = "Arial Black",
      Bold = true,
      Italic = false,
      Height = chu1_height,
      Tolerance = 0.0,
      Z = base_thickness,
      Filled = true,
      Extruded = chu1_depth
    ).each { |e| e.material = color_chu_vang }
    chu1_group.move! Geom::Transformation.translation([chu1_x, chu1_y, base_thickness])

    # 5. Chữ nổi 3D dòng dưới: "BÒ NẤM NƯỚNG SỐT"
    chu2_group = entities.add_group
    chu2_text = "BÒ NẤM NƯỚNG SỐT"
    chu2_height = 80.mm
    chu2_depth = 25.mm
    chu2_x = 70.mm
    chu2_y = 40.mm
    chu2_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      chu2_text,
      TextAlignLeft = true,
      Font = "Arial Black",
      Bold = true,
      Italic = false,
      Height = chu2_height,
      Tolerance = 0.0,
      Z = base_thickness,
      Filled = true,
      Extruded = chu2_depth
    ).each { |e| e.material = color_chu_trang }
    chu2_group.move! Geom::Transformation.translation([chu2_x, chu2_y, base_thickness])

    # 6. Hông chữ (mô phỏng viền đen/inox)
    # Đơn giản hóa: Tô màu mặt bên chữ bằng màu hông
    chu1_group.entities.each { |e| e.back_material = color_hong_chu if e.respond_to?(:back_material) }
    chu2_group.entities.each { |e| e.back_material = color_hong_chu if e.respond_to?(:back_material) }

    # 7. Chân đế (giả lập bệ thấp phía dưới)
    chan_group = entities.add_group
    chan_height = 40.mm
    chan_group.entities.add_face(
      [0, -chan_height, 0],
      [width, -chan_height, 0],
      [width, 0, 0],
      [0, 0, 0]
    ).pushpull(60.mm)
    chan_group.material = "#8d735b"

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module ChuMicaUonNoiFomDenLed
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('ChuMicaUonNoiFomDenLed', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số tổng thể
    width = 1200.mm
    height = 400.mm
    depth = 60.mm

    # Tạo nhóm chữ nổi
    group = entities.add_group
    gents = group.entities

    # Tạo mặt chữ "B"
    b_face = gents.add_3d_text(
      "B",
      TextAlignLeft,
      "Arial Black",
      false, # Bold
      false, # Italic
      350.mm, # Chiều cao chữ
      0, # Độ nghiêng
      true, # Filled
      0
    )
    b_group = gents.add_group(b_face)
    b_group.move! Geom::Transformation.new([100.mm, 25.mm, 0])
    # Đẩy nổi chữ "B"
    b_group.entities.each do |e|
      if e.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)
        e.pushpull(depth)
      end
    end

    # Tạo mặt chữ "L"
    l_face = gents.add_3d_text(
      "L",
      TextAlignLeft,
      "Arial Black",
      false,
      false,
      350.mm,
      0,
      true,
      0
    )
    l_group = gents.add_group(l_face)
    l_group.move! Geom::Transformation.new([600.mm, 25.mm, 0])
    # Đẩy nổi chữ "L"
    l_group.entities.each do |e|
      if e.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)
        e.pushpull(depth)
      end
    end

    # Tô màu mặt chữ (mica xanh lá)
    green = model.materials.add('MicaGreen')
    green.color = '#39FF14'
    [b_group, l_group].each do |letter_group|
      letter_group.entities.each do |e|
        if e.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)
          # Mặt trên cùng
          if e.normal.z > 0.9
            e.material = green
          end
        end
      end
    end

    # Tô màu thành chữ (xám đậm)
    gray = model.materials.add('MicaGray')
    gray.color = '#3A3A3A'
    [b_group, l_group].each do |letter_group|
      letter_group.entities.each do |e|
        if e.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)
          # Thành bên
          if e.normal.z.abs < 0.1
            e.material = gray
          end
        end
      end
    end

    # Mô phỏng đèn LED (tạo khối mỏng bên trong chữ)
    led_mat = model.materials.add('LEDGlow')
    led_mat.color = '#BFFF00'
    led_mat.alpha = 0.4
    [b_group, l_group].each do |letter_group|
      letter_group.entities.each do |e|
        if e.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)
          # Mặt trên cùng
          if e.normal.z > 0.9
            led_face = e
            led = gents.add_face(led_face.vertices.map(&:position))
            led.pushpull(-5.mm)
            led.material = led_mat
          end
        end
      end
    end

    # Đặt nhóm chữ vào vị trí giữa bảng (nếu cần)
    group.move! Geom::Transformation.new([0, 0, 0])

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module ChuNoiAluDanTuong
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('ChuNoiAluDanTuong', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Kích thước tổng thể
    width = 1200.mm
    height = 400.mm
    depth = 60.mm

    # Tạo nền tường (giả bê tông)
    wall_face = entities.add_face([0,0,0], [width,0,0], [width,height,0], [0,height,0])
    wall_face.pushpull(-20.mm)
    wall_material = model.materials.add('WallConcrete')
    wall_material.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#888888')
    wall_face.material = wall_material
    wall_face.back_material = wall_material

    # Khung xương sắt hộp 25x25mm (ẩn phía sau)
    frame_group = entities.add_group
    frame = frame_group.entities
    box = 25.mm
    # Viền ngoài
    frame.add_face([0,0,-25.mm], [width,0,-25.mm], [width,box,-25.mm], [0,box,-25.mm]).pushpull(height-box)
    frame.add_face([0,height-box,-25.mm], [width,height-box,-25.mm], [width,height,-25.mm], [0,height,-25.mm]).pushpull(box)
    frame.add_face([0,0,-25.mm], [box,0,-25.mm], [box,height,-25.mm], [0,height,-25.mm]).pushpull(box)
    frame.add_face([width-box,0,-25.mm], [width,0,-25.mm], [width,height,-25.mm], [width-box,height,-25.mm]).pushpull(box)
    # Xương đứng
    (1..1).each do |i|
      x = i * width/2
      frame.add_face([x,0,-25.mm], [x+box,0,-25.mm], [x+box,height,-25.mm], [x,height,-25.mm]).pushpull(box)
    end
    # Xương ngang
    (1..1).each do |i|
      y = i * height/2
      frame.add_face([0,y,-25.mm], [width,y,-25.mm], [width,y+box,-25.mm], [0,y+box,-25.mm]).pushpull(box)
    end

    # Chữ nổi lớn "THẢO"
    text_group = entities.add_group
    text_entities = text_group.entities
    text1 = "THẢO"
    text1_material = model.materials.add('Text1Orange')
    text1_material.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#FF4B1F')
    text1_3d = text_entities.add_3d_text(
      text1,
      TextAlignLeft,
      "Arial Black",
      false, false,
      180.mm, # chiều cao chữ
      30.mm,  # độ dày nổi
      0,      # độ nghiêng
      true,   # filled
      false   # extruded
    )
    text1_3d.material = text1_material
    text1_3d.transformation = Geom::Transformation.new([80.mm, 200.mm, 20.mm])

    # Chữ nổi lớn "MIN"
    text2 = "MIN"
    text2_material = model.materials.add('Text2Black')
    text2_material.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#222222')
    text2_3d = text_entities.add_3d_text(
      text2,
      TextAlignLeft,
      "Arial Black",
      false, false,
      180.mm,
      30.mm,
      0,
      true,
      false
    )
    text2_3d.material = text2_material
    text2_3d.transformation = Geom::Transformation.new([420.mm, 200.mm, 20.mm])

    # Chữ phụ "StepHi - BodyFit"
    text3 = "StepHi - BodyFit"
    text3_material = model.materials.add('Text3Black')
    text3_material.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#222222')
    text3_3d = text_entities.add_3d_text(
      text3,
      TextAlignLeft,
      "Arial",
      false, false,
      60.mm,
      15.mm,
      0,
      true,
      false
    )
    text3_3d.material = text3_material
    text3_3d.transformation = Geom::Transformation.new([100.mm, 80.mm, 20.mm])

    # Gạch cam dưới chữ phụ
    underline_group = entities.add_group
    underline = underline_group.entities
    underline_face = underline.add_face([80.mm, 70.mm, 20.mm], [220.mm, 70.mm, 20.mm], [220.mm, 85.mm, 20.mm], [80.mm, 85.mm, 20.mm])
    underline_face.pushpull(8.mm)
    underline_material = model.materials.add('UnderlineOrange')
    underline_material.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#FF4B1F')
    underline_face.material = underline_material

    # Đèn LED mũi tên hai bên (mô phỏng bằng khối hộp vàng)
    led_group = entities.add_group
    led = led_group.entities
    led_material = model.materials.add('LEDYellow')
    led_material.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#FFD700')
    # Bên trái
    led.add_face([20.mm, 350.mm, 10.mm], [60.mm, 390.mm, 10.mm], [70.mm, 380.mm, 10.mm], [30.mm, 340.mm, 10.mm]).pushpull(5.mm)
    led.add_face([60.mm, 390.mm, 10.mm], [120.mm, 330.mm, 10.mm], [130.mm, 340.mm, 10.mm], [70.mm, 380.mm, 10.mm]).pushpull(5.mm)
    # Bên phải
    led.add_face([width-20.mm, 350.mm, 10.mm], [width-60.mm, 390.mm, 10.mm], [width-70.mm, 380.mm, 10.mm], [width-30.mm, 340.mm, 10.mm]).pushpull(5.mm)
    led.add_face([width-60.mm, 390.mm, 10.mm], [width-120.mm, 330.mm, 10.mm], [width-130.mm, 340.mm, 10.mm], [width-70.mm, 380.mm, 10.mm]).pushpull(5.mm)
    led_group.material = led_material

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

    model.commit_operation
  end

module ChuNoiDanTuong

    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số tổng thể
    width = 1200.mm
    height = 400.mm
    wall_thickness = 20.mm

    # Tạo mặt tường (dùng làm nền tham chiếu, không phải tấm alu)
    wall_face = entities.add_face([0,0,0], [width,0,0], [width,height,0], [0,height,0])
    wall_face.pushpull(-wall_thickness)
    wall_face.material = "#F8F8F8"

    # Vị trí logo (ở giữa trên cùng)
    logo_width = 180.mm
    logo_height = 90.mm
    logo_thickness = 5.mm
    logo_x = (width - logo_width) / 2
    logo_y = height - logo_height - 30.mm
    logo_z = wall_thickness + 1.mm

    logo_group = entities.add_group
    logo_face = logo_group.entities.add_face(
      [logo_x, logo_y, logo_z],
      [logo_x + logo_width, logo_y, logo_z],
      [logo_x + logo_width, logo_y + logo_height, logo_z],
      [logo_x, logo_y + logo_height, logo_z]
    )
    logo_face.pushpull(logo_thickness)
    logo_face.material = "#FFFFFF"
    # Viền logo
    logo_edges = logo_group.entities.add_circle(
      [logo_x + logo_width/2, logo_y + logo_height/2, logo_z + logo_thickness/2],
      [0,0,1],
      logo_height/2 + 5.mm,
      48
    )
    logo_circle = logo_group.entities.add_face(logo_edges)
    logo_circle.material = "#8EC6E6"
    logo_circle.pushpull(1.mm)
    # Dải ruy băng đỏ (mô phỏng)
    ribbon_w = 90.mm
    ribbon_h = 15.mm
    ribbon_x = logo_x + (logo_width - ribbon_w)/2
    ribbon_y = logo_y + logo_height/2 + 20.mm
    ribbon_face = logo_group.entities.add_face(
      [ribbon_x, ribbon_y, logo_z + logo_thickness + 0.5.mm],
      [ribbon_x + ribbon_w, ribbon_y, logo_z + logo_thickness + 0.5.mm],
      [ribbon_x + ribbon_w, ribbon_y + ribbon_h, logo_z + logo_thickness + 0.5.mm],
      [ribbon_x, ribbon_y + ribbon_h, logo_z + logo_thickness + 0.5.mm]
    )
    ribbon_face.material = "#D94F8A"
    ribbon_face.pushpull(1.5.mm)

    # Chữ "Trường Mầm Non" (dòng trên, nhỏ)
    text1 = "Trường Mầm Non"
    text1_height = 60.mm
    text1_depth = 15.mm
    text1_x = (width - 400.mm) / 2
    text1_y = logo_y - 55.mm
    text1_z = wall_thickness + 2.mm
    text1_group = entities.add_group
    text1_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      text1,
      TextAlignCenter,
      text1_height,
      false,
      text1_depth,
      "Arial Rounded MT Bold"
    )
    text1_group.material = "#D94F8A"
    text1_group.move! Geom::Transformation.translation(
      [width/2, text1_y, text1_z]
    )

    # Chữ "Hoa Baby" (dòng dưới, lớn)
    text2 = "Hoa Baby"
    text2_height = 110.mm
    text2_depth = 25.mm
    text2_x = (width - 600.mm) / 2
    text2_y = text1_y - 110.mm
    text2_z = wall_thickness + 2.mm
    text2_group = entities.add_group
    text2_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      text2,
      TextAlignCenter,
      text2_height,
      false,
      text2_depth,
      "Arial Rounded MT Bold"

  def self.build

    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số chính
    width = 1200.mm
    height = 400.mm
    depth = 60.mm
    khung_satt = 30.mm
    go_day = 20.mm

    # 1. Khung xương sắt hộp 30x30mm
    khung_group = entities.add_group
    khung = khung_group.entities

    # Khung viền ngoài
    pts = [
      [0, 0, 0],
      [width, 0, 0],
      [width, height, 0],
      [0, height, 0]
    ]
    # 4 cạnh khung
    khung.add_face(pts[0], pts[1], [pts[1][0], pts[1][1], khung_satt], [pts[0][0], pts[0][1], khung_satt])
    khung.add_face(pts[1], pts[2], [pts[2][0], pts[2][1], khung_satt], [pts[1][0], pts[1][1], khung_satt])
    khung.add_face(pts[2], pts[3], [pts[3][0], pts[3][1], khung_satt], [pts[2][0], pts[2][1], khung_satt])
    khung.add_face(pts[3], pts[0], [pts[0][0], pts[0][1], khung_satt], [pts[3][0], pts[3][1], khung_satt])

    # Xương đứng (2 xương chia đều)
    1.upto(2) do |i|
      x = i * width / 3
      khung.add_face([x, 0, 0], [x, 0, khung_satt], [x, height, khung_satt], [x, height, 0])
    end

    # Xương ngang tăng cứng (1 xương giữa)
    y = height / 2
    khung.add_face([0, y, 0], [0, y, khung_satt], [width, y, khung_satt], [width, y, 0])

    # Chân đế (2 chân)
    chan_group = entities.add_group
    chan = chan_group.entities
    chan_length = 100.mm
    [[0, 0, 0], [width - khung_satt, 0, 0]].each do |pt|
      base = chan.add_face(pt, [pt[0]+khung_satt, pt[1], pt[2]], [pt[0]+khung_satt, pt[1]-chan_length, pt[2]], [pt[0], pt[1]-chan_length, pt[2]])
      base.pushpull khung_satt
    end

    # 2. Tấm nền gỗ dựng đứng

    nen = nen_group.entities
    so_thanh = (width / 50.mm).to_i

      thanh.pushpull(depth - khung_satt)
      thanh.material = mau_go
    end

    # 3. Chữ nổi "BBB"

    chu = chu_group.entities
    chu_text = "B"
    mau_chu = "#B87333"
    mau_vien = "#8B5C2B"
    mau_led = "#FFD700"
    font = "Arial Black"
    chu_rong = 300.mm
    chu_cao = 350.mm
    chu_day = 60.mm
    khoang_cach = 40.mm

    3.times do |i|
      x = 70.mm + i*(chu_rong + khoang_cach)
      y = (height - chu_cao)/2
      chu3d = chu.add_3d_text(
        chu_text,
        TextAlignLeft,
        chu_cao,
        true,
        chu_day,
        font,
        false,
        false
      )
      chu3d_group = chu.add_group(chu3d)
      chu3d_group.material = mau_chu
      chu3d_group.entities.each { |e| e.back_material = mau_vien }
      chu3d_group.move!([x, y, depth])
      # Đèn LED bulb trên mặt chữ
      # Vẽ 7 bóng LED cho mỗi chữ
      led_group = chu3d_group.entities.add_group
      led_radius = 20.mm
      led_z = chu_day + depth + 2.mm
      led_pos = [
        [chu_cao*0.2, chu_cao*0.8],
        [chu_cao*0.5, chu_cao*0.85],
        [chu_cao*0.8, chu_cao*0.8],
        [chu_cao*0.2, chu_cao*0.5],
        [chu_cao*0.5, chu_cao*0.5],
        [chu_cao*0.8, chu_cao*0.5],
        [chu_cao*0.5, chu_cao*0.2]
      ]
      led_pos.each do |lx, ly|
        led = led_group.entities.add_circle([lx, ly, led_z], [0,0,1], led_radius, 24)
        led_face = led_group.entities.add_face(led)
        led_face.pushpull(8.mm)
        led_face.material = mau_led
      end
    end

    # Đặt nhóm chữ lên nền
    chu_group.move!([0, 0, khung_satt + go_day])

    model.commit_operation
  end

module HopDenChibi2Mat60X140
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model

    entities = model.active_entities

    # Kích thước tổng thể
    width = 600.mm
    height = 1400.mm
    depth = 30.mm
    base_height = 100.mm
    base_width = 500.mm
    base_depth = 500.mm
    frame_size = 30.mm

    # === 1. Khung chân đế sắt hộp ===
    base_group = entities.add_group
    base = base_group.entities

    # Khung vuông dưới chân
    base.add_face([0,0,0], [base_width,0,0], [base_width,base_depth,0], [0,base_depth,0]).pushpull(frame_size)
    # 2 xương đứng
    x1 = base_width*0.3
    x2 = base_width*0.7
    y = base_depth*0.5
    base.add_face([x1, y, frame_size], [x1+frame_size, y, frame_size], [x1+frame_size, y, base_height+height*0.7], [x1, y, base_height+height*0.7]).pushpull(frame_size)
    base.add_face([x2, y, frame_size], [x2+frame_size, y, frame_size], [x2+frame_size, y, base_height+height*0.7], [x2, y, base_height+height*0.7]).pushpull(frame_size)
    # Thanh giằng ngang
    base.add_face([x1, y, base_height+height*0.4], [x2+frame_size, y, base_height+height*0.4], [x2+frame_size, y, base_height+height*0.4+frame_size], [x1, y, base_height+height*0.4+frame_size]).pushpull(frame_size)
    # 2 thanh chống xiên
    base.add_face([x1, y, frame_size], [x1+frame_size, y, frame_size], [0,0,frame_size], [0,0,frame_size+frame_size]).pushpull(frame_size/2)
    base.add_face([x2, y, frame_size], [x2+frame_size, y, frame_size], [base_width,0,frame_size], [base_width,0,frame_size+frame_size]).pushpull(frame_size/2)

    # Tô màu khung sắt
    mat_black = model.materials.add('KhungDen')
    mat_black.color = '#222222'
    base_group.material = mat_black

    # === 2. Hộp đèn chibi 2 mặt ===
    sign_group = entities.add_group
    sign = sign_group.entities

    # Tạo mặt biển dạng bo tròn chibi (dạng polygon mô phỏng)
    # Đỉnh bo tròn, đáy bo tròn nhỏ (giả lập hình dạng)
    points = []
    n = 36
    r_top = width/2
    r_bottom = width*0.35
    center_top = [width/2, base_depth/2, base_height+height]
    center_bottom = [width/2, base_depth/2, base_height+height*0.15]
    # Nửa trên (bo tròn lớn)
    (0..n/2).each do |i|
      angle = Math::PI * i / (n/2)
      x = center_top[0] + r_top * Math.cos(angle)
      z = center_top[2] + r_top * Math.sin(angle)
      points << [x, center_top[1], z]
    end
    # Nửa dưới (bo tròn nhỏ)
    (n/2).downto(0) do |i|
      angle = Math::PI * i / (n/2)
      x = center_bottom[0] + r_bottom * Math.cos(angle)
      z = center_bottom[2] - r_bottom * Math.sin(angle)
      points << [x, center_bottom[1], z]
    end
    # Tạo mặt biển
    face = sign.add_face(points)
    face.pushpull(-depth)
    # Tô màu nền trắng
    mat_white = model.materials.add('NenTrang')
    mat_white.color = '#FFFFFF'
    sign_group.material = mat_white

    # === 3. Viền hộp đèn (nẹp alu đen) ===
    # Viền ngoài (tạo offset mặt biển, pushpull)
    offset = 15.mm
    outline = []
    points.each do |pt|
      dx = pt[0] - width/2
      dz = pt[2] - (base_height+height*0.5)
      len = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz)
      scale = (len + offset)/len
      outline << [width/2 + dx*scale, pt[1], (base_height+height*0.5) + dz*scale]
    end
    viendn = sign.add_face(outline)
    viendn.erase! if viendn.normal.z < 0
    viendn = sign.add_face(outline)
    viendn.pushpull(-depth-10.mm)
    sign.add_face(points) # Đảm bảo mặt biển không bị mất

    mat_vienden = model.materials.add('VienDen')
    mat_vienden.color = '#222222'
    viendn.material = mat_vienden

    # === 4. Chữ nổi 3D ===
    # "Bánh Tráng Trộn" (vàng viền đen, bo tròn)
    text1 = sign.add_3d_text(
      "Bánh Tráng Trộn",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Rounded MT Bold",
      false, false,
      60.mm,  # chiều cao chữ
      20.mm   # độ dày nổi
    )
    t1_tran = Geom::Transformation.new([width/2, base_depth/2, base_height+height*0.92])
    text1.transform!(t1_tran)
    mat_yellow = model.materials.add('ChuVang')
    mat_yellow.color = '#FFD600'
    text1.material = mat_yellow

    # "Nước Ép" (đỏ, viết tay)
    text2 = sign.add_3d_text(
      "Nước Ép",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Brush Script MT",
      false, false,
      80.mm,
      25.mm
    )
    t2_tran = Geom::Transformation.new([width/2, base_depth/2, base_height+height*0.75])
    text2.transform!(t2_tran)
    mat_red = model.materials.add('ChuDo')
    mat_red.color = '#FF1744'
    text2.material = mat_red

    # Hai ngôi sao vàng hai bên
    star1 = sign.add_3d_text("★", TextAlignRight, "Arial", false, false, 40.mm, 10.mm)
    star1.transform!(Geom::Transformation.new([width/2-150.mm, base_depth/2, base_height+height*0.92]))
    star1.material = mat_yellow
    star2 = sign.add_3d_text("★", TextAlignLeft, "Arial", false, false, 40.mm, 10.mm)
    star2.transform!(Geom::Transformation.new([width/2+150.mm, base_depth/2, base_height+height*0.92]))
    star2.material = mat_yellow

    # === 5. Hình ảnh nước ép, bánh tráng (khối mô phỏng) ===
    # Ly nước ép trái: hình trụ đỏ
    glass1 = sign.add_group
    glass1.entities.add_cylinder([width/2-70.mm, base_depth/2, base_height+height*0.45], 30.mm, 90.mm)
    mat_glass1 = model.materials.add('NuocDo')
    mat_glass1.color = '#FF1744'
    glass1.material = mat_glass1
    # Ly nước ép giữa: hình trụ vàng
    glass2 = sign.add_group
    glass2.entities.add_cylinder([width/2, base_depth/2, base_height+height*0.45], 30.mm, 90.mm)
    mat_glass2 = model.materials.add('NuocVang')
    mat_glass2.color = '#FFD600'
    glass2.material = mat_glass2
    # Ly nước ép phải: hình trụ hồng nhạt
    glass3 = sign.add_group
    glass3.entities.add_cylinder([width/2+70.mm, base_depth/2, base_height+height*0.45], 30.mm, 90.mm)
    mat_glass3 = model.materials.add('NuocHong')
    mat_glass3.color = '#FF80AB'
    glass3.material = mat_glass3
    # Đĩa bánh tráng tròn (màu cam vàng)
    plate = sign.add_group
    plate.entities.add_circle([width/2, base_depth/2, base_height+height*0.18], [0,0,1], 65.mm)
    plate.entities.add_face(plate.entities[0]).pushpull(10.mm)
    mat_plate = model.materials.add('BanhTrang')
    mat_plate.color = '#FFD180'
    plate.material = mat_plate

    # === 6. Gắn hộp đèn lên khung chân ===
    sign_group.move!([base_width*0.5-width*0.5, 0, base_height])

  end

    # Thông số chính

    radius = diameter / 2
    depth = 100.mm
    viendep = 10.mm # viền bo tròn mặt mica
    khung_satt = 25.mm
    chande_cao = 200.mm
    chande_rong = 120.mm
    chande_day = 6.mm

    # Màu sắc

    color_nhom = "#C0C0C0"
    color_satt = "#B0B0B0"

    # 1. Dựng mặt mica hút nổi (hình tròn, hơi lồi)
    group_mica = entities.add_group

    face_mica = group_mica.entities.add_face(face_mica)
    # Đẩy mặt mica lồi nhẹ (hút nổi ~15mm)
    face_mica.pushpull(-depth + 15.mm)
    # Bo tròn viền mặt trước
    group_mica.entities.add_circle([0, 0, depth+viendep], [0, 0, 1], radius-viendep)
    # Tô màu
    group_mica.material = color_mica

    # 2. Dựng viền nhôm/alu bao quanh (hình trụ rỗng)
    group_vien = entities.add_group

    path = group_vien.entities.add_circle([0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 1], radius)
    face_vien = group_vien.entities.add_face(path)
    # Viền trong
    path2 = group_vien.entities.add_circle([0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 1], radius-viendep)
    face_vien.followme(group_vien.entities.add_circle([0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 1], radius))
    # Đẩy viền lên cao
    face_vien.pushpull(depth)
    group_vien.material = color_nhom

    # 3. Khung xương sắt hộp bên trong (2 thanh ngang, 2 thanh dọc)
    group_khung = entities.add_group
    # Thanh dọc 1
    pt1 = [-khung_satt/2, 0, 0]
    pt2 = [khung_satt/2, 0, 0]
    pt3 = [khung_satt/2, 0, depth]
    pt4 = [-khung_satt/2, 0, depth]

    face_khung1.pushpull(diameter)
    # Thanh ngang 1
    pt5 = [0, -khung_satt/2, 0]
    pt6 = [0, khung_satt/2, 0]
    pt7 = [0, khung_satt/2, depth]
    pt8 = [0, -khung_satt/2, depth]
    face_khung2 = group_khung.entities.add_face(pt5, pt6, pt7, pt8)

    group_khung.material = color_satt

    # 4. Chân đế sắt hộp (2 chân)

      [-radius/2 + khung_satt, -khung_satt/2, -chande_cao],
      [-radius/2 + khung_satt, khung_satt/2, -chande_cao],
      [-radius/2, khung_satt/2, -chande_cao]
    )
    chan1.pushpull(chande_cao)
    # Chân phải

      [radius/2 + khung_satt, -khung_satt/2, -chande_cao],
      [radius/2 + khung_satt, khung_satt/2, -chande_cao],
      [radius/2, khung_satt/2, -chande_cao]
    )
    chan2.pushpull(chande_cao)
    # Đế chân trái
    de1 = group_chan.entities.add_face(
      [-radius/2 - chande_day, -chande_rong/2, -chande_cao-chande_day],
      [-radius/2 + khung_satt + chande_day, -chande_rong/2, -chande_cao-chande_day],
      [-radius/2 + khung_satt + chande_day, chande_rong/2, -chande_cao-chande_day],
      [-radius/2 - chande_day, chande_rong/2, -chande_cao-chande_day]

module HopDenHutNoiVuong60
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('HopDenHutNoiVuong60', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số chính
    width = 600.mm
    height = 600.mm
    depth = 60.mm
    radius = 50.mm # Bo tròn góc mặt hộp
    frame_thickness = 25.mm # Sắt hộp 25x25
    nẹp_width = 10.mm # Nẹp nhôm viền

    # Tạo khung xương sắt hộp vuông 25x25mm
    frame_group = entities.add_group
    frame = frame_group.entities

    # Khung ngoài (vuông, bo góc)
    pts = [
      Geom::Point3d.new(0, 0, 0),
      Geom::Point3d.new(width, 0, 0),
      Geom::Point3d.new(width, height, 0),
      Geom::Point3d.new(0, height, 0)
    ]
    # 4 thanh sắt hộp ngoài
    frame.add_face pts[0], pts[1], pts[2], pts[3]
    # 4 thanh sắt hộp viền (dạng khung)
    # Dưới đây là 4 thanh sắt hộp quanh viền
    [
      [0, 0, 0, width, 0, 0],
      [width, 0, 0, width, height, 0],
      [width, height, 0, 0, height, 0],
      [0, height, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    ].each do |x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2|
      edge = frame.add_line([x1, y1, z1], [x2, y2, z2])
      vec = Geom::Vector3d.new(0, 0, -frame_thickness)
      face = frame.add_face(edge.start.position, edge.end.position, edge.end.position.offset(vec), edge.start.position.offset(vec))
      face.pushpull(frame_thickness)
    end

    # Xương ngang tăng cứng (1 thanh giữa)
    x1 = frame_thickness
    x2 = width - frame_thickness
    y = height / 2
    z = -frame_thickness
    edge = frame.add_line([x1, y, z], [x2, y, z])
    vec = Geom::Vector3d.new(0, 0, -frame_thickness)
    face = frame.add_face([x1, y, z], [x2, y, z], [x2, y, z - frame_thickness], [x1, y, z - frame_thickness])
    face.pushpull(frame_thickness)

    # Chân đế sắt hộp 25x25mm
    leg_group = entities.add_group
    legs = leg_group.entities
    leg_height = 120.mm
    base_plate = 80.mm
    # Hai chân dọc
    [
      [width*0.25, -frame_thickness, -leg_height],
      [width*0.75, -frame_thickness, -leg_height]
    ].each do |x, y, z|
      leg = legs.add_face(
        [x, y, 0],
        [x+frame_thickness, y, 0],
        [x+frame_thickness, y, z],
        [x, y, z]
      )
      leg.pushpull(frame_thickness)
      # Bản mã chân
      plate = legs.add_face(
        [x-10.mm, y-5.mm, z],
        [x+frame_thickness+10.mm, y-5.mm, z],
        [x+frame_thickness+10.mm, y+frame_thickness+5.mm, z],
        [x-10.mm, y+frame_thickness+5.mm, z]
      )
      plate.pushpull(5.mm)
    end

    # Tạo mặt mica hút nổi (bo tròn 4 góc)
    face_group = entities.add_group
    face_ents = face_group.entities
    # Tạo hình chữ nhật bo góc
    require 'sketchup.rb'
    require 'extensions.rb'
    # Vẽ mặt bo góc
    center = Geom::Point3d.new(width/2, height/2, depth - 3.mm)
    rect = face_ents.add_face(
      [radius, radius, depth - 3.mm],

  end

module HopDenTronXinhan40
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('HopDenTronXinhan40', true)
    ents = model.active_entities

    # === Thông số chính ===
    dia = 400.mm
    radius = dia / 2
    depth = 120.mm
    frame_thick = 25.mm
    rim_width = 40.mm
    text_thick_main = 30.mm
    text_thick_sub = 15.mm

    # === Khung xương sắt hộp ===
    frame_group = ents.add_group
    frame_ents = frame_group.entities

    # Vòng tròn khung sắt hộp (2 mặt trước/sau)
    [0, depth - frame_thick].each do |z|
      circle = frame_ents.add_circle([0, 0, z], [0, 0, 1], radius - frame_thick / 2, 64)
      frame_ents.add_face(circle)
    end

    # Thanh nối xương ngang (4 thanh chia đều)
    4.times do |i|
      angle = i * Math::PI / 2
      x = Math.cos(angle) * (radius - frame_thick / 2)
      y = Math.sin(angle) * (radius - frame_thick / 2)
      p1 = [x, y, 0]
      p2 = [x, y, depth - frame_thick]
      frame_ents.add_line(p1, p2)
      # Tạo thanh hộp 25x25 nối 2 mặt
      vec = Geom::Vector3d.new(x, y, 0)
      tr = Geom::Transformation.translation(vec)
      box = frame_ents.add_group
      box.entities.add_face([0, -frame_thick/2, 0], [0, frame_thick/2, 0], [0, frame_thick/2, depth], [0, -frame_thick/2, depth])
      box.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each { |f| f.pushpull(frame_thick) }
      box.transform!(Geom::Transformation.rotation([0,0,0], [0,0,1], angle))
      box.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([0,0,0]))
      box.transform!(tr)
    end

    # === Tai treo/cần đỡ ===
    # Thanh sắt hộp 25x25, dài 200mm, gắn bên trái hộp
    arm_group = ents.add_group
    arm_ents = arm_group.entities
    arm_len = 200.mm
    arm_face = arm_ents.add_face([-(radius+frame_thick), -frame_thick/2, depth/2-frame_thick/2],
                                [-(radius+frame_thick), frame_thick/2, depth/2-frame_thick/2],
                                [-(radius+frame_thick), frame_thick/2, depth/2+frame_thick/2],
                                [-(radius+frame_thick), -frame_thick/2, depth/2+frame_thick/2])
    arm_face.pushpull(-arm_len)
    # Plate gắn tường (40x120mm)
    plate = arm_ents.add_face([-(radius+frame_thick+arm_len), -20.mm, depth/2-60.mm],
                             [-(radius+frame_thick+arm_len), 20.mm, depth/2-60.mm],
                             [-(radius+frame_thick+arm_len), 20.mm, depth/2+60.mm],
                             [-(radius+frame_thick+arm_len), -20.mm, depth/2+60.mm])
    plate.pushpull(5.mm)

    # === Thân hộp đèn tròn (mặt mica + viền alu) ===
    # Mặt mica trắng (2 mặt)
    [0, depth].each do |z|
      face = ents.add_circle([0,0,z], [0,0,1], radius, 128)
      f = ents.add_face(face)
      f.material = "#FFFFFF"
      f.back_material = "#FFFFFF"
    end

    # Viền alu đen (bao quanh)
    rim_group = ents.add_group
    rim_ents = rim_group.entities
    rim_face = rim_ents.add_circle([0,0,0], [0,0,1], radius, 128)
    rim_hole = rim_ents.add_circle([0,0,0], [0,0,1], radius - rim_width, 128)
    rim = rim_ents.add_face(rim_face)
    rim.erase_inner_loop(rim_hole)
    rim.pushpull(depth)
    rim.material = "#222222"

    # === Nội dung chữ nổi 3D và icon/logo ===
    text_group = ents.add_group
    text_ents = text_group.entities

    # Logo xe hơi cách điệu (dạng khối cong, mô phỏng bằng 2 đường cong đỏ/đen)
    # Đen
    logo_curve1 = text_ents.add_arc([0, 60.mm, depth+1.mm], [1,0,0], [0,1,0], 120.mm, 0, Math::PI, 24)
    logo_face1 = text_ents.add_face(logo_curve1)
    logo_face1.pushpull(3.mm)
    logo_face1.material = "#222222"
    # Đỏ
    logo_curve2 = text_ents.add_arc([0, 50.mm, depth+1.5.mm], [1,0,0], [0,1,0], 100.mm, 0, Math::PI, 24)
    logo_face2 = text_ents.add_face(logo_curve2)
    logo_face2.pushpull(3.mm)
    logo_face2.material = "#E53935"

    # Dòng "DETAILING"
    text_ents.add_3d_text("DETAILING", TextAlignCenter, "Arial Black", false, false, 40.mm, 0, text_thick_sub).transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([0, 30.mm, depth+2.mm]))
    text_ents.grep(Sketchup::ComponentInstance).last.material = "#222222"

    # Dòng "THANH HẰNG"
    text_ents.add_3d_text("THANH HẰNG", TextAlignCenter, "Arial Black", false, false, 48.mm, 0, text_thick_main).transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([0, -10.mm, depth+2.mm]))
    text_ents.grep(Sketchup::ComponentInstance).last.material = "#E53935"

    # Các dịch vụ (icon + chữ)
    # Icon mô phỏng bằng hình vuông nhỏ, chữ nổi đỏ
    icons_y = [-50.mm, -70.mm, -90.mm]
    services = ["RỬA XE", "THAY NHỚT", "NƯỚC GIẢI KHÁT"]
    services.each_with_index do |txt, i|
      # Icon
      icon = text_ents.add_face([-60.mm, icons_y[i], depth+2.mm], [-50.mm, icons_y[i], depth+2.mm],
                                [-50.mm, icons_y[i]+10.mm, depth+2.mm], [-60.mm, icons_y[i]+10.mm, depth+2.mm])
      icon.pushpull(5.mm)
      icon.material = "#E53935"
      # Text
      t = text_ents.add_3d_text(txt, TextAlignLeft, "Arial Black", false, false, 22.mm, 0, text_thick_sub)
      t.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([-40.mm, icons_y[i], depth+2.mm]))
      text_ents.grep(Sketchup::ComponentInstance).last.material = "#E53935"
    end

    # Chân biển đỏ (hình quạt tròn dưới cùng)
    wedge_group = ents.add_group
    wedge_ents = wedge_group.entities
    wedge_face = wedge_ents.add_arc([0,0,depth+1.5.mm], [1,0,0], [0,1,0], radius, Math::PI, 2*Math::PI, 64)
    wedge_face2 = wedge_ents.add_arc([0,0,depth+1.5.mm], [1,0,0], [0,1,0], 0, Math::PI, 2*Math::PI, 64)
    wedge = wedge_ents.add_face(wedge_face + wedge_face2.reverse)
    wedge.pushpull(10.mm)
    wedge.material = "#E53935"

    # "CHĂM SÓC XE" (trắng, trên nền đỏ)
    t1 = text_ents.add_3d_text("CHĂM SÓC XE", TextAlignCenter, "Arial Black", false, false, 28.mm, 0, text_thick_sub)
    t1.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([0, -120.mm, depth+12.mm]))
    text_ents.grep(Sketchup::ComponentInstance).last.material = "#FFFFFF"

    # "CHUYÊN NGHIỆP" (trắng, nhỏ hơn)
    t2 = text_ents.add_3d_text("CHUYÊN NGHIỆP", TextAlignCenter, "Arial", false, false, 16.mm, 0, text_thick_sub)
    t2.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([0, -140.mm, depth+12.mm]))
    text_ents.grep(Sketchup::ComponentInstance).last.material = "#FFFFFF"

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

module KiotDenLed140X160X200

    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số
    width = 1400.mm
    height = 1600.mm
    depth = 2000.mm
    frame_size = 30.mm
    alu_thickness = 3.mm
    roof_height = 250.mm
    sign_height = 350.mm
    led_box_height = 250.mm
    led_box_depth = 120.mm

    # Màu sắc
    color_yellow = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFD600")
    color_orange = Sketchup::Color.new("#FF6F00")
    color_white = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFFFFF")
    color_gray = Sketchup::Color.new("#B0BEC5")
    color_black = Sketchup::Color.new("#212121")
    color_green = Sketchup::Color.new("#43A047")
    color_cream = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFF8E1")

    # 1. Khung xương sắt hộp
    frame_group = entities.add_group
    frame = frame_group.entities

    # 4 cột đứng
    [[0,0,0],[width-frame_size,0,0],[0,depth-frame_size,0],[width-frame_size,depth-frame_size,0]].each do |pt|
      frame.add_face([pt,[pt[0]+frame_size,pt[1],pt[2]],[pt[0]+frame_size,pt[1]+frame_size,pt[2]],[pt[0],pt[1]+frame_size,pt[2]]]).pushpull(height)
    end

    # Xương ngang trên/dưới
    [[0,0,0],[0,0,height-frame_size],[0,depth-frame_size,0],[0,depth-frame_size,height-frame_size]].each do |pt|
      frame.add_face([pt,[pt[0]+width,pt[1],pt[2]],[pt[0]+width,pt[1]+frame_size,pt[2]],[pt[0],pt[1]+frame_size,pt[2]]]).pushpull(frame_size)
    end

    # Xương ngang giữa tăng cứng (chia 3 tầng)
    [height/3, height*2/3].each do |z|
      frame.add_face([[0,0,z],[width,0,z],[width,frame_size,z],[0,frame_size,z]]).pushpull(frame_size)
      frame.add_face([[0,depth-frame_size,z],[width,depth-frame_size,z],[width,depth,z],[0,depth,z]]).pushpull(frame_size)
    end

    # Xương dọc hai bên
    [0, width-frame_size].each do |x|
      frame.add_face([[x,0,0],[x+frame_size,0,0],[x+frame_size,0,height],[x,0,height]]).pushpull(frame_size)
      frame.add_face([[x,depth-frame_size,0],[x+frame_size,depth-frame_size,0],[x+frame_size,depth-frame_size,height],[x,depth-frame_size,height]]).pushpull(frame_size)
    end

    # Chân đế (4 chân)
    [[0,0,0],[width-frame_size,0,0],[0,depth-frame_size,0],[width-frame_size,depth-frame_size,0]].each do |pt|
      frame.add_face([pt,[pt[0]+frame_size,pt[1],pt[2]],[pt[0]+frame_size,pt[1]+frame_size,pt[2]],[pt[0],pt[1]+frame_size,pt[2]]]).pushpull(-50.mm)
    end

    # 2. Tấm alu vàng mặt ngoài
    alu_group = entities.add_group
    alu = alu_group.entities
    # Mặt trước
    face = alu.add_face([ [0,0,0], [width,0,0], [width,0,height], [0,0,height] ])
    face.pushpull(alu_thickness)
    alu_group.material = color_yellow

    # Mặt bên trái
    face = alu.add_face([ [0,0,0], [0,depth,0], [0,depth,height], [0,0,height] ])
    face.pushpull(alu_thickness)
    alu_group.material = color_yellow

    # Mặt bên phải
    face = alu.add_face([ [width,0,0], [width,depth,0], [width,depth,height], [width,0,height] ])
    face.pushpull(alu_thickness)
    alu_group.material = color_yellow

    # Mặt sau
    face = alu.add_face([ [0,depth,0], [width,depth,0], [width,depth,height], [0,depth,height] ])
    face.pushpull(alu_thickness)
    alu_group.material = color_yellow

    # 3. Mái lượn sóng cam (CNC alu)
    roof_group = entities.add_group
    roof = roof_group.entities
    # Tạo đường lượn sóng
    wave_pts = []
    wave_count = 4
    step = width/wave_count
    (0..wave_count).each do |i|
      x = i*step
      y = 0
      z = height
      wave_pts << [x, y, z]
      wave_pts << [x+step/2, y, z+roof_height*(i%2==0 ? 1 : -0.5)]
    end
    # Đường lượn sóng phía trước
    path = []
    (0..wave_count*2).each do |i|
      pt = wave_pts[i]
      path << [pt[0], pt[1], pt[2]]
    end
    # Đường lượn sóng phía sau
    path_back = path.map{|pt| [pt[0], pt[1]+alu_thickness+400.mm, pt[2]]}
    # Tạo mặt mái
    roof_face_pts = path + path_back.reverse
    face = roof.add_face(roof_face_pts)
    face.pushpull(alu_thickness)
    roof_group.material = color_orange

    # 4. Cửa cuốn nhôm vàng kem
    door_group = entities.add_group
    door = door_group.entities
    door_width = 900.mm
    door_height = 1200.mm
    door_x = (width-door_width)/2
    door_y = alu_thickness+1.mm
    door_z = 200.mm

    face.pushpull(10.mm)
    door_group.material = color_cream

    # 5. Hộp đèn mica trắng (phía dưới)
    led_group = entities.add_group
    led = led_group.entities
    led_x = (width-900.mm)/2
    led_y = alu_thickness+30.mm

    face = led.add_face([ [led_x,led_y,led_z], [led_x+900.mm,led_y,led_z], [led_x+900.mm,led_y,led_z+led_box_height], [led_x,led_y,led_z+led_box_height] ])
    face.pushpull(led_box_depth)
    led_group.material = color_white

    # 6. Chữ nổi "TIK TAK"
    text_group = entities.add_group
    text = text_group.entities
    text_z = height-120.mm
    text_y = alu_thickness+5.mm
    text_x = 120.mm
    tik = text.add_3d_text('TIK', TextAlignLeft, "Arial Black", false, false, 180.mm, 40.mm, 0, true, 0)
    tik.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([text_x, text_y, text_z]))
    tik.material = color_white
    tik.back_material = color_orange

    tak = text.add_3d_text('TAK', TextAlignLeft, "Arial Black", false, false, 180.mm, 40.mm, 0, true, 0)
    tak.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([text_x+350.mm, text_y, text_z]))
    tak.material = color_white
    tak.back_material = color_orange

    # 7. Logo lát cam (hình tròn, lát cam, lá xanh)
    logo_group = entities.add_group
    logo = logo_group.entities
    logo_center = [text_x+650.mm, text_y+20.mm, text_z+60.mm]
    logo_radius = 60.mm
    logo_face = logo.add_circle(logo_center, [0,1,0], logo_radius)
    logo_face = logo.add_face(logo_face)
    logo_face.pushpull(20.mm)
    logo_group.material = color_orange
    # Lát cam vàng
    cam_face = logo.add_circle(logo_center, [0,1,0], logo_radius*0.7)
    cam_face = logo.add_face(cam_face)
    cam_face.pushpull(21.mm)
    cam_face.material = color_yellow
    # Lá xanh
    leaf = logo.add_face([
      [logo_center[0]+logo_radius*0.7, logo_center[1], logo_center[2]+logo_radius*0.7],
      [logo_center[0]+logo_radius*0.9, logo_center[1], logo_center[2]+logo_radius*1.1],
      [logo_center[0]+logo_radius*0.5, logo_center[1], logo_center[2]+logo_radius*1.2]
    ])
    leaf.pushpull(10.mm)
    leaf.material = color_green

    # 8. Chữ phụ hộp đèn (dán decal mô phỏng)
    led_text_group = led_group.entities.add_group
    led_text = led_text_group.entities
    led_text.add_3d_text('ĂN VẶT - MÁY TRÁI SỮA', TextAlignCenter, "Arial", false, false, 40.mm, 8.mm, 0, true, 0)
    led_text.add_3d_text('TIKTAK', TextAlignCenter, "Arial Black", false, false, 60.mm, 15.mm, 0, true, 0)
    led_text.add_3d_text('Face Book: TikTak Kỳ Mỹ, Cam Ranh 79 520', TextAlignCenter, "Arial", false, false, 20.mm, 5.mm, 0, true, 0)
    led_text.add_3d_text('Hotline - Zalo: 0961 85 18 12', TextAlignCenter, "Arial", false, false, 20.mm, 5.mm, 0, true, 0)
    led_text_group.material = color_black

    model.commit_operation
  end

module LedNeonNhieuMau90X60
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model

    entities = model.active_entities

    # Kích thước tổng thể
    width = 900.mm
    height = 600.mm
    base_thickness = 10.mm
    letter_thickness = 30.mm
    crown_thickness = 20.mm

    # Tạo đế mica trắng sữa (cắt CNC theo biên dạng chữ, ở đây mô phỏng hình chữ nhật bo góc)
    base = entities.add_group
    pts = [
      [0, 0, 0],
      [width, 0, 0],
      [width, height, 0],
      [0, height, 0]
    ]
    face = base.entities.add_face(pts)
    face.pushpull(base_thickness)
    # Bo góc nhẹ (mô phỏng)
    base.material = "#F8F8FF" # trắng sữa

    # Vị trí chữ "Thien"

    thien_text = "Thien"
    thien_pos = [width * 0.18, height * 0.60, base_thickness]
    thien = thien_group.entities.add_3d_text(

      TextAlignLeft,
      "Brush Script MT",
      false,
      false,
      letter_thickness,
      120.mm,
      0,
      true,
      thien_pos
    )
    thien_group.material = "#FF3EF6" # Hồng tím LED neon

    # Viền sáng chữ "Thien" (mô phỏng bằng offset)
    thien_outline = thien_group.entities.add_group

      if e.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)
        outline = e.offset(5.mm)
        outline.material = "#FFFFFF"
      end
    end

    # Vị trí chữ "Thanh"
    thanh_group = entities.add_group
    thanh_text = "Thanh"
    thanh_pos = [width * 0.13, height * 0.28, base_thickness]
    thanh = thanh_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      thanh_text,
      TextAlignLeft,
      "Brush Script MT",
      false,
      false,
      letter_thickness,
      120.mm,
      0,
      true,
      thanh_pos
    )
    thanh_group.material = "#00B2FF" # Xanh dương LED neon

    # Viền sáng chữ "Thanh"
    thanh_outline = thanh_group.entities.add_group
    thanh_group.entities.each do |e|
      if e.is_a?(Sketchup::Face)
        outline = e.offset(5.mm)
        outline.material = "#B6F0FF"
      end
    end

    # Vương miện (crown) phía trên chữ "Thien"
    crown_group = entities.add_group
    # Mô phỏng vương miện bằng các cung tròn và hình chữ nhật nhỏ
    crown_base = crown_group.entities.add_circle(
      [width * 0.70, height * 0.80, base_thickness + letter_thickness + 2.mm],
      [0,0,1],
      40.mm,
      32
    )
    crown_face = crown_group.entities.add_face(crown_base)
    crown_face.pushpull(crown_thickness)
    crown_group.material = "#FFD600" # Vàng cam LED neon

    # Thêm các chóp vương miện (mô phỏng 3 chóp)
    3.times do |i|
      angle = 120 * i - 60
      rad = angle * Math::PI / 180
      x = width * 0.70 + 40.mm * Math.cos(rad)
      y = height * 0.80 + 40.mm * Math.sin(rad)

      sphere_face = crown_group.entities.add_face(sphere)
      sphere_face.pushpull(8.mm)
    end

    # Kết thúc thao tác
    model.commit_operation
  end
end

module LedXinhanMuiTen120X50
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('LedXinhanMuiTen120X50', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số chính
    width = 1200.mm
    height = 500.mm
    depth = 30.mm
    frame_thickness = 25.mm
    border_width = 20.mm
    led_radius = 5.mm
    led_spacing = 35.mm
    text_thickness = 20.mm

    # Tạo nhóm tổng thể
    group = entities.add_group
    ents = group.entities

    # 1. Khung xương sắt hộp (25x25mm)
    frame = ents.add_group
    fw = frame_thickness
    # Khung ngoài
    frame.entities.add_face([0,0,0],[width,0,0],[width,height,0],[0,height,0]).pushpull(-fw)
    # Xương đứng
    frame.entities.add_face([fw+500.mm,fw,0],[fw+500.mm,fw,height-fw],[fw+500.mm+fw,fw,height-fw],[fw+500.mm+fw,fw,0]).pushpull(-fw)
    # Xương ngang tăng cứng
    frame.entities.add_face([fw,fw+250.mm,0],[width-fw,fw+250.mm,0],[width-fw,fw+250.mm,fw],[fw,fw+250.mm,fw])
    # Chân đế
    leg1 = frame.entities.add_group
    leg1.entities.add_face([width-80.mm, -fw-40.mm, 0], [width-50.mm, -fw-40.mm, 0], [width-50.mm, -fw, 0], [width-80.mm, -fw, 0]).pushpull(-70.mm)
    leg2 = frame.entities.add_group
    leg2.entities.add_face([80.mm, -fw-40.mm, 0], [50.mm, -fw-40.mm, 0], [50.mm, -fw, 0], [80.mm, -fw, 0]).pushpull(-70.mm)

    # 2. Tấm nền mặt biển (mũi tên)
    # Vẽ hình mũi tên bằng các điểm polyline
    arrow_pts = [
      [0, height/2, fw],                 # Đầu mũi tên trái
      [100.mm, height, fw],              # Góc trên mũi tên
      [width-100.mm, height, fw],        # Đỉnh trên phải
      [width-100.mm, height-120.mm, fw], # Gấp xuống
      [width, height-120.mm, fw],        # Đầu phải
      [width, 120.mm, fw],               # Gấp lên
      [width-100.mm, 120.mm, fw],        # Đỉnh dưới phải
      [width-100.mm, 0, fw],             # Góc dưới
      [100.mm, 0, fw],                   # Đuôi dưới
    ]
    arrow_face = ents.add_face(arrow_pts)
    arrow_face.pushpull(depth-fw)

    # Tô màu nền xanh dương
    mat_bg = model.materials.add('BG_BLUE')
    mat_bg.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#0018A8')
    arrow_face.material = mat_bg
    arrow_face.back_material = mat_bg

    # 3. Viền nẹp alu trắng xám
    border = ents.add_group
    offset = 0
    border_pts = arrow_pts.map { |pt| [pt[0]+offset, pt[1]+offset, pt[2]+depth-fw] }
    border_face = border.entities.add_face(border_pts)
    border_face.pushpull(border_width)

    mat_border = model.materials.add('BORDER_WHITE')
    mat_border.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#E6E6E6')
    border_face.material = mat_border
    border_face.back_material = mat_border

    # 4. Chữ nổi "AN LAND GARDEN"
    text = ents.add_group
    text_string = "AN LAND GARDEN"
    text_pos = Geom::Point3d.new(width/2-230.mm, height/2-30.mm, fw+10.mm)
    text.entities.add_3d_text(
      text_string,
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Rounded MT Bold",
      false, false,
      100.mm, text_thickness, 0, true, text_pos
    )
    mat_text = model.materials.add('TEXT_YELLOW')
    mat_text.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#FFE600')
    text.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each { |f| f.material = mat_text; f.back_material = mat_text }

    # 5. LED viền (đỏ + xanh dương)
    led_group = ents.add_group
    # LED chạy viền ngoài (đỏ)
    led_pts = []
    (0..8).each do |i|
      led_pts << arrow_pts[i]
      next_pt = arrow_pts[(i+1)%arrow_pts.size]
      dist = Math.sqrt((next_pt[0]-arrow_pts[i][0])**2 + (next_pt[1]-arrow_pts[i][1])**2)
      steps = (dist / led_spacing).to_i
      (1..steps).each do |s|
        led_pts << [
          arrow_pts[i][0] + (next_pt[0]-arrow_pts[i][0])*s/steps,
          arrow_pts[i][1] + (next_pt[1]-arrow_pts[i][1])*s/steps,
          fw+depth+border_width/2
        ]
      end
    end
    led_pts.each do |pt|
      led = led_group.entities.add_circle([pt[0], pt[1], pt[2]], [0,0,1], led_radius)
      led_face = led_group.entities.add_face(led)
      led_face.pushpull(led_radius)
    end
    mat_led_red = model.materials.add('LED_RED')
    mat_led_red.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#FF0000')
    led_group.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each { |f| f.material = mat_led_red; f.back_material = mat_led_red }

    # LED chạy viền trong (xanh dương)

      steps = (dist / led_spacing).to_i
      (1..steps).each do |s|
        led_pts2 << [
          inner_pts[i][0] + (next_pt[0]-inner_pts[i][0])*s/steps,
          inner_pts[i][1] + (next_pt[1]-inner_pts[i][1])*s/steps,
          fw+depth/2
        ]
      end
    end
    led_pts2.each do |pt|
      led = led_group2.entities.add_circle([pt[0], pt[1], pt[2]], [0,0,1], led_radius)
      led_face = led_group2.entities.add_face(led)
      led_face.pushpull(led_radius)
    end
    mat_led_blue = model.materials.add('LED_BLUE')
    mat_led_blue.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#00BFFF')
    led_group2.entities.grep(Sketchup::Face).each { |f| f.material = mat_led_blue; f.back_material = mat_led_blue }

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

module MicaHutNoiNgoiSaoBuaLiem
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('MicaHutNoiNgoiSaoBuaLiem', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Màu vàng mica hút nổi
    yellow = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFD600")

    # === TẠO LOGO BÚA LIỀM ===
    # Thông số logo búa liềm
    logo_center = Geom::Point3d.new(0, 0, 0)
    logo_scale = 600.0 # mm (chiều rộng chính)
    logo_thickness = 50.0 # mm (độ nổi)
    # Vẽ búa liềm bằng các khối cơ bản (hình chữ nhật, cung tròn, hình trụ)
    logo_group = entities.add_group
    logo_ents = logo_group.entities

    # Thân liềm (hình tròn khuyết)
    center_liem = Geom::Point3d.new(0, 0, 0)
    radius_outer = 220.0
    radius_inner = 140.0
    angle1 = 30.degrees
    angle2 = 320.degrees
    # Vẽ cung ngoài
    edges_outer = logo_ents.add_arc(center_liem, [1,0,0], [0,1,0], radius_outer, angle1, angle2, 24)
    # Vẽ cung trong
    edges_inner = logo_ents.add_arc(center_liem, [1,0,0], [0,1,0], radius_inner, angle1, angle2, 24)
    # Nối hai đầu cung
    pt1 = edges_outer.first.start.position
    pt2 = edges_outer.last.end.position
    pt3 = edges_inner.last.end.position
    pt4 = edges_inner.first.start.position
    logo_ents.add_line(pt1, pt4)
    logo_ents.add_line(pt2, pt3)
    # Tạo mặt liềm
    face_liem = logo_ents.add_face(edges_outer + [logo_ents.add_line(pt2, pt3)] + edges_inner.reverse + [logo_ents.add_line(pt4, pt1)])
    face_liem.pushpull(logo_thickness)
    face_liem.material = yellow
    face_liem.back_material = yellow

    # Thân búa (hình chữ nhật)
    hammer_w = 60.0
    hammer_h = 220.0
    hammer_thick = logo_thickness
    hammer_origin = Geom::Point3d.new(-hammer_w/2, radius_outer-40, 0)
    hammer_face = logo_ents.add_face([
      hammer_origin,
      hammer_origin.offset([1,0,0], hammer_w),
      hammer_origin.offset([1,0,0], hammer_w).offset([0,1,0], hammer_h),
      hammer_origin.offset([0,1,0], hammer_h)
    ])
    hammer_face.pushpull(hammer_thick)
    hammer_face.material = yellow
    hammer_face.back_material = yellow

    # Đầu búa (hình hộp nhỏ)
    head_w = 120.0
    head_h = 40.0
    head_thick = logo_thickness
    head_origin = Geom::Point3d.new(-head_w/2, radius_outer+hammer_h-40, 0)
    head_face = logo_ents.add_face([
      head_origin,
      head_origin.offset([1,0,0], head_w),
      head_origin.offset([1,0,0], head_w).offset([0,1,0], head_h),
      head_origin.offset([0,1,0], head_h)
    ])
    head_face.pushpull(head_thick)
    head_face.material = yellow
    head_face.back_material = yellow

    # Cán búa (hình hộp nghiêng)
    can_w = 30.0
    can_h = 180.0
    can_thick = logo_thickness
    can_origin = Geom::Point3d.new(-can_w/2+100, radius_outer-60, 0)
    can_face = logo_ents.add_face([
      can_origin,
      can_origin.offset([1,0,0], can_w),
      can_origin.offset([1,0,0], can_w).offset([0,1,0], can_h),
      can_origin.offset([0,1,0], can_h)
    ])
    can_face.pushpull(can_thick)
    can_face.material = yellow
    can_face.back_material = yellow
    # Xoay cán búa
    tr = Geom::Transformation.rotation(center_liem, [0,0,1], 25.degrees)
    logo_group.transform!(tr)

    # === TẠO 4 NGÔI SAO HÚT NỔI ===
    star_count = 4
    star_radius = 175.0 # mm (bán kính ngôi sao)
    star_thickness = 35.0 # mm (độ nổi)
    star_spacing = 400.0 # mm (khoảng cách giữa các ngôi sao)
    star_y = 500.0 # mm (tọa độ y đặt ngôi sao)

    def self.create_star(entities, center, radius, thickness, color)
      # Vẽ ngôi sao 5 cánh 3D
      pts = []
      for i in 0...10
        angle = Math::PI/2 + i*Math::PI/5
        r = (i % 2 == 0) ? radius : radius*0.4
        pts << Geom::Point3d.new(
          center.x + r*Math.cos(angle),
          center.y + r*Math.sin(angle),
          center.z
        )
      end
      face = entities.add_face(pts)
      face.material = color
      face.back_material = color
      # Đẩy nổi lên
      face.pushpull(thickness)
      # Tạo khối nổi 3D (tạo tâm nổi)
      star_center = Geom::Point3d.new(center.x, center.y, center.z + thickness*1.2)
      for i in 0...10
        face2 = entities.add_face(center, pts[i], pts[(i+1)%10])
        face2.material = color
        face2.back_material = color
        face2.pushpull(thickness*0.6)
      end
    end

    # Tạo 4 ngôi sao
    for i in 0...star_count
      x = (i-1.5)*star_spacing
      y = star_y
      z = 0
      star_group = entities.add_group
      self.create_star(star_group.entities, Geom::Point3d.new(x, y, z), star_radius, star_thickness, yellow)
    end

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module QuayThuNganMatDaLamNhua
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('QuayThuNganMatDaLamNhua', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số chính
    width = 1500.mm
    height = 700.mm
    depth = 1200.mm
    radius = 250.mm # Bán kính bo cong góc trái
    lam_width = 30.mm
    lam_depth = 15.mm
    lam_gap = 2.mm
    stone_thickness = 20.mm
    nẹp_height = 50.mm

    # Tạo nhóm khung xương sắt hộp
    group_frame = entities.add_group
    frame = group_frame.entities

    # Khung đáy (chữ L bo cong)
    pts_base = [
      [0, 0, 0],
      [radius, 0, 0],
      [width, 0, 0],
      [width, depth - radius, 0],
      [width - radius, depth, 0],
      [0, depth, 0],
      [0, radius, 0]
    ]
    # Bo cong góc trái
    arc_pts = []
    num_arc = 12
    (0..num_arc).each do |i|
      angle = Math::PI/2 * i / num_arc
      x = radius * Math.cos(Math::PI - angle)
      y = radius * Math.sin(Math::PI - angle)
      arc_pts << [x, y, 0]
    end
    pts_base = arc_pts + pts_base[1..-1]

    # Khung đáy
    base_face = frame.add_face(pts_base)
    base_face.pushpull(30.mm) # Sắt hộp cao 30mm

    # Khung đứng (cột)
    frame_pts = [
      [0, 0, 0],
      [width, 0, 0],
      [width, depth, 0],
      [0, depth, 0]
    ]
    frame_pts.each do |pt|
      frame.add_face(
        pt,
        [pt[0]+30.mm, pt[1], pt[2]],
        [pt[0]+30.mm, pt[1], pt[2]+height],
        [pt[0], pt[1], pt[2]+height]
      ).pushpull(-30.mm)
    end

    # Tạo thân quầy (ốp lam nhựa dọc bo cong)
    group_body = entities.add_group
    body = group_body.entities

    # Tạo các thanh lam nhựa chạy dọc mặt trước và bo cong
    lam_start = 0
    lam_end = width + depth
    lam_pos = 0
    while lam_pos < width + depth
      # Tính vị trí trên mặt chữ L bo cong
      if lam_pos < radius * Math::PI/2
        # Trên cung tròn bo góc
        angle = lam_pos / radius
        x = radius * Math.cos(Math::PI - angle)
        y = radius * Math.sin(Math::PI - angle)
      elsif lam_pos < width
        # Trên cạnh trước
        x = lam_pos
        y = 0
      else
        # Trên cạnh bên phải
        x = width
        y = lam_pos - width
      end
      # Tạo thanh lam
      lam_face = body.add_face(
        [x, y, 0],
        [x + lam_width, y, 0],
        [x + lam_width, y, height],
        [x, y, height]
      )
      lam_face.pushpull(-lam_depth)
      lam_face.material = "#B97A56"
      lam_face.back_material = "#B97A56"
      lam_pos += lam_width + lam_gap
    end

    # Tạo mặt đá trắng vân mây
    group_stone = entities.add_group
    stone = group_stone.entities
    # Mặt đá phủ ra ngoài thân quầy 30mm
    offset = 30.mm
    pts_stone = pts_base.map { |pt| [pt[0] - offset, pt[1] - offset, height] }
    stone_face = stone.add_face(pts_stone)
    stone_face.pushpull(stone_thickness)
    stone_face.material = "#F5F5F5"

    # Tạo viền nẹp nhôm vàng ở chân
    group_nep = entities.add_group
    nep = group_nep.entities
    pts_nep = pts_base.map { |pt| [pt[0], pt[1], 0] }
    nep_face = nep.add_face(pts_nep)
    nep_face.pushpull(nẹp_height)
    nep_face.material = "#FFD700"

    # Tạo dải LED hắt sáng vàng (mô phỏng bằng khối mỏng sát viền nẹp)
    group_led = entities.add_group
    led = group_led.entities
    pts_led = pts_base.map { |pt| [pt[0], pt[1], nẹp_height] }
    led_face = led.add_face(pts_led)
    led_face.pushpull(10.mm)
    led_face.material = "#FFFACD"

    # Đặt tên nhóm cho dễ quản lý
    group_frame.name = "Khung xương sắt hộp"
    group_body.name = "Ốp lam nhựa giả gỗ"
    group_stone.name = "Mặt đá trắng"
    group_nep.name = "Viền nẹp nhôm vàng"
    group_led.name = "Dải LED hắt chân"

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module TemDecalInBe
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('TemDecalInBe', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Kích thước tem
    width = 200.mm
    height = 100.mm
    thickness = 2.mm

    # Tạo mặt nền decal (dạng cloud/bo tròn lượn sóng)
    center = Geom::Point3d.new(0, 0, 0)
    num_points = 32
    radius_x = width / 2 - 5.mm
    radius_y = height / 2 - 5.mm
    wave_amp = 8.mm
    wave_freq = 6

    points = []
    (0...num_points).each do |i|
      angle = 2 * Math::PI * i / num_points
      r_x = radius_x + Math.sin(angle * wave_freq) * wave_amp
      r_y = radius_y + Math.sin(angle * wave_freq) * wave_amp
      x = center.x + r_x * Math.cos(angle)
      y = center.y + r_y * Math.sin(angle)
      points << Geom::Point3d.new(x, y, 0)
    end
    face = entities.add_face(points)
    face.pushpull(thickness)

    # Tô màu nền decal
    decal_color = Sketchup::Color.new("#F6FAFF")
    face.material = decal_color
    face.back_material = decal_color

    # Viền ngoài decal (vàng kem nhạt)
    offset = 4.mm
    outer_points = []
    (0...num_points).each do |i|
      angle = 2 * Math::PI * i / num_points
      r_x = radius_x + offset + Math.sin(angle * wave_freq) * (wave_amp + 2)
      r_y = radius_y + offset + Math.sin(angle * wave_freq) * (wave_amp + 2)
      x = center.x + r_x * Math.cos(angle)
      y = center.y + r_y * Math.sin(angle)
      outer_points << Geom::Point3d.new(x, y, thickness/2)
    end
    outer_face = entities.add_face(outer_points)
    outer_face.erase! if outer_face.normal.z < 0
    outer_face.pushpull(-thickness/2)
    outer_face.material = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFF3D1")
    outer_face.back_material = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFF3D1")

    # Vẽ chữ nổi "MOON"
    moon_group = entities.add_group
    moon_text = "MOON"
    moon_pos = Geom::Point3d.new(-60.mm, 15.mm, thickness)
    moon_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      moon_text, TextAlignCenter, "Arial Rounded MT Bold", false, false,
      22.mm, 30.mm, 0, true, moon_pos, 0
    )
    moon_group.material = Sketchup::Color.new("#8B5C2B") # Nâu chocolate
    moon_group.entities.each { |e| e.material = Sketchup::Color.new("#8B5C2B") }
    # Viền trắng cho chữ "MOON" (tạo offset)
    moon_outline = moon_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      moon_text, TextAlignCenter, "Arial Rounded MT Bold", false, false,
      24.mm, 30.mm, 0, true, moon_pos, 0
    )
    moon_outline.material = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFFFFF")

    # Chữ nổi "COFFEE AND"
    coffee_group = entities.add_group
    coffee_text = "COFFEE\nAND"
    coffee_pos = Geom::Point3d.new(-5.mm, -10.mm, thickness)
    coffee_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      coffee_text, TextAlignCenter, "Arial Rounded MT Bold", false, false,
      7.mm, 15.mm, 0, true, coffee_pos, 0
    )
    coffee_group.material = Sketchup::Color.new("#4B2E12")

    # Chữ nổi "Tea"

    tea_text = "Tea"
    tea_pos = Geom::Point3d.new(55.mm, -20.mm, thickness)
    tea_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      tea_text, TextAlignCenter, "Arial Rounded MT Bold", false, false,

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100% dựng trần alu gương bóng BUB viền khung nhôm, có đèn LED
module TranAluGuongBongBubVienKhungNhom
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('TranAluGuongBongBubVienKhungNhom', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Kích thước tổng thể
    width = 3000.mm
    height = 1000.mm
    depth = 150.mm
    alu_thickness = 3.mm
    frame_thickness = 50.mm
    frame_width = frame_thickness
    led_radius = 25.mm
    led_height = 30.mm

    # Tạo khung xương sắt hộp (25x25mm)
    khung_group = entities.add_group
    khung = khung_group.entities
    sắt = 25.mm

    # Khung viền ngoài
    [
      [0,0,0], [width,0,0], [width,height,0], [0,height,0]
    ].each_with_index do |pt, i|
      next_pt = [
        [width,0,0], [width,height,0], [0,height,0], [0,0,0]
      ][i]
      khung.add_face(pt, [pt[0],pt[1],sắt], [next_pt[0],next_pt[1],sắt], next_pt).pushpull(sắt)
    end

    # Xương ngang tăng cứng (cách nhau ~500mm)
    (1..5).each do |i|
      x = i * width/6
      khung.add_face([x,0,0],[x,0,sắt],[x,height,sắt],[x,height,0]).pushpull(sắt)
    end

    # Xương dọc tăng cứng (cách nhau ~500mm)
    (1..1).each do |i|
      y = i * height/2
      khung.add_face([0,y,0],[0,y,sắt],[width,y,sắt],[width,y,0]).pushpull(sắt)
    end

    # Tai treo trần (4 góc)
    4.times do |i|
      x = (i==1 || i==2) ? width : 0
      y = (i>=2) ? height : 0
      khung.add_face([x,y,sắt],[x+50.mm,y,sắt],[x+50.mm,y+50.mm,sắt],[x,y+50.mm,sắt]).pushpull(10.mm)
    end

    # Tạo tấm alu gương bóng (nền)
    alu_group = entities.add_group
    alu = alu_group.entities
    alu_face = alu.add_face([0,0,sắt],[width,0,sắt],[width,height,sắt],[0,height,sắt])
    alu_face.pushpull(alu_thickness)
    # Màu gương bóng
    mat_alu = model.materials.add('AluMirror')
    mat_alu.color = Sketchup::Color.new('#E5E5E5')
    mat_alu.alpha = 0.7
    alu_face.material = mat_alu
    alu_face.back_material = mat_alu

    # Tạo viền khung nhôm hộp (50mm)
    frame_group = entities.add_group
    frame = frame_group.entities

module XeBanHangDenLedKinh60X140X200
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('XeBanHangDenLedKinh60X140X200', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Kích thước tổng thể
    width = 600.mm
    height = 1400.mm
    depth = 2000.mm

    # Thông số khung sắt
    frame_size = 30.mm
    frame_color = Sketchup::Color.new("#FF69B4") # Hồng đậm

    # Tạo khung sắt hộp
    frame_group = entities.add_group
    frame = frame_group.entities

    # 4 trụ đứng
    [[0,0,0],[width,0,0],[0,depth,0],[width,depth,0]].each do |x,y,z|
      frame.add_face([x,y,z],[x+frame_size,y,z],[x+frame_size,y,z+height],[x,y,z+height]).pushpull(frame_size)
    end

    # Khung trên/dưới
    [[0,0,0],[0,depth,0],[0,0,height-frame_size],[0,depth,height-frame_size]].each do |x,y,z|
      frame.add_face([x,y,z],[width,y,z],[width,y+frame_size,z],[x,y+frame_size,z]).pushpull(frame_size)
    end

    # Khung ngang tăng cứng (giữa)
    frame.add_face([0,0,height/2],[width,0,height/2],[width,frame_size,height/2],[0,frame_size,height/2]).pushpull(frame_size)
    frame.add_face([0,depth-frame_size,height/2],[width,depth-frame_size,height/2],[width,depth,height/2],[0,depth,height/2]).pushpull(frame_size)

    # Chân bánh xe
    4.times do |i|
      x = (i%2==0) ? 0 : width
      y = (i<2) ? 0 : depth
      cyl = frame.add_circle([x,y,0], [0,0,1], 25.mm, 24)
      frame.add_face(cyl).pushpull(-40.mm)
    end

    frame_group.material = frame_color

    # Tạo tấm nền alu mặt trước (hồng pastel)
    alu_color = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFB6C1")
    alu_group = entities.add_group
    alu = alu_group.entities
    alu_face = alu.add_face([0,0,0],[width,0,0],[width,0,900.mm],[0,0,900.mm])
    alu_face.pushpull(5.mm)
    alu_group.material = alu_color
    alu_group.move!([0,0,0])

    # Tạo tấm nền alu biển hiệu cong trên (hồng pastel)
    sign_group = entities.add_group
    sign = sign_group.entities
    sign_height = 300.mm
    sign_curve = []
    steps = 24
    (0..steps).each do |i|
      t = i.to_f/steps
      x = t*width
      y = 0
      z = 900.mm + sign_height*Math.sin(Math::PI*t)
      sign_curve << [x,y,z]
    end
    sign_curve << [width,0,900.mm]
    sign_curve << [0,0,900.mm]
    sign_face = sign.add_face(sign_curve)
    sign_face.pushpull(40.mm)
    sign_group.material = alu_color
    sign_group.move!([0,0,0])

    # Tạo kính cường lực mặt trước
    glass_group = entities.add_group
    glass = glass_group.entities
    glass_face = glass.add_face([0,0,900.mm],[width,0,900.mm],[width,0,1300.mm],[0,0,1300.mm])
    glass_face.pushpull(8.mm)
    glass_group.material = Sketchup::Color.new(200,255,255,80)
    glass_group.move!([0,0,0])

    # Tạo kính hai bên
    [0, width].each do |x|
      side_group = entities.add_group
      side = side_group.entities
      side_face = side.add_face([x,0,900.mm],[x,depth,900.mm],[x,depth,1300.mm],[x,0,1300.mm])
      side_face.pushpull(8.mm)
      side_group.material = Sketchup::Color.new(200,255,255,80)
    end

    # Viền nẹp alu quanh biển hiệu
    trim_group = entities.add_group
    trim = trim_group.entities
    trim.add_face([0,-10.mm,900.mm],[width,-10.mm,900.mm],[width,-10.mm,900.mm+sign_height],[0,-10.mm,900.mm+sign_height]).pushpull(10.mm)
    trim_group.material = frame_color

    # Chữ nổi "TIỆM TRÀ NHÀ MEOW" (trắng viền hồng)
    text_group = entities.add_group
    text = text_group.entities
    text.add_3d_text("TIỆM TRÀ NHÀ MEOW", 
      TextAlignCenter=true, 
      "Arial Black", 
      false, false, 120.mm, 30.mm, true, 0)
    text_group.material = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFFFFF")
    text_group.move!([width/2, 20.mm, 900.mm+sign_height/2+30.mm])

    # Chữ nổi "TRÀ NGON - ĐẬM VỊ" (xanh dương viền trắng)
    text2_group = entities.add_group
    text2 = text2_group.entities
    text2.add_3d_text("TRÀ NGON - ĐẬM VỊ", 
      TextAlignCenter=true, 
      "Arial Black", 
      false, false, 80.mm, 20.mm, true, 0)
    text2_group.material = Sketchup::Color.new("#1E90FF")
    text2_group.move!([width/2, 20.mm, 900.mm+40.mm])

    # Chữ nổi mặt trước (đỏ)
    ["TRÀ SỮA FULL TOPPING", "TRÀ TRÁI CÂY", "MÌ CAY - ĂN VẶT"].each_with_index do |line, i|
      g = entities.add_group
      e = g.entities
      e.add_3d_text(line, TextAlignLeft=true, "Arial Black", false, false, 60.mm, 15.mm, true, 0)
      g.material = Sketchup::Color.new("#FF3B3B")
      g.move!([40.mm, 20.mm, 700.mm-80.mm*i])
    end

    # Logo mèo tròn mặt trước
    logo_group = entities.add_group
    logo = logo_group.entities
    center = [width-120.mm, 60.mm, 400.mm]
    logo_circle = logo.add_circle(center, [0,0,1], 90.mm, 48)
    logo_face = logo.add_face(logo_circle)

    logo_text1 = logo.add_3d_text("TIỆM TRÀ NHÀ MEOW", TextAlignCenter=true, "Arial", false, false, 18.mm, 3.mm, true, 0)
    logo_text2 = logo.add_3d_text("0962 750 569", TextAlignCenter=true, "Arial", false, false, 18.mm, 3.mm, true, 0)
    logo_text1_group = logo.add_group(logo_text1)
    logo_text2_group = logo.add_group(logo_text2)
    logo_text1_group.material = Sketchup::Color.new("#FF69B4")
    logo_text2_group.material = Sketchup::Color.new("#FF69B4")
    logo_text1_group.move!([center[0], center[1], center[2]+10.mm])
    logo_text2_group.move!([center[0], center[1], center[2]-30.mm])

    # Icon ly trà sữa (trái biển hiệu)

    cup_face.pushpull(10.mm)
    cup_group.material = Sketchup::Color.new("#FFFACD")

    # Icon mèo (phải biển hiệu)

    # Khung ngang đáy, đỉnh, giữa
    [[0,0,0],[0,0,height],[0,0,base_height],[0,0,base_height+glass_height]].each do |zpt|
      khung.entities.add_face([0,0,zpt[2]], [width,0,zpt[2]], [width,khung_satt,zpt[2]], [0,khung_satt,zpt[2]])
      khung.entities.add_face([width,0,zpt[2]], [width,depth,zpt[2]], [width-khung_satt,depth,zpt[2]], [width-khung_satt,0,zpt[2]])
      khung.entities.add_face([width,depth,zpt[2]], [0,depth,zpt[2]], [0,depth-khung_satt,zpt[2]], [width,depth-khung_satt,zpt[2]])

    end

    # 2. Tấm alu vàng mặt trước
    alu_front = entities.add_group
    face = alu_front.entities.add_face(
      [khung_satt, khung_satt, 0],
      [width-khung_satt, khung_satt, 0],
      [width-khung_satt, khung_satt, base_height],
      [khung_satt, khung_satt, base_height]
    )
    face.pushpull(-alu_thickness)
    alu_front.material = mau_vang

    # 3. Tấm alu vàng mặt hông (trái/phải)
    [khung_satt, width-khung_satt-alu_thickness].each do |x|
      alu_side = entities.add_group
      face = alu_side.entities.add_face(
        [x, khung_satt, 0],
        [x, depth-khung_satt, 0],
        [x, depth-khung_satt, base_height],
        [x, khung_satt, base_height]
      )
      face.pushpull(-alu_thickness)
      alu_side.material = mau_vang
    end

    # 4. Kính cường lực mặt trước
    glass_front = entities.add_group
    face = glass_front.entities.add_face(
      [khung_satt+alu_thickness, khung_satt, base_height],
      [width-khung_satt-alu_thickness, khung_satt, base_height],
      [width-khung_satt-alu_thickness, khung_satt, base_height+glass_height],
      [khung_satt+alu_thickness, khung_satt, base_height+glass_height]
    )
    face.pushpull(-glass_thickness)
    glass_front.material = Sketchup::Color.new(255,255,255,40) # kính mờ

    # 5. Kính cường lực mặt bên
    [khung_satt+alu_thickness, width-khung_satt-alu_thickness-glass_thickness].each do |x|
      glass_side = entities.add_group
      face = glass_side.entities.add_face(
        [x, khung_satt, base_height],
        [x, depth-khung_satt, base_height],
        [x, depth-khung_satt, base_height+glass_height],
        [x, khung_satt, base_height+glass_height]
      )
      face.pushpull(-glass_thickness)
      glass_side.material = Sketchup::Color.new(255,255,255,40)
    end

    # 6. Hộp biển hiệu trên nóc (nền vàng)
    top_box = entities.add_group
    face = top_box.entities.add_face(
      [khung_satt, khung_satt, base_height+glass_height],
      [width-khung_satt, khung_satt, base_height+glass_height],
      [width-khung_satt, khung_satt, base_height+glass_height+top_box_height],
      [khung_satt, khung_satt, base_height+glass_height+top_box_height]
    )
    face.pushpull(-100.mm)
    top_box.material = mau_vang

    # 7. Chữ nổi "Tiệm Trà" (trắng, viền đen, shadow đen)

      false,
      120.mm,
      30.mm,
      0,
      true,
      2,
      true
    )
    text1.material = mau_trang
    text1.entities.each { |e| e.material = mau_trang if e.is_a?(Sketchup::Face) }
    text1.move!([khung_satt+50.mm, khung_satt-40.mm, base_height+glass_height+top_box_height+10.mm])

    # 8. Chữ nổi "Labubu" (hồng, viền đen, shadow đen)
    text2 = entities.add_group
    text2.entities.add_3d_text(
      "Labubu",
      TextAlignLeft,
      "Pacifico", # font script tương tự
      false,
      false,
      140.mm,
      40.mm,
      0,
      true,
      2,
      true
    )
    text2.material = mau_hong
    text2.entities.each { |e| e.material = mau_hong if e.is_a?(Sketchup::Face) }
    text2.move!([khung_satt+350.mm, khung_satt-40.mm, base_height+glass_height+top_box_height+10.mm])

    # 9. Chữ phụ mặt trước (3 dòng trắng, viền đen)
    y_text = base_height/2 + 60.mm
    ["TRÀ SỮA FULL TOPPING", "MILO DẦM", "YAOUIRT TRÁI CÂY"].each_with_index do |txt, i|
      t = entities.add_group
      t.entities.add_3d_text(
        txt,
        TextAlignCenter,
        "Arial Black",
        false,
        false,
        60.mm,
        15.mm,
        0,
        true,
        2,
        true
      )
      t.material = mau_trang
      t.entities.each { |e| e.material = mau_trang if e.is_a?(Sketchup::Face) }
      t.move!([width/2-300.mm, khung_satt+30.mm, y_text-i*70.mm])
    end

    # 10. Số điện thoại (nền trắng, chữ đen, viền đen)
    phone_bg = entities.add_group
    face = phone_bg.entities.add_face(
      [width/2-120.mm, khung_satt+30.mm, base_height/2-60.mm],
      [width/2+120.mm, khung_satt+30.mm, base_height/2-60.mm],
      [width/2+120.mm, khung_satt+30.mm, base_height/2-30.mm],
      [width/2-120.mm, khung_satt+30.mm, base_height/2-30.mm]
    )
    face.pushpull(-5.mm)
    phone_bg.material = mau_trang
    phone_txt = entities.add_group
    phone_txt.entities.add_3d_text(
      "Alo ship: 0389 786 547",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial",
      false,
      false,
      30.mm,
      8.mm,
      0,
      true,
      2,
      true
    )
    phone_txt.material = mau_den
    phone_txt.move!([width/2-100.mm, khung_satt+35.mm, base_height/2-55.mm])

    # 11. Logo tròn (dán decal)
    logo = entities.add_group
    center = [width-220.mm, khung_satt+35.mm, base_height/2]
    logo.entities.add_circle(center, [0,0,1], 70.mm)
    logo.entities.add_face(logo.entities[0])
    logo.material = mau_trang
    # Vẽ mascot đơn giản (hình elip hồng)

    mascot.entities.add_circle([center[0], center[1], center[2]+1.mm], [0,0,1], 30.mm)
    mascot.entities.add_face(mascot.entities[0])
    mascot.material = mau_hong

    # 12. Đèn LED bulb treo trần
    3.times do |i|
      led = entities.add_group
      x = width/4 + i*width/4
      y = depth/2
      z = base_height+glass_height+top_box_height-10.mm
      # Dây đèn
      led.entities.add_cylinder([x, y, z], [0,0,-1], 2.mm, 40.mm)
      # Bóng đèn
      led.entities.add_circle([x, y, z-40.mm], [0,0,-1], 15.mm)
      led.entities.add_face(led.entities[1])
      led.material = mau_trang
    end

    # 13. Bánh xe di động
    4.times do |i|
      wheel = entities.add_group
      wx = [khung_satt+30.mm, width-khung_satt-30.mm][i%2]
      wy = [khung_satt+30.mm, depth-khung_satt-30.mm][i/2]
      wz = -20.mm
      wheel.entities.add_circle([wx, wy, wz], [0,0,1], 18.mm)
      wheel.entities.add_face(wheel.entities[0])
      wheel.material = mau_xam
    end

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

module BangChucDanhDeGoAnMon
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model

    # Kích thước tổng thể
    width = 300.mm

      [ (base1_width/2),  (base1_depth/2), 0],
      [-(base1_width/2),  (base1_depth/2), 0]
    )
    base1_face.pushpull(base1_height)
    base1.material = "#7B2E1D"

    # Đế gỗ tầng trên
    base2_height = 20.mm
    base2_depth = 25.mm
    base2_width = width + 10.mm
    base2 = entities.add_group
    base2_face = base2.entities.add_face(
      [-(base2_width/2), -base2_depth/2, base1_height],
      [ (base2_width/2), -base2_depth/2, base1_height],
      [ (base2_width/2),  (base2_depth/2), base1_height],
      [-(base2_width/2),  (base2_depth/2), base1_height]
    )
    base2_face.pushpull(base2_height)
    base2.material = "#7B2E1D"

    # Mặt bảng kim loại ăn mòn
    board = entities.add_group
    board_z = base1_height + base2_height
    board_face = board.entities.add_face(
      [-(width/2), -depth/2, board_z],
      [ (width/2), -depth/2, board_z],
      [ (width/2),  (depth/2), board_z],
      [-(width/2),  (depth/2), board_z]
    )
    board_face.pushpull(height)
    board.material = "#D8C75A"

    # Viền bảng (viền đỏ nâu)
    border = entities.add_group

      [-(width/2 + border_thick), -(depth/2 + border_thick), board_z - border_thick],

      [ (width/2 - pattern_offset), -(depth/2 - pattern_thick), board_z + pattern_thick],
      [ (width/2 - pattern_offset),  (depth/2 - pattern_thick), board_z + pattern_thick],
      [-(width/2 - pattern_offset),  (depth/2 - pattern_thick), board_z + pattern_thick]
    )
    pattern_face.pushpull(height - 2*pattern_offset)
    pattern.material = "#F5D76E"

    # Viền họa tiết vàng ở đế
    base_pattern = entities.add_group
    base_pattern_face = base_pattern.entities.add_face(
      [-(base2_width/2 - 7.mm), -base2_depth/2 + 2.mm, base1_height + 1.mm],
      [ (base2_width/2 - 7.mm), -base2_depth/2 + 2.mm, base1_height + 1.mm],

    )
    base_pattern_face.pushpull(2.mm)
    base_pattern.material = "#F5D76E"

    # Logo (mô phỏng khối tròn, không chi tiết)
    logo = entities.add_group
    logo_radius = 28.mm
    logo_center = [-(width/2) + 45.mm, 0, board_z + height/2]
    logo_face = logo.entities.add_circle(logo_center, [0,0,1], logo_radius)
    logo.entities.add_face(logo_face).pushpull(2.mm)
    logo.material = "#D32F2F"

    # Chữ nổi "LUẬT SƯ"
    text1 = entities.add_group

      "Luật sư",
      TextAlignLeft,
      "Arial",
      false,
      false,
      18.mm,
      2.mm,
      0,
      true,
      "#E53935"
    ).move!([-(width/2) + 100.mm, 0, board_z + height - 40.mm])

    # Chữ nổi "HUỲNH TẤN ĐÔ"

      0,
      true,
      "#E53935"
    ).move!([-(width/2) + 100.mm, 0, board_z + height - 80.mm])

    model.commit_operation
  end
