# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module BangHieuBatLotTon1300X120
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('BangHieuBatLotTon1300X120', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số chính
    width = 13000.mm
    height = 1200.mm
    depth = 150.mm
    khung_size = 30.mm
    khung_spacing = 500.mm

    # Màu sắc
    mau_nen = "#F5A623"
    mau_chu = "#FFFFFF"
    mau_logo_vien = "#F5A623"
    mau_logo_xanh = "#3CB371"

    # === Khung xương sắt hộp ===
    khung_group = entities.add_group
    khung_entities = khung_group.entities

    # Khung viền ngoài
    [
      [0,0,0], [width,0,0], [width,height,0], [0,height,0]
    ].each_with_index do |pt, i|
      next_pt = [ [0,0,0], [width,0,0], [width,height,0], [0,height,0] ][(i+1)%4]
      edge = khung_entities.add_line(pt, next_pt)
      face = khung_entities.add_face(
        pt,
        [pt[0]+khung_size, pt[1], pt[2]],
        [next_pt[0]+khung_size, next_pt[1], next_pt[2]],
        next_pt
      )
      face.pushpull(-khung_size)
    end

    # Xương đứng
    x = khung_spacing
    while x < width
      khung_entities.add_face(
        [x,0,0],
        [x+khung_size,0,0],
        [x+khung_size,height,0],
        [x,height,0]
      ).pushpull(-khung_size)
      x += khung_spacing
    end

    # Xương ngang tăng cứng (2 thanh ngang)
    [height/3, 2*height/3].each do |y|
      khung_entities.add_face(
        [0,y,0],
        [width,y,0],
        [width,y+khung_size,0],
        [0,y+khung_size,0]
      ).pushpull(-khung_size)
    end

    khung_group.name = "Khung xương sắt hộp"

    # === Tấm nền bảng hiệu (bạt/alu) ===
    nen_group = entities.add_group
    nen_face = nen_group.entities.add_face(
      [0,0,khung_size],
      [width,0,khung_size],
      [width,height,khung_size],
      [0,height,khung_size]
    )
    nen_face.pushpull(depth - khung_size)
    nen_face.material = mau_nen
    nen_group.name = "Tấm nền bảng hiệu"

    # === Viền nẹp alu/nhôm ===
    vien_group = entities.add_group
    vien_entities = vien_group.entities
    vien_width = 20.mm
    # Viền trên
    vien_entities.add_face(
      [-vien_width, -vien_width, khung_size],
      [width+vien_width, -vien_width, khung_size],
      [width+vien_width, 0, khung_size],
      [-vien_width, 0, khung_size]
    ).pushpull(depth - khung_size)
    # Viền dưới
    vien_entities.add_face(
      [-vien_width, height, khung_size],
      [width+vien_width, height, khung_size],
      [width+vien_width, height+vien_width, khung_size],
      [-vien_width, height+vien_width, khung_size]
    ).pushpull(depth - khung_size)
    # Viền trái
    vien_entities.add_face(
      [-vien_width, 0, khung_size],
      [0, 0, khung_size],
      [0, height, khung_size],
      [-vien_width, height, khung_size]
    ).pushpull(depth - khung_size)
    # Viền phải
    vien_entities.add_face(
      [width, 0, khung_size],
      [width+vien_width, 0, khung_size],
      [width+vien_width, height, khung_size],
      [width, height, khung_size]
    ).pushpull(depth - khung_size)
    vien_group.name = "Viền nẹp alu"

    # === Logo tròn bên trái ===
    logo_group = entities.add_group
    logo_center = [200.mm + 150.mm, height/2 + khung_size, depth/2 + khung_size]
    logo_radius = 150.mm
    logo_face = logo_group.entities.add_circle(logo_center, [0,0,1], logo_radius)
    logo_face = logo_group.entities.add_face(logo_face)
    logo_face.pushpull(10.mm)
    logo_face.material = "white"
    # Viền logo
    logo_vien = logo_group.entities.add_circle(logo_center, [0,0,1], logo_radius+10.mm)
    logo_vien_face = logo_group.entities.add_face(logo_vien)
    logo_vien_face.material = mau_logo_vien
    logo_vien_face.erase!
    # Chữ "PT" cách điệu (mô phỏng bằng 2 khối chữ)
    logo_group.entities.add_3d_text("P", false, "Arial", false, false, 80.mm, 10.mm, 0, true, true).each do |ent|
      ent.move!([logo_center[0]-50.mm, logo_center[1]-40.mm, logo_center[2]+2.mm])
      ent.material = mau_logo_vien
    end
    logo_group.entities.add_3d_text("T", false, "Arial", false, false, 80.mm, 10.mm, 0, true, true).each do |ent|
      ent.move!([logo_center[0]+10.mm, logo_center[1]-40.mm, logo_center[2]+2.mm])
      ent.material = mau_logo_xanh
    end
    logo_group.name = "Logo tròn"

    # === Chữ nổi "Phúc Thuận 福順" ===
    text_group = entities.add_group
    # Chữ "Phúc Thuận"
    text1 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text("Phúc Thuận", false, "Arial", false, false, 250.mm, 30.mm, 0, true, true)
    text1.each do |ent|
      ent.material = mau_chu
      ent.move!([logo_center[0]+logo_radius+80.mm, height/2 + 100.mm, depth-60.mm])
    end
    # Chữ "福順"
    text2 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text("福順", false, "Arial", false, false, 120.mm, 20.mm, 0, true, true)
    text2.each do |ent|
      ent.material = mau_chu
      ent.move!([logo_center[0]+logo_radius+700.mm, height/2 + 110.mm, depth-60.mm])
    end
    text_group.name = "Chữ nổi"

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module BangHieuXinhanBat2Mat80X120
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('BangHieuXinhanBat2Mat80X120', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Kích thước tổng thể
    width = 800.mm
    height = 1200.mm
    depth = 30.mm

    # Khung sắt hộp 25x25mm
    khung_thickness = 25.mm
    khung_group = entities.add_group
    khung = khung_group.entities

    # 4 thanh khung viền ngoài
    # Trên
    khung.add_face([0,0,0], [width,0,0], [width,khung_thickness,0], [0,khung_thickness,0]).pushpull(depth)
    # Dưới
    khung.add_face([0,height-khung_thickness,0], [width,height-khung_thickness,0], [width,height,0], [0,height,0]).pushpull(depth)
    # Trái
    khung.add_face([0,khung_thickness,0], [khung_thickness,khung_thickness,0], [khung_thickness,height-khung_thickness,0], [0,height-khung_thickness,0]).pushpull(depth)
    # Phải
    khung.add_face([width-khung_thickness,khung_thickness,0], [width,khung_thickness,0], [width,height-khung_thickness,0], [width-khung_thickness,height-khung_thickness,0]).pushpull(depth)

    # Xương đứng giữa (cách nhau ~500mm)
    x1 = khung_thickness + 500.mm
    khung.add_face([x1,khung_thickness,0], [x1+khung_thickness,khung_thickness,0], [x1+khung_thickness,height-khung_thickness,0], [x1,height-khung_thickness,0]).pushpull(depth)

    # Xương ngang tăng cứng (ở giữa chiều cao)
    y1 = height/2 - khung_thickness/2
    khung.add_face([khung_thickness,y1,0], [width-khung_thickness,y1,0], [width-khung_thickness,y1+khung_thickness,0], [khung_thickness,y1+khung_thickness,0]).pushpull(depth)

    # Tấm nền bạt hiflex căng phẳng (lọt lòng khung)
    nen_group = entities.add_group
    nen = nen_group.entities
    nen_face = nen.add_face(
      [khung_thickness, khung_thickness, khung_thickness],
      [width - khung_thickness, khung_thickness, khung_thickness],
      [width - khung_thickness, height - khung_thickness, khung_thickness],
      [khung_thickness, height - khung_thickness, khung_thickness]
    )
    nen_face.pushpull(depth - khung_thickness)
    nen_group.material = "#ffe600" # Vàng tươi

    # Dải xanh trên (cao 140mm)
    dai_xanh_tren = entities.add_group
    dai_xanh_tren.entities.add_face(
      [khung_thickness, height - khung_thickness - 140.mm, khung_thickness+0.1.mm],
      [width - khung_thickness, height - khung_thickness - 140.mm, khung_thickness+0.1.mm],
      [width - khung_thickness, height - khung_thickness, khung_thickness+0.1.mm],
      [khung_thickness, height - khung_thickness, khung_thickness+0.1.mm]
    ).pushpull(2.mm)
    dai_xanh_tren.material = "#003399"

    # Dải xanh dưới (cao 90mm)
    dai_xanh_duoi = entities.add_group
    dai_xanh_duoi.entities.add_face(
      [khung_thickness, khung_thickness, khung_thickness+0.1.mm],
      [width - khung_thickness, khung_thickness, khung_thickness+0.1.mm],
      [width - khung_thickness, khung_thickness + 90.mm, khung_thickness+0.1.mm],
      [khung_thickness, khung_thickness + 90.mm, khung_thickness+0.1.mm]
    ).pushpull(2.mm)
    dai_xanh_duoi.material = "#003399"

    # Viền nẹp nhôm vàng mờ (bản 20mm)
    vien_group = entities.add_group
    vien = vien_group.entities
    vien_color = "#d4af37"
    # 4 cạnh viền
    vien.add_face([0,0,depth], [width,0,depth], [width,20.mm,depth], [0,20.mm,depth]).pushpull(-5.mm)
    vien.add_face([0,height-20.mm,depth], [width,height-20.mm,depth], [width,height,depth], [0,height,depth]).pushpull(-5.mm)
    vien.add_face([0,20.mm,depth], [20.mm,20.mm,depth], [20.mm,height-20.mm,depth], [0,height-20.mm,depth]).pushpull(-5.mm)
    vien.add_face([width-20.mm,20.mm,depth], [width,20.mm,depth], [width,height-20.mm,depth], [width-20.mm,height-20.mm,depth]).pushpull(-5.mm)
    vien_group.material = vien_color

    # Chữ nổi (dùng add_3d_text, thực tế là in bạt nhưng mô phỏng nổi cho rõ)
    text_group = entities.add_group

    # Dòng 1: TIỆM IN (trên dải xanh, màu vàng)
    text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "TIỆM IN",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false, false,
      70.mm, 15.mm, 0, true, 0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.new([width/2, height - khung_thickness - 70.mm, depth+2.mm]))
    text_group.material = "#ffe600"

    # Dòng 2: PHƯỚC TIÊN (trên dải xanh, màu vàng)
    text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "PHƯỚC TIÊN",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false, false,
      90.mm, 20.mm, 0, true, 0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.new([width/2, height - khung_thickness - 130.mm, depth+2.mm]))
    text_group.material = "#ffe600"

    # Dòng 3: IN MÀU (chính giữa, màu xanh)
    text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "IN MÀU",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false, false,
      100.mm, 30.mm, 0, true, 0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.new([width/2, height - khung_thickness - 250.mm, depth+2.mm]))
    text_group.material = "#003399"

    # Dòng 4: PHOTO (chính giữa, màu xanh)
    text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "PHOTO",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false, false,
      100.mm, 30.mm, 0, true, 0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.new([width/2, height - khung_thickness - 350.mm, depth+2.mm]))
    text_group.material = "#003399"

    # Dòng 5: ẢNH THẺ (chính giữa, màu xanh)
    text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "ẢNH THẺ",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false, false,
      100.mm, 30.mm, 0, true, 0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.new([width/2, height - khung_thickness - 450.mm, depth+2.mm]))
    text_group.material = "#003399"

    # Dòng 6: Số điện thoại (trên dải xanh dưới, màu vàng)
    text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "0329.663.642",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false, false,
      70.mm, 15.mm, 0, true, 0
    ).transform!(Geom::Transformation.new([width/2, khung_thickness + 45.mm, depth+2.mm]))
    text_group.material = "#ffe600"

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module BangHieuXinhanBat2MatCoTru150X150
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('BangHieuXinhanBat2MatCoTru150X150', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số chính
    width = 1500.mm
    height = 1500.mm
    depth = 30.mm
    truss_size = 40.mm
    truss_height = 1700.mm
    truss_offset = 50.mm # khoảng cách trụ ra ngoài bảng
    frame_size = 25.mm

    # Màu sắc
    color_yellow = Sketchup::Color.new("#F9C846")
    color_brown = Sketchup::Color.new("#7B4B13")
    color_green = Sketchup::Color.new("#217A3B")
    color_gray = Sketchup::Color.new("#B0B0B0")
    color_black = Sketchup::Color.new("#222222")

    # 1. Dựng 2 trụ đứng
    truss_group = entities.add_group
    # Trụ trái
    truss1 = truss_group.entities.add_face(
      [0, 0, 0],
      [truss_size, 0, 0],
      [truss_size, depth, 0],
      [0, depth, 0]
    )
    truss1.pushpull(truss_height)
    # Trụ phải
    truss2 = truss_group.entities.add_face(
      [width + 2*truss_offset, 0, 0],
      [width + 2*truss_offset + truss_size, 0, 0],
      [width + 2*truss_offset + truss_size, depth, 0],
      [width + 2*truss_offset, depth, 0]
    )
    truss2.pushpull(truss_height)
    truss_group.material = color_gray

    # 2. Dựng khung viền bảng hiệu (sắt hộp 25x25)
    frame_group = entities.add_group
    # Khung ngoài
    frame_origin = [truss_offset + truss_size, 0, truss_height - height - 100.mm]
    # 4 cạnh khung
    # Trên
    frame_group.entities.add_face(
      [frame_origin[0], frame_origin[1], frame_origin[2] + height],
      [frame_origin[0] + width, frame_origin[1], frame_origin[2] + height],
      [frame_origin[0] + width, frame_origin[1] + frame_size, frame_origin[2] + height],
      [frame_origin[0], frame_origin[1] + frame_size, frame_origin[2] + height]
    ).pushpull(frame_size)
    # Dưới
    frame_group.entities.add_face(
      [frame_origin[0], frame_origin[1], frame_origin[2]],
      [frame_origin[0] + width, frame_origin[1], frame_origin[2]],
      [frame_origin[0] + width, frame_origin[1] + frame_size, frame_origin[2]],
      [frame_origin[0], frame_origin[1] + frame_size, frame_origin[2]]
    ).pushpull(frame_size)
    # Trái
    frame_group.entities.add_face(
      [frame_origin[0], frame_origin[1], frame_origin[2]],
      [frame_origin[0] + frame_size, frame_origin[1], frame_origin[2]],
      [frame_origin[0] + frame_size, frame_origin[1], frame_origin[2] + height],
      [frame_origin[0], frame_origin[1], frame_origin[2] + height]
    ).pushpull(frame_size)
    # Phải
    frame_group.entities.add_face(
      [frame_origin[0] + width - frame_size, frame_origin[1], frame_origin[2]],
      [frame_origin[0] + width, frame_origin[1], frame_origin[2]],
      [frame_origin[0] + width, frame_origin[1], frame_origin[2] + height],
      [frame_origin[0] + width - frame_size, frame_origin[1], frame_origin[2] + height]
    ).pushpull(frame_size)
    frame_group.material = color_gray

    # 3. Dựng tấm nền bảng hiệu (bạt vàng)
    sign_group = entities.add_group
    sign_face = sign_group.entities.add_face(
      [frame_origin[0] + frame_size, frame_origin[1] + frame_size, frame_origin[2] + frame_size],
      [frame_origin[0] + width - frame_size, frame_origin[1] + frame_size, frame_origin[2] + frame_size],
      [frame_origin[0] + width - frame_size, frame_origin[1] + frame_size, frame_origin[2] + height - frame_size],
      [frame_origin[0] + frame_size, frame_origin[1] + frame_size, frame_origin[2] + height - frame_size]
    )
    sign_face.pushpull(depth - 2*frame_size)
    sign_group.material = color_yellow

    # 4. Dựng chữ nổi 3D (dùng add_3d_text)
    text_group = entities.add_group

    # "VỰA SẦU RIÊNG"
    text1 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "VỰA SẦU RIÊNG",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial",
      false, false,
      100.mm, 15.mm, 0, true, 0
    )
    text1_group = text_group.entities.add_group(text1)
    text1_group.material = color_brown
    text1_group.move!([
      frame_origin[0] + width/2,
      frame_origin[1] + depth/2,
      frame_origin[2] + height - 200.mm
    ])

    # "Phúc Thuận"
    text2 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "Phúc Thuận",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial",
      false, false,
      180.mm, 30.mm, 0, true, 0
    )
    text2_group = text_group.entities.add_group(text2)
    text2_group.material = color_green
    text2_group.move!([
      frame_origin[0] + width/2,
      frame_origin[1] + depth/2,
      frame_origin[2] + height/2 + 50.mm
    ])

    # "Km14 - QL14 - CUÔR ĐĂNG - DAKLAK"
    text3 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "Km14 - QL14 - CUÔR ĐĂNG - DAKLAK",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial",
      false, false,
      60.mm, 10.mm, 0, true, 0
    )
    text3_group = text_group.entities.add_group(text3)
    text3_group.material = color_black
    text3_group.move!([
      frame_origin[0] + width/2,
      frame_origin[1] + depth/2,
      frame_origin[2] + 120.mm
    ])

    # "0764.39 68 68 - 0934.53 22 55"
    text4 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "0764.39 68 68 - 0934.53 22 55",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial",
      false, false,
      60.mm, 10.mm, 0, true, 0
    )
    text4_group = text_group.entities.add_group(text4)
    text4_group.material = color_black
    text4_group.move!([
      frame_origin[0] + width/2,
      frame_origin[1] + depth/2,
      frame_origin[2] + 70.mm
    ])

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

# Mã nguồn Ruby hoàn chỉnh 100%
module DecalBeDanKinh1
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('DecalBeDanKinh1', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Kích thước tổng thể (3 tấm kính)
    total_width = 3000.mm
    total_height = 2500.mm
    glass_thickness = 10.mm

    # Tạo 3 tấm kính
    glass_width = total_width / 3
    3.times do |i|
      grp = entities.add_group
      face = grp.entities.add_face(
        [i * glass_width, 0, 0],
        [(i + 1) * glass_width, 0, 0],
        [(i + 1) * glass_width, 0, total_height],
        [i * glass_width, 0, total_height]
      )
      face.pushpull(-glass_thickness)
      mat = model.materials.add("Glass")
      mat.alpha = 0.15
      mat.color = Sketchup::Color.new(200, 220, 255)
      grp.material = mat
      grp.layer = "Glass"
    end

    # Decal đỏ lớn (VF8)
    decal1_width = 900.mm
    decal1_height = 1800.mm
    decal1_x = 0.55 * glass_width
    decal1_y = 0
    decal1_z = 400.mm
    grp1 = entities.add_group
    pts1 = [
      [decal1_x, glass_thickness + 0.1.mm, decal1_z],
      [decal1_x + decal1_width, glass_thickness + 0.1.mm, decal1_z + 100.mm],
      [decal1_x + decal1_width - 80.mm, glass_thickness + 0.1.mm, decal1_z + decal1_height],
      [decal1_x - 80.mm, glass_thickness + 0.1.mm, decal1_z + decal1_height - 100.mm]
    ]
    face1 = grp1.entities.add_face(pts1)
    face1.pushpull(1.mm)
    mat1 = model.materials.add("DecalRed")
    mat1.color = "#D32F2F"
    grp1.material = mat1

    # Decal đỏ lớn (WILD)
    decal2_width = 900.mm
    decal2_height = 1800.mm
    decal2_x = glass_width * 2 + 0.05 * glass_width
    decal2_y = 0
    decal2_z = 400.mm
    grp2 = entities.add_group
    pts2 = [
      [decal2_x, glass_thickness + 0.1.mm, decal2_z + 100.mm],
      [decal2_x + decal2_width, glass_thickness + 0.1.mm, decal2_z],
      [decal2_x + decal2_width - 80.mm, glass_thickness + 0.1.mm, decal2_z + decal2_height - 100.mm],
      [decal2_x - 80.mm, glass_thickness + 0.1.mm, decal2_z + decal2_height]
    ]
    face2 = grp2.entities.add_face(pts2)
    face2.pushpull(1.mm)
    mat2 = model.materials.add("DecalRed2")
    mat2.color = "#D32F2F"
    grp2.material = mat2

    # Chữ nổi 3D (mô phỏng decal dán nổi)
    # VF8
    vf8_grp = entities.add_group
    vf8_text = vf8_grp.entities.add_3d_text(
      "VF8",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false,
      false,
      180.mm,
      30.mm,
      0,
      true,
      0
    )
    vf8_grp.material = "#FFFFFF"
    vf8_grp.move! Geom::Transformation.new([decal1_x + decal1_width / 2, glass_thickness + 2.mm, decal1_z + 120.mm])

    # WILD
    wild_grp = entities.add_group
    wild_text = wild_grp.entities.add_3d_text(
      "WILD",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false,
      false,
      150.mm,
      30.mm,
      0,
      true,
      0
    )
    wild_grp.material = "#FFFFFF"
    wild_grp.move! Geom::Transformation.new([decal2_x + decal2_width / 2, glass_thickness + 2.mm, decal2_z + 120.mm])

    # VINFAST logo (dưới kính)
    3.times do |i|
      vinfast_grp = entities.add_group
      vinfast_text = vinfast_grp.entities.add_3d_text(
        "VINFAST",
        TextAlignCenter,
        "Arial",
        false,
        false,
        60.mm,
        8.mm,
        0,
        true,
        0
      )
      vinfast_grp.material = "#FFFFFF"
      vinfast_grp.move! Geom::Transformation.new([i * glass_width + glass_width / 2, glass_thickness + 2.mm, 120.mm])
      # Logo chữ V cách điệu (mô phỏng khối tam giác)
      v_grp = vinfast_grp.entities.add_group
      v_pts = [
        [0, 0, 80.mm],
        [20.mm, 0, 120.mm],
        [-20.mm, 0, 120.mm]
      ]
      v_face = v_grp.entities.add_face(v_pts)
      v_face.pushpull(2.mm)
      v_grp.material = "#FFFFFF"
      v_grp.move! Geom::Transformation.new([0, 0, 0])
    end

    # Slogan và số (dạng text nổi mô phỏng decal)
    # "BẢO HÀNH 10 NĂM"
    bh1_grp = entities.add_group
    bh1_text = bh1_grp.entities.add_3d_text(
      "BẢO HÀNH\n10 NĂM",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial",
      false,
      false,
      40.mm,
      6.mm,
      0,
      true,
      0
    )
    bh1_grp.material = "#FFFFFF"
    bh1_grp.move! Geom::Transformation.new([decal1_x + decal1_width + 100.mm, glass_thickness + 2.mm, decal1_z + 400.mm])

    bh2_grp = entities.add_group
    bh2_text = bh2_grp.entities.add_3d_text(
      "BẢO HÀNH\n10 NĂM",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial",
      false,
      false,
      40.mm,
      6.mm,
      0,
      true,
      0
    )
    bh2_grp.material = "#FFFFFF"
    bh2_grp.move! Geom::Transformation.new([decal2_x - 100.mm, glass_thickness + 2.mm, decal2_z + 400.mm])

    # Số lớn (782 triệu đồng)
    so1_grp = entities.add_group
    so1_text = so1_grp.entities.add_3d_text(
      "782",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false,
      false,
      60.mm,
      10.mm,
      0,
      true,

module DecalBeDanKinh

      Bold = true,

      true,

    splash_w = 1200.mm

    splash_x = (width - splash_w) / 2
    splash_y = 120.mm
    splash_face = entities.add_face(
      [splash_x, splash_y, decal_thickness+1.mm],
      [splash_x+splash_w, splash_y, decal_thickness+1.mm],
      [splash_x+splash_w, splash_y+splash_h, decal_thickness+1.mm],
      [splash_x, splash_y+splash_h, decal_thickness+1.mm]
    )
    splash_face.pushpull(4.mm)
    splash_face.material = Sketchup::Color.new("#1976D2")

    # Tạo các khối xe (đại diện bằng hình hộp màu)
    car_w = 220.mm
    car_h = 100.mm
    car_d = 40.mm
    car_colors = ["#F06292", "#FFEB3B", "#E53935", "#FFFFFF"]
    4.times do |i|
      car_x = splash_x + 60.mm + i*(car_w+40.mm)
      car_y = splash_y + 40.mm
      car = entities.add_group
      car.entities.add_face(
        [car_x, car_y, decal_thickness+5.mm],

        [car_x, car_y+car_h, decal_thickness+5.mm]
      ).pushpull(car_d)
      car.material = Sketchup::Color.new(car_colors[i])
    end

    model.commit_operation
  end
end

module HopDenBatInUv1Mat400X90
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('HopDenBatInUv1Mat400X90', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Thông số
    width = 4000.mm
    height = 900.mm
    depth = 30.mm
    khung_size = 25.mm
    vien_nep = 30.mm

    # Màu sắc
    mau_xanh = "#0057B7"
    mau_vang = "#FFE600"
    mau_trang = "#FFFFFF"
    mau_nhom = "#E5E5E5"
    mau_den = "#222222"

    materials = model.materials
    mat_xanh = materials.add('XanhBien'); mat_xanh.color = mau_xanh
    mat_vang = materials.add('VangTuoi'); mat_vang.color = mau_vang
    mat_trang = materials.add('Trang'); mat_trang.color = mau_trang
    mat_nhom = materials.add('Nhom'); mat_nhom.color = mau_nhom
    mat_den = materials.add('Den'); mat_den.color = mau_den

    # 1. Dựng khung xương sắt hộp
    khung_group = entities.add_group
    kg = khung_group.entities

    # Khung ngoài
    [
      [ORIGIN, [width, 0, 0]],
      [[width, 0, 0], [width, height, 0]],
      [[width, height, 0], [0, height, 0]],
      [[0, height, 0], ORIGIN]
    ].each do |p1, p2|
      edge = kg.add_line(p1, p2)
      edge.faces.each { |f| f.erase! }
      kg.add_face([p1, [p1[0], p1[1], p1[2]+khung_size], [p2[0], p2[1], p2[2]+khung_size], p2]).pushpull(-khung_size)
    end

    # Xương đứng (cách nhau ~500mm)
    (1..7).each do |i|
      x = i * (width/8)
      kg.add_face([[x, 0, 0], [x+khung_size, 0, 0], [x+khung_size, height, 0], [x, height, 0]]).pushpull(-khung_size)
    end

    # Xương ngang tăng cứng (trên/dưới)
    [khung_size, height-khung_size*2].each do |y|
      kg.add_face([[0, y, 0], [width, y, 0], [width, y+khung_size, 0], [0, y+khung_size, 0]]).pushpull(-khung_size)
    end

    khung_group.material = mat_nhom

    # 2. Tấm nền bạt in UV
    nen_group = entities.add_group
    face = nen_group.entities.add_face([ [0,0,khung_size], [width,0,khung_size], [width,height,khung_size], [0,height,khung_size] ])
    face.pushpull(depth-khung_size)
    nen_group.material = mat_xanh

    # 3. Viền nẹp nhôm/alu
    vien_group = entities.add_group
    # Trên
    vien_group.entities.add_face([[0,0,depth], [width,0,depth], [width,vien_nep,depth], [0,vien_nep,depth]]).pushpull(-vien_nep)
    # Dưới
    vien_group.entities.add_face([[0,height-vien_nep,depth], [width,height-vien_nep,depth], [width,height,depth], [0,height,depth]]).pushpull(-vien_nep)
    # Trái
    vien_group.entities.add_face([[0,0,depth], [vien_nep,0,depth], [vien_nep,height,depth], [0,height,depth]]).pushpull(-vien_nep)
    # Phải
    vien_group.entities.add_face([[width-vien_nep,0,depth], [width,0,depth], [width,height,depth], [width-vien_nep,height,depth]]).pushpull(-vien_nep)
    vien_group.material = mat_nhom

    # 4. Chữ nổi (dùng add_3d_text mô phỏng in UV)
    text_group = entities.add_group

    # Dòng trên cùng: "TIỆM IN PHƯỚC TIẾN - IN NHANH LẤY LIỀN"
    text1 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "TIỆM IN PHƯỚC TIẾN - IN NHANH LẤY LIỀN",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false, false,
      120.mm, 10.mm, 0, true, 0
    )
    text1.material = mat_vang
    text1.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width/2, 60.mm, depth+1.mm]))

    # Dòng giữa: "IN MÀU - PHOTOCOPY - ẢNH THẺ"
    text2 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "IN MÀU - PHOTOCOPY - ẢNH THẺ",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false, false,
      140.mm, 10.mm, 0, true, 0
    )
    text2.material = mat_xanh
    text2.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width/2, 220.mm, depth+1.mm]))

    # Dòng phụ nhỏ
    text3 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "SCAN - PHOTOCOPY - IN MÀU - ĐÓNG SÁCH - IN MENU\nTEM NHÃN CARD VISIT - TỜ RƠI QUẢNG CÁO - CHỈNH SỬA ĐỒ ÁN - IN 3D THEO YÊU CẦU - VĂN PHÒNG PHẨM - IN ẢNH",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial",
      false, false,
      40.mm, 5.mm, 0, true, 0
    )
    text3.material = mat_trang
    text3.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width/2, 350.mm, depth+1.mm]))

    # Góc phải: "HỖ TRỢ NHẬN FILE ..."
    text4 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "HỖ TRỢ NHẬN FILE\nSỬA & IN ONLINE TỪ XA\nGIAO HÀNG TẬN NƠI",
      TextAlignLeft,
      "Arial Black",
      false, false,
      40.mm, 5.mm, 0, true, 0
    )
    text4.material = mat_xanh
    text4.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width-600.mm, 60.mm, depth+1.mm]))

    # Dòng địa chỉ dưới cùng
    text5 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "395 LÊ DUẨN - BUÔN MA THUỘT - ĐẮK LẮK",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false, false,
      60.mm, 8.mm, 0, true, 0
    )
    text5.material = mat_trang
    text5.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width/2, height-80.mm, depth+1.mm]))

    # Số điện thoại
    text6 = text_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "Liên hệ: 0329.663.642",
      TextAlignRight,
      "Arial Black",
      false, false,
      40.mm, 5.mm, 0, true, 0
    )
    text6.material = mat_trang
    text6.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([width-80.mm, height-80.mm, depth+1.mm]))

    # 5. Logo (mô phỏng khối vuông + chữ)
    logo_group = entities.add_group
    # Nền logo
    logo_face = logo_group.entities.add_face([[60.mm, 60.mm, depth+2.mm], [160.mm, 60.mm, depth+2.mm], [160.mm, 160.mm, depth+2.mm], [60.mm, 160.mm, depth+2.mm]])
    logo_face.pushpull(8.mm)
    logo_group.material = mat_xanh
    # Chữ "PHUOCTIEN" (mô phỏng)
    logo_text = logo_group.entities.add_3d_text(
      "PHUOCTIEN",
      TextAlignCenter,
      "Arial Black",
      false, false,
      22.mm, 2.mm, 0, true, 0
    )
    logo_text.material = mat_trang
    logo_text.transform!(Geom::Transformation.translation([110.mm, 80.mm, depth+10.mm]))

    # 6. Tai treo tường (2 bên)
    tai_group = entities.add_group
    [[0, height/2-60.mm, 0], [width-60.mm, height/2-60.mm, 0]].each do |pos|
      tai = tai_group.entities.add_face([
        pos,
        [pos[0]+60.mm, pos[1], pos[2]],
        [pos[0]+60.mm, pos[1]+20.mm, pos[2]],
        [pos[0], pos[1]+20.mm, pos[2]]
      ])
      tai.pushpull(-60.mm)
    end
    tai_group.material = mat_nhom

    model.commit_operation
  end
